Bava Batra 57b:6-58a:2: Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa: bakkol shuttafin meakkevin ze et ze, chutz min hakkevisa – sheen darkan shel benot yisrael lehitbazzot al hakkevisa.
"Veotzem enav merot bera" – amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ze sheen mistakkel benashim beshaa sheomdot al hakkevisa.
Hechi dame? i deikka darka achrita – rasha hu! i delekka darka achrita – anus hu! leolam delekka darka achrita, vaafillu hachi – mibbee leh lemenas nafsheh.

Bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi benaa: chaluk shel talmid chacham – ketzad? kol sheen besaro nire mittachtav. tallit shel talmid chacham – ketzad? kol sheen chaluko nire mittachtav tefach. shulchan shel talmid chacham – ketzad? shene shelishe gedil, ushelish gelay – vealav kearot veyarak. vetabbato mibbachutz.
Veha tanya: tabbato mibbifnim! la kashya – ha deikka yanoka, ha delekka yanoka.
Vei baet ema: ha veha delekka yanoka; vela kashya – ha deikka shammaa, ha delekka shammaa.
Vei baet ema: ha veha deikka shammaa; vela kashya – ha bimama, ha belelya.
Mitta shel talmide chachamim – ketzad? kol sheen tachteha ella sandalin bimot hachamma, uminalin bimot haggeshamim. veshel am haaretz – doma leotzar balus.
Berakhot 5a:2-5: Amar rabbi levi bar chama, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, shenneemar: "rigzu veal techetau" im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yaasok battora, shenneemar: "imru vilvavchem". im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yikra keriat shema, shenneemar: "al mishkavchem". im nitztzecho — mutav, veim lav — yizkor lo yom hammita, shenneemar: "vedommu sela".

Veamar rabbi levi bar chama, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, may dichtiv "veettena lecha et luchot haeven vehattora vehammitzva asher katavti lehorotam". "luchot" — ellu aseret haddibberot, "tora" — ze mikra, "vehammitzva" — zo mishna, "asher katavti" — ellu neviim uchetuvim, "lehorotam" — ze talmud, melammed shekkullam nittenu lemoshe missinay.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato, keillu ochez cherev shel shete fiyyot beyado. shenneemar: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam", may mashma? amar mar zutera veittema rav ashe: meresha deinyana, dichtiv: "yalezu chasidim bechavod yerannenu al mishkevotam". uchetiv batreh: "rommot el bigronam vecherev pifiyyot beyadam".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol hakkore keriat shema al mittato — mazzikin bedelin hemennu. shenneemar: "uvene reshef yagbihu uf", veen "uf" ella tora, shenneemar: "hataif enecha bo veenennu". veen "reshef" ella mazzikin, shenneemar: "meze raav ulechume reshef veketev meriri".
Isaiah 43:21-26: Velo-oti karata yaakov ki-yagata bi yisrael

Anochi anochi hu moche feshaecha lemaani vechattotecha lo ezkor
Hazekireni nishshafta yachad sapper atta lemaan titzdak
Isaiah 43:27-44:2: Avicha harishon chata umelitzecha pashu vi

Isaiah 44:14-18: Lichrot-lo arazim vayyikkach tirza veallon vayammetz-lo baatze-yaar nata ore<small>50</small> vegeshem yegaddel

Chetzyo saraf bemo-esh al-chetzyo basar yochel yitzle tzali veyisba af-yachom veyomar heach chammoti raiti ur
Usheerito leel asa lefislo (ysegaved) [yisgod]lo veyishtachu veyitpallel elav veyomar hatztzileni ki eli atta

Isaiah 44:3-7: Ki etztzok-mayim al-tzame venozlim al-yabbasha etztzok ruchi al-zarecha uvirchati al-tzeetzaecha

Ko-amar Adonai melech-yisrael vegoalo Adonai tzevaot ani rishon vaani acharon umibbaladay en elohim
Umi-chamoni yikra veyaggideha veyarecheha li missumi am-olam veotiyyot vaasher tavona yaggidu lamo
Isaiah 44:8-13: Al-tifchadu veal-tirhu halo meaz hishmaticha vehiggadti veattem eday hayesh eloah mibbaladay veen tzor bal-yadati
Yotzre-fesel kullam tohu vachamudehem bal-yoilu veedehem hemma bal-yiru uval-yedu lemaan yevoshu
Mi-yatzar el ufesel nasach levilti hoil
Hen kol-chaverav yevoshu vecharashim hemma meadam yitkabbetzu chullam yaamodu yifchadu yevoshu yachad
Charash barzel maatzad ufaal bappecham uvammakkavot yitztzerehu vayyifalehu bizroa kocho gam-raev veen koach lo-shata mayim vayyiaf
Charash etzim nata kav yetaarehu vassered yaasehu bammaktzuot uvammechuga yetoorehu vayyaasehu ketavnit ish ketiferet adam lashevet bayit
Ketubot 82b:8-13: Hechzira — hare hi kechol hannashim, veen lah ella ketubbatah. hechzira, may ka mashma lan? tenena: hamegaresh et haishsha umachzira, al menat ketubba rishona machzirah!
Mahu detema: ishto hu deihu ketav la ketubba minneh, aval yevimto dela ihu ketav la, hecha degarsha veahdera — ema ketubbeta minneh, ka mashma lan.
Amar rav yehuda: barishona hayu kotvin livtula matayim ulealmana mane, vehayu mazkinin velo hayu nosin nashim, ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetikken, kol nechasav achrain lichtubbatah.

Tanya name hachi: barishona hayu kotvin livtula matayim ulealmana mane, vehayu mazkinin velo hayu nosin nashim. hitkinu sheyyihyu mannichin otah bevet aviha. vaadayin: keshehu koes aleha, omer lah: "lechi etzel ketubbatich",
Hitkinu sheyyihyu mannichin otah bevet chamiha. ashirot osot otah kelatot shel kesef veshel zahav, aniyyot hayu osot otah avit shel meme raglayim.
Vaadayin, keshekkoes aleha omer lah: "teli ketubbatich vatzei". ad shebba shimon ben shatach vetikken, sheyyehe kotev lah: kol nechasay achrain lichtubbatah.
Menachot 99a:5-12: Tanu rabbanan: asara shulchanot asa shelomo, velo hayu mesadderin ella al shel moshe, shenneemar: "veet hashshulchan asher alav lechem happanim zahav".
Eser menorot asa shelomo, velo hayu madlikin ella beshel moshe, shenneemar: "et menorat hazzahav veneroteha levaer baerev".

Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: al kullam hayu mesadderin, shenneemar: "et hashshulchanot vaalehem lechem happanim", uvechullan hayu madlikin, shenneemar: "et hammenorot venerotehem levaaram kammishpat lifne haddevir zahav sagur".

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu mesadderin ella al shel moshe, ella ma ani mekayyem "veet hashshulchanot asher alehem lechem happanim zahav"? ellu shelosha shulchanot shehayu bammikdash: shenayim shehayu beulam mibbifnim lefetach habbayit, echad shel kesef veechad shel zahav.
Al shel kesef noten lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato, shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. echad shel zahav bifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid.
Umena lan deen moridin? amar rabbi: deamar kera: "vayyakem moshe et hammishkan vayyitten et adanav vayyasem et kerashav vayyitten et berichav vayyakem et ammudav".

Umenalan demaalin? amar rabbi acha bar yaakov: deamar kera "et machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam veasu otam rikkue fachim tzippuy lammizbeach ki hikrivum lifne Adonai vayyikdashu veyihyu leot livne yisrael" – battechilla tashmishe mizbeach, veachshav gufo shel mizbeach.

"Asher shibbarta vesamtam baaron" – tane rav yosef: melammed shehalluchot veshivre luchot munnachin baaron. mikkan letalmid chacham sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso, sheen nohagin bo minhag bizzayon.
Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:10: Mochin shehakkoves motzi, hare ellu shello. veshehassorek motzi, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. hakkoves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello. yater mikken, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. im haya hashshachor al gabbe hallavan, notel et hakkol vehen shello. hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede litpor bo, umatlit shehi shalosh al shalosh, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. ma shehecharash motzi vammaatzad, hare ellu shello, uvakkashshil, shel baal habbayit. veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit, af hannesoret shel baal habbayit:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:1-3:
Shenayim ochazin betallit, ze omer ani metzatiha veze omer ani metzatiha, ze omer kullah shelli veze omer kullah shelli, ze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veyachaloku. ze omer kullah shelli veze omer chetzyah shelli, haomer kullah shelli, yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mishshelosha chalakim, vehaomer chetzyah shelli, yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mervia. ze notel shelosha chalakim, veze notel revia: 
Hayu shenayim rochvin al gabbe vehema, o shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig, ze omer kullah shelli, veze omer kullah shelli, ze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veze yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah, veyachaloku. bizman shehem modim o sheyyesh lahen edim, cholkim belo shevua: 
Haya rochev al gabbe vehema veraa et hammetzia, veamar lachavero teneha li, netalah veamar ani zachiti vah, zacha vah. im mishshennetanah lo amar ani zachiti vah techilla, lo amar kelum:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:4-8:
Raa et hammetzia venafal aleha, uva acher vehechezik bah, ze shehechezik bah zacha vah. raa otan ratzin achar metzia, achar tzevi shavur, achar gozalot shello farchu, veamar zachta li sadi, zachta lo. haya tzevi ratz kedarko, o shehayu gozalot mafrichin, veamar zachta li sadi, lo amar kelum: 
Metziat beno uvitto hakketannim, metziat avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim, metziat ishto, hare ellu shello. metziat beno uvitto haggedolim, metziat avdo veshifchato haivrim, metziat ishto sheggershah, af al pi shello natan ketubbatah, hare ellu shellahen: 
Matza shetare chov, im yesh bahen acharayut nechasim, lo yachazir, shebbet din nifrain mehen, en bahen acharayut nechasim, yachazir, sheen bet din nifrain mehen, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben kach uven kach lo yachazir, mippene shebbet din nifrain mehen: 
Matza gitte nashim, veshichrure avadim, deyateke, mattana veshovrim, hare ze lo yachazir, sheani omer ketuvim hayu venimlach alehem shello littenam: 
Matza iggerot shum veiggerot mazon, shetare chalitza umeunin, ushetare verurin, vechol maase vet din, hare ze yachazir. matza vachafisa o vidluskema, tachrich shel shetarot, o agudda shel shetarot, hare ze yachazir. vechamma agudda shel shetarot, shelosha keshurin ze vaze. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, echad hallove mishshelosha, yachazir lallove, shelosha hallovin meechad, yachazir lammalve. matza shetar ben shetarotav veeno yodea ma tivo, yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. im yesh immahen simponot, yaase ma shebbassimponot:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:1-4: Ellu metziot shello, veellu chayyav lehacheriz. ellu metziot shello, matza ferot mefuzzarin, maot mefuzzarot, kerichot birshut harabbim, veiggule devela, kikkarot shel nachtom, macharozot shel dagim, vachatichot shel basar, vegizze tzemer habbaot mimmedinatan, vaanitze fishtan, uleshonot shel argaman, hare ellu shello, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, kol sheyyesh bo shinnuy, chayyav lehacheriz. ketzad. matza iggul uvetocho cheres, kikkar uvetocho maot. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, kol kele enporya eno chayyav lehacheriz:

Veelu chayyav lehacheriz, matza ferot bichli o cheli kemot shehu, maot bechis o chis kemot shehu, tzibbure ferot, tzibbure maot, shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze, kerichot birshut hayyachid, vechikkarot shel baal habbayit, vegizze tzemer hallekuchot mibbet haumman, kadde yayin vechadde shemen, hare ellu chayyav lehacheriz:

Matza achar haggappa o achar haggader gozalot mekushsharin, o vishvilin shebbassadot, hare ze lo yigga bahen. matza cheli baashpa, im mechusse, lo yigga bo, im megulle, notel umachriz. matza vegal o vechotel yashan, hare ellu shello. matza vechotel chadash, mechetzyo velachutz, shello, mechetzyo velifnim, shel baal habbayit. im haya maskiro laacherim, afillu vetoch habbayit, hare ellu shello:

Matza vachanut, hare ellu shello. ben hatteva velachenvani, shel chenvani. lifne shulchani, hare ellu shello. ben hakkisse velashshulchani, hare ellu lashshulchani. hallokeach perot mechavero o sheshshalach lo chavero perot, umatza vahen maot, hare ellu shello. im hayu tzerurin, notel umachriz:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:5-8: Af hassimla hayta vichlal kol elle. lamma yatzat. lehakkish eleha, lomar lecha, ma simla meyuchedet sheyyesh bah simanim veyesh lah tovim, af kol davar sheyyesh bo simanim veyesh lo tovim, chayyav lehacheriz:

Vead matay chayyav lehacheriz. ad kede sheyyedu vo shechenav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shalosh regalim, veachar haregel haacharon shiva yamim, kede sheyyelech leveto shelosha veyachazor shelosha veyachriz yom echad:

Amar et haaveda velo amar simaneha, lo yitten lo. veharammay, af al pi sheamar simaneha, lo yitten lo, shenneemar (Devarim 22) ad derosh achicha oto, ad shettidrosh et achicha im rammay hu im eno rammay. kol davar sheose veochel, yaase veyochal. vedavar sheen ose veochel, yimmacher, shenneemar (sham) vahashevoto lo, ree heach teshivennu lo. ma yehe vaddamim. rabbi tarfon omer, yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu chayyav beacharayutan. rabbi akiva omer, lo yishtammesh bahen, lefichach im avdu eno chayyav beacharayutan:

Matza sefarim, kore vahen achat lishloshim yom. veim eno yodea likrot, gollan. aval lo yilmod bahen battechilla, velo yikra acher immo. matza chesut, menaarah achat lishloshim yom. veshotchah letzarkah, aval lo lichvodo. kele chesef uchele nechoshet, mishtammesh bahen letzarkan, aval lo leshochokan. kele zahav uchele zechuchit, lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. matza sak o kuppa, vechol davar sheen darko littol, hare ze lo yittol:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:9-3:2: Ezo hi aveda, matza chamor o fara roin badderech, en zo aveda. chamor vechelav hafuchin, para ratza ben hakkeramim, hare zo aveda. hechezirah uvarcha, hechezirah uvarcha, afilu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav lehachazirah, shenneemar (Devarim 22) hashev teshivem. haya vatel missela, lo yomar lo ten li sela, ella noten lo secharo kefoel batel. im yesh sham bet din, matne bifne vet din. im en sham bet din, bifne mi yatne, shello kodem:

Metzaah barefet, eno chayyav bah. birshut harabbim, chayyav bah. veim hayta vet hakkevarot, lo yittamma lah. im amar lo aviv, hittamme, o sheamar lo, al tachazir, lo yishma lo. parak vetaan, parak vetaan, afillu arbaa vachamishsha feamim, chayyav, shenneemar (Shemot 23) azov taazov. halach veyashav lo veamar, hoil vealecha mitzva, im retzoncha lifrok perok, patur, shenneemar, immo. im haya zaken o chole, chayyav. mitzva min hattora lifrok, aval lo liton. rabbi shimon omer, af liton. rabbi yose haggelili omer, im haya alav yater al massao, en zakuk lo, shenneemar, tachat massao, masseoy sheyyachol laamod bo:

Avedato vaavedat aviv, avedato kodemet. avedato vaavedat rabbo, shello kodemet. avedat aviv vaavedat rabbo, shel rabbo kodemet, sheaviv hevio laolam hazze, verabbo shellimmedo chachma mevio lechayye haolam habba. veim aviv chacham, shel aviv kodemet. haya aviv verabbo nosin masseoy, meniach et shel rabbo. veachar kach meniach et shel aviv. haya aviv verabbo bevet hashshevi, pode et rabbo, veachar kach pode et aviv. veim haya aviv chacham, pode et aviv, veachar kach pode et rabbo:

Hammafkid etzel chavero behema o chelim, venignevu o sheavdu, shillem velo ratza lishshava, shehare amru shomer chinnam nishba veyotze, nimtza haggannav, meshallem tashlume chefel. tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem, lemi shehappikkadon etzlo. nishba velo ratza leshallem, nimtza haggannav, meshallem tashlume chefel, tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. lemi meshallem, levaal happikkadon:

Hassocher para mechavero vehishilah leacher, umeta chedarka, yishshava hassocher shemmeta chedarka, vehashshoel yeshallem lassocher. amar rabbi yose, ketzad halla ose sechora befarato shel chavero, ella tachazor para labbealim:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:3-6:
Amar lishnayim, gazalti leechad mikkem mane, veeni yodea eze mikkem, o, aviv shel echad mikkem hifkid li mane, veeni yodea eze hu, noten laze mane velaze mane, shehoda mippi atzmo: 
Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad, ze mane veze matayim, ze omer shelli matayim veze omer shelli matayim, noten laze mane velaze mane, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. amar rabbi yose, im ken ma hifsid harammay. ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu: 
Vechen shene chelim, echad yafe mane veechad yafe elef zuz, ze omer yafe shelli veze omer yafe shelli, noten et hakkatan leechad mehen, umittoch haggadol noten deme katan lashsheni, vehashshear yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. amar rabbi yose, im ken ma hifsid harammay. ella hakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu: 
Hammafkid perot etzel chavero, afillu hen avudin lo yigga bahen. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, mochran bifne vet din, mippene shehu chemeshiv aveda labbealim:
Mishnah Bikkurim 1:1-5:
Yesh meviin bikkurim vekorin, meviin velo korin, veyesh sheenan meviin. ellu sheenan meviin, hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shel yachid o shel rabbim, vechen hammavrich mittoch shel yachid o mittoch shel rabbim letoch shello. hannotea letoch shello vehivrich letoch shello, vederech hayyachid vederech harabbim baemtza, hare ze eno mevi. rabbi yehuda omer, kaze mevi: 
Meeze taam eno mevi, mishshum shenneemar, reshit bikkure admatcha (Shemot 23), ad sheyyehu chol haggiddulin meadmatcha. haarisin vehechachorot vehassikkarikon vehaggazlan, en meviin meoto hattaam, mishshum shenneemar, reshit bikkure admatcha: 
En meviin bikkurim chutz mishshivat hamminim. lo mittemarim shebbeharim, velo mipperot shebbaamakim, velo mizzete shemen sheenam min hammuvchar. en meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret. anshe har tzevoim heviu vikkurehem kodem laatzeret, velo kibbelu mehem, mippene hakkatuv shebbattora (Shemot 23) vechag hakkatzir bikkure maasecha asher tizra bassade: 
Ellu meviin velo korin, hagger mevi veeno kore, sheeno yachol lomar asher nishba Adonai laavotenu latet lanu (Devarim 26:3). veim hayta immo miyyisrael, mevi vekore. ucheshehu mitpallel beno leven atzmo, omer, elohe avot yisrael. ucheshehu vevet hakkeneset, omer, elohe avotechem. veim hayta immo miyyisrael, omer, elohe avotenu: 
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, ishsha vat gerim lo tinnase lakkehunna, ad shettehe immah miyyisrael. echad gerim veechad avadim meshuchrarim, vaafillu ad asara dorot, ad shettehe imman miyyisrael. haappotroppos vehashshaliach vehaeved vehaishsha vetumtum veanderoginos, meviin velo korin, sheenan yecholin lomar (Devarim 26:10) asher natatta li Adonai:
Mishnah Kelim 24:16-25:3:
Shalosh sevachot hen. shel yalda, temea tumat midras. shel zekena, temea teme met. veshel yotzet lachutz, tehora mikkelum:  
Shalosh kuppot hen. mehuha shettelayah al habberiyya, holchin achar habberiyya. ketanna al haggedola, holchin achar haggedola. hayu shavot, holchin achar happenimit. rabbi shimon omer, kaf moznayim shettelayah al shule hammecham, mibbifnim, tame. mibbachutz, tahor. telayah al tziddah, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz, tahor:  
Kol hakkelim yesh lahem achorayim vatoch, kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartzufin, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kol sheyyesh lo tovrot, yesh lo achorayim vatoch. vechol sheen lo tovrot, en lo achorayim vatoch. hashshulchan vehaddelufki, yesh lahem achorayim vatoch, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, en lahem achorayim. vechen tavla sheen lah lizbez: 
Hammardea yesh lo achorayim vatoch, mishshiva lacharchur, mearbaa laddarvan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, en lahem, lo huzkeru arbaa veshiva ella lashsheyarim: 
Middot yayin vashemen, vezoma listera, umesannenet shel chardal, umeshammeret shel yayin, yesh lahen achorayim vatoch, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, en lahem. rabbi shimon omer, yesh lahem. nitmeu meachorehen, ma shebbetochan tahor, vetzarich lehatebil:
Mishnah Kelim 25:4-7:
Harova vachatzi harova, nitma harova, lo nitma chatzi harova. nitma chatzi harova, lo nitma harova. amru lifne rabbi akiva, hoil vachatzi harova achorayim larova, keli shennitma tocho lo nitmeu achorav. amar lahen, shel kat kodmin hi, o shemma harova achorayim lachatzi harova, keli shennitmeu achorav, lo nitma tocho: 
Nitma harova, harova vaachorav temein, chatzi harova vaachorav tehorin. nitma chatzi harova, chatzi harova vaachorav temein, harova vaachorav tehorin. nitmeu achore harova, achore chatzi harova tehorin, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, en cholkin et haggabbayin. ucheshehu matbil, matbil et kullo: 
Kanne chelim, veognehem, veaznehem, vidot hakkelim hamekabbelim, shennaflu alehen mashkin, menaggevan vehem tehorim. ushear kol hakkelim (sheenam yecholin lekabbel rimmonim), sheen lahem achorayim vatoch, shennaflu mashkin al miktzato, kullo tame. keli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin, achorav temeim, tocho veogno veazno veyadav tehorin. nitma tocho, kullo tame: 
Kol hakkelim yesh lahen achorayim vatoch, veyesh lahem bet tzevia. rabbi tarfon omer, laareva gedola shel etz. rabbi akiva omer, lechosot. rabbi meir omer, leyadayim hattemeot vehattehorot. amar rabbi yose, lo amru ella leyadayim hattehorot bilvad:
Mishnah Kelim 25:8-26:2:
Ketzad. hayu yadav tehorot vaachore hakkos temeim, achazo bevet tzeviato, eno choshesh shemma nitmeu yadav baachore hakkos. haya shote vechos sheachorav temeim, eno choshesh shemma nitma hammashke shebbefiv baachore hakkos vechazar vetimme hakkos. kumkum shehu martiach, eno choshesh shemma yatzu mashkin mittocho venagu vaachorav vechazru letocho: 
Kele hakkodesh en lahem achorayim vatoch, veen lahem bet tzevia. veen matbilim kelim vetoch kelim lekodesh. kol hakkelim yordin lide tumatan bemachashava, veenan olim mide tumatan ella veshinnuy maase, shehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase umiyyad machashava, umachashava enah mevattelet lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machashava: 
Sandal imki, vechis shel shenatzot, rabbi yehuda omer, af kefifa mitzrit, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af sandal ladiki kayyotze vahen, hare ellu mittammein umittaharin shello veumman. amar rabbi yose, vahalo chol hakkelim mittammein umittaharin shello veumman. aval ellu, af al pi shehen muttarin, temein, shehahedyot yachol lehachaziram. lo amru ella vichfifa mitzrit, sheaf haumman eno yachol lehachazirah: 
Kis shel shenatzot shennittelu shenatzav, tame. nifshat, tahor. tala alav et hammatlet millemattan, tame. kis letoch kis, shennitma achad mehen bemashke, lo nitma chavero. tzeror hammargalit, tame. tzeror hammaot, rabbi eliezer metamme, vachachamim metaharim:
Mishnah Kelim 26:3-7:
Kaf lokte kotzim, tehora. hazzon vehabbirkeyar, temein. vehashsharvulim, temein. vehapperaklimin, tehorin. vechol bet etzbaot, tehorot, chutz mishshel kayyatzin, mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog. nikrea, im enah mekabbelet et rov haog, tehora: 
Sandal shennifseka achat meaznav vetikkenah, tame midras. nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah, tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennifseka sheniyya, tehora. nifsak akevo, nittal chotmo, o shennechelak lishnayim, tahor. solyam shennifsak mikkol makom, tahor. minal shennifchat, im eno mekabbel et rov haregel, tahor. minal sheal haemum, rabbi eliezer metaher, vachachamim metammeim. kol chamatot tzerurot, tehorot, chutz mishshel arviyyin. rabbi meir omer, tzeror shaa, tehorot. tzeror olam, temeot. rabbi yose omer, kol chamatot tzerurot, tehorot: 
Ellu orot temein midras, or shechishshav alav leshatiach, or sekorteya, or katavolya, or hachammar, or hakkattan, or hakkattaf, or harofe, or haarisa, or hallev shel katan, or hakkar, or hakkeset, midras. or hassarok, or hassorek, rabbi eliezer omer, midras. vachachamim omrim, teme met: 
Av kesut, vetachrich kesut, midras. av argaman, vetachrich argaman, bet shammay omrim, midras. uvet hillel omrim, teme met. or sheasao chippuy lichli, tahor. lemishkalot, tame. rabbi yose metaher mishshum aviv: 
Kol makom sheen chesron melacha, machashava metammetan. vechol makom sheyyesh chesron melacha, en machashava metammetan, ella hautzba:
Mishnah Kelim 26:8-27:2:
Orot baal habbayit, machashava metammetan. veshel abbedan, en machashava metammetan. veshel gannav, machashava metammetan. veshel gazlan, en machashava metammetan. rabbi shimon omer, chilluf haddevarim, shel gazlan, machashava metammetan. veshel gannav, en machashava metammetan, mippene shello nityaashu habbealim: 
Or shehu tame midras, vechishshav alav lirtzuot ulesandalin, kevan shennatan bo et haizmel, tahor, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyemaatennu fachot mechamishsha tefachim. rabbi elazar bar rabbi tzadok omer, af haose mitpachat min haor, temea. umin hakkeset, tehora: 
Habbeged mittamme mishshum chamishsha shemot. hassak, mishshum arbaa. haor, mishshum shelosha. haetz, mishshum shenayim. ucheli cheres, mishshum echad. keli cheres mittamme mishshum keli kibbul. kol sheen lo toch bichle cheres, en lo achorayim. musaf alav haetz, shehu mittamme mishshum moshav. vechen tavla sheen lah lizbez, bichle etz, temea, uvichle cheres, tehora. musaf alav haor, shehu mittamme mishshum ohalim. musaf alav hassak, shehu mittamme mishshum arig. musaf alav habbeged, shehu mittamme mishshum shalosh al shalosh: 
Habbeged mittamme mishshum shelosha al shelosha, lemidras, umishshum shalosh al shalosh litme met. hassak arbaa al arbaa, haor chamishsha al chamishsha, mappatz shishsha al shishsha, shavin lemidras velitme met. rabbi meir omer, hassak sheyarav arbaa, utechillato mishsheyyiggamer:
Mishnah Kelim 27:3-6:
Haose shenayim min habbeged veechad min hassak, shelashtan min hassak veechad min haor, arbaa min haor veechad min hammappatz, tahor. chamishsha min hammappatz veechad min haor, arbaa min haor veechad min hassak, shelosha min hassak veechad min habbeged, tame. ze hakkelal, kol shechibber lo min hechamur mimmennu, tame. min hakkal mimmennu, tahor: 
Hamekatztzea mikkullam tefach al tefach, tame. mishshule hakkuppa tefach al tefach, tame. mitztzedade hakkuppa, rabbi shimon metaher. vachachamim omrim, hamekatztzea tefach al tefach bechol makom, tame: 
Beloye nafa uchevara shehitkinan lishiva, rabbi akiva metamme, vachachamim metaharin ad sheyyekatztzea. kisse shel katan sheyyesh lo raglayim, af al pi sheen bo gavoah tefach, tame. chaluk shel katan, rabbi eliezer omer, kol shehu. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye vo chashshiur, venimdad kaful: 
Ellu nimdadin kefulin. ampalya, ufemolinya, umichnasayim, vechova, vechis shel pundiyya. umatlit shettelayah al hassafa, im peshuta, nimdedet peshuta, veim kefula, nimdedet kefula:
Mishnah Orlah 2:10-13:
Tevalin, shenayim ushelosha shemot mimmin echad, o mishshelosha, asur, umitztarfin. rabbi shimon omer, shenayim ushelosha shemot mimmin echad, o shene minin mishshem echad, enan mitztarfin: 
Seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch issa, lo baze chede lechammetz velo baze chede lechammetz, nitztarfu vechimmetzu, rabbi eliezer omer, achar haacharon ani va. vachachamim omrim, ben shennafal issur battechilla, ben bassof, leolam eno oser ad sheyyehe bo chede lechammetz: 
Yoezer ish habbira haya mittalmide bet shammay, veamar, shaalti et rabban gamliel hazzaken omed beshaar hammizrach, veamar, leolam eno oser, ad sheyyehe bo chede lechammetz: 
Kelim shessachan beshemen tame, vechazar vesachan beshemen tahor, o shessachan beshemen tahor, vechazar vesachan beshemen tame, rabbi eliezer omer, achar harishon ani ba. vachachamim omrim, achar haacharon:
Mishnah Orlah 2:14-3:1:
Seor shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu letoch issa, lo vaze chede lechammetz velo vaze chede lechammetz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim: 
Tevalin shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem shennaflu bakkedera, lo vaelu chede letabbel velo vaellu chede letabbel, venitztarfu vetibbelu, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim: 
Chaticha shel kadshe kadashim, shel piggul, veshel notar, shennitbashshelu im hachatichot, asur lezarim umuttar lakkohanim. rabbi shimon mattir lezarim velakkohanim: 
Besar kadshe kadashim uvesar kadashim kallim shennitbashshelu im besar hattaava, asur litmeim umuttar lithorim: 
Beged shetztzevao viklippe arla, yiddalek. nitarev baacherim, kullam yiddaleku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaale beechad umatayim:
Mishnah Orlah 2:6-9:
Ulema amru kol hamechammetz vehametabbel vehamedammea lehachamir, min bemino. lehakel ulehachamir, min besheeno mino. ketzad, seor shel chittim shennafal letoch issat chittim, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, ben sheyyesh bo laalot beechad umea uven sheen bo laalot beechad umea, asur. en bo laalot bemea veechad, ben sheyyesh bo chede lechammetz, ben sheen bo chede lechammetz, asur: 
Lehakel ulehachamir min besheeno mino, ketzad. kegon gerisin shennitbashshelu im adashim, veyesh bahem benoten taam, ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea, uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea, asur. en bahem benoten taam, ben sheyyesh bahem laalot beechad umea, uven sheen bahem laalot beechad umea, muttar: 
Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa, veyesh bo kede lechammetz, veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma, o seor shel kile hakkerem, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, asur: 
Seor shel chullin shennafal letoch issa vechimmetzah, veachar kach nafal seor shel teruma o seor shel kile hakkerem, veyesh bo chede lechammetz, asur. rabbi shimon mattir:
Mishnah Orlah 3:2-5: Hatztzovea melo hassit biklippe arla, vaarago veveged, veen yadua eze hu, rabbi meir omer, yiddalek habbeged. vachachamim omrim, yaale veechad umatayim:
Haoreg melo hassit mitztzemer habbechor beveged, yiddalek habbeged. umissear hannazir umippeter chamor besak, yiddalek hassak. uvemukdashin, mekaddeshin kol shehen:
Tavshil shebbishshelo viklippe arla, yiddalek. nitarev baacherim, yaale beechad umatayim:
Tannur shehissikuhu viklippe arla veafa vo et happat, tiddalek happat. nitarva vaacherot, taale beechad umatayim:
Mishnah Orlah 3:6-9: Mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem, yiddaleku. nitarvu vaacherim, kullam yiddaleku, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yaalu beechad umatayim:

Shehaya rabbi meir omer, et sheddarko limmanot, mekaddesh. vachachamim omrim, eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad. verabbi akiva omer, shiva. veellu hem, egoze ferech, rimmone vadan, vechaviyyot setumot, vechulfot teradin, vekulse cheruv, udelaat yevanit. rabbi akiva omer, af kikkarot shel baal habbayit. harauy learla, arla. lechile hakkerem, kile hakkarem:
Ketzad. nitpatztzeu haegozim, nitpardu harimmonim, nitpattechu hechaviyyot, nitchattechu haddeluim, nitparsu hakkikkarot, yaalu beechad umatayim:

Sefek arla, beeretz yisrael asur, uvesureya muttar, uvechutza laaretz yored velokeach, uvilvad shello yirennu loket. kerem natua yarak, veyarak nimkar chutza lo, beeretz yisrael asur, uvesureya muttar, uvechutza laaretz yored veloket, uvilvad shello yilkot bayyad. hechadash, asur min hattora bechol makom. vehaarla, halacha. vehakkilayim, middivre sofrim:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 6:21-22: Nachri shehevi chafatzav beshabbat vehichnisan levet yisrael muttar. vaafillu amar lo hannichan bezavit zo hare ze muttar. umezammenin et hannachri beshabbat venotnin lefanav mezonot leachlan. veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo mippene sheen shevitato alenu. vechen notnin mezonot lifne hakkelev bechatzer veim netalan veyatza en nizkakin lo:

Mi shehaya ba badderech vekadash alav hayyom vehayu immo maot noten kiso lenachri leholicho lo ulemotzae shabbat lokcho mimmennu. veaf al pi shello natan lo sachar al ze. veaf al pi shennetano lo mishshechashecha muttar mippene sheadam bahul al mamono vei efshar sheyyashlichennu. veim lo tattir lo davar ze sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim yavo lahavio beyado veover al melacha shel tora. bamme devarim amurim bechiso aval metzia lo yitten lannachri ella molichah befachot pachot mearba ammot:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1:1: Kol hakkarbanot shel mine nefesh chayya bain mechamishsha minin bilvad. min habbakar umin hakkevasim umin haizzim umin hattorim umin bene hayyona:
Vechol hakkarbanot ben shel tzibbur ben shel yachid arbaa minin. ola. vechattat. veasham. ushelamim:
Veod yesh sham shelosha mine karban yachid vehem happesach. vehabbechor. vehammaaser:

Kol karbanot hatztzibbur hen ola o chattat. veen bekarbenot hatztzibbur shelamim chutz mishshene kevasim habbaim im lechem hattenufa baatzeret. vehem hannikraim zivche shalme tzibbur. veen hatztzibbur makrivin asham leolam velo of:

Hashshelamim baim min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar mizzecharim uminnekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim. veen haof ba shelamim. hakketannim hem mibben shemonat yamim ad shana temima miyyom leyom. im nitabbera shana nitabbera lo. vehaggedolim babbakar ad shalosh shanim shelemot miyyom leyom. uvatztzon ad shete shanim shelemot miyyom leyom. yoter al ze hare hu zaken veen makrivin oto:

Af al pi shekkol hakkarbanot kesherin miyyom hashshemini vahala en makrivin lechattechilla ella miyyom sheloshim vahala. chutz min habbechor umin happesach umin hammaaser sheim ratza lehakerivan bashshemini lechattechilla makriv:

Shaot monin lekadashim. veim hosifu shaa achat o pachatu shaa pesulin. ketzad. karban shemmitzvato lihyot ben shana im hosif al hashshana shaa achat nifsal. afillu haya ben shana bishat shechita vehosif al hashshana bishat zerika nifsal ad sheyyihye ben shana ad sheat zerika. vechen bechol hazzevachim:

Kol makom shenneemar battora keves o kavsa o kevasim hare ellu bene shana. vechol makom shenneemar ayil o elim hem hazzecharim bene shenatayim. umeematay yikkare ayil mishsheyyikkanes beshana sheniyya echad usheloshim yom. aval beyom sheloshim eno kasher lo lecheves velo laayil vehu hannikra pilgas. vechol makom shenneemar bo egel hare ze ben shana. par ben shetayim. seir izzim [ben shana. sair] ben shetayim. kol shana sheniyya hu nikra sair:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1:5: Karbenot hatztzibbur hem shene temidin shel kol yom. umusefe shabbatot verashe chodashim vehammoadot useir chattat shel yom hakkippurim. vechen im shaggu bet din vehoru baavoda zara mevi kol shevet veshevet par vesair. happar ola vehassair chattat. veellu hasseirim hem hannikraim seire avoda zara. veim shaggu vehoru bishar hammitzvot meviin par lechattat vehu hannikra par helem davar shel tzibbur:

Karbenot hayyachid hem habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach. vehachagiga vehi shelamim. vehariyya vehi olot. vekarban hagger vehu ola min habbehema. o shene bene yona o shete torim ushenehen ola. o shete behemot achat ola veachat shelamim. vehannoder o hammitnaddev ola o shelamim. ushelamim habbain im hallechem hem hannikraim toda. vechen karbenot hannazir vehen ola vechattat ushelamim. vekarbenot metzora vehen chattat veasham veola. vekarbenot zavim veyoldot vehen chattat veola. vekarban hashshogeg bemitzvat lo taase sheyyesh bah karet vehu chattat. veim nistappek lo im asa o lo asa oto hachote mevi asham vehu hannikra asham taluy. veyesh averot shemmevi alehen asham vehu hannikra asham vadday. vechen el haola ufar hachattat shemmakriv kohen gadol mishshello beyom hakkippurim hare hen karban yachid. ufar ze hu hannikra par yom hakkippurim. vechol ellu hakkarbanot meforashin hen battora vechol echad mehen yitbaaru dinav bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 1:7: Kol karbenot hayyachid chayyav beacharayutan uveacharayut niskehen chutz min hannedava. vechol karbenot hatztzibbur enan chayyavin beacharayutan velo beacharayut niskehen. veim karav hazzevach chayyavin beacharayut niskehem. vekarban yachid shekkavua lo zeman hare hu kekarban tzibbur veeno chayyav beacharayuto:
Kol olat behema enah baa ella min hazzecharim bilvad. vehi baa min hakkevasim umin haizzim umin habbakar ben gedolim ben ketannim. umin hattorim uvene yona veechad bahen hazzachar vehannekeva:
Hachattat baa mechameshet hamminim haellu min hazzecharim umin hannekevot min haggedolim umin hakketannim:
Haasham eno ba ella mizzichre kevasim bilvad. yesh asham ba miggedole min ze veyesh asham ba min hakketannim:
Niddah 20a:4-6: Shachor — kecheret. amar rabba bar rav huna: cheret sheamru — deyo. tanya name hachi: shachor kecheret, veshachor sheamru — deyo. velema deyo! i amar deyo — hava amena ki fichchuta didyota, ka mashma lan ki charuta didyota.
Ibbaya lehu: belacha o beyabbishta? ta shema: derabbi amme pale kureta didyota uvadek be.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kekir, kidyo ucheenav — temea, vezohi sheshshaninu: "amok mikken — temea". amar rabbi elazar: kezayit, kezefet ucheorev — tahor, vezohi sheshshaninu: "dehe mikken — tahor".

Shabbat 155b:8-12: Amar lecha rav yehuda: leolam "mehalektin" desafe leh bideh, "malkitin" deshade leh kammayyhu, udeka kashya lach yone shovach veyone aliyyay lemishde kammayyhu name la? hane mezonotan alecha, vehane en mezonotan alecha. kidtanya: notnin mezonot lifne chelev, veen notnin mezonot lifne chazir. uma hefresh ben ze laze? ze mezonotav alecha, veze en mezonotav alecha.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, en notnin mayim lifne devorim velifne yonim shebbashshovach, aval notnin lifne avozin velifne tarnegolin velifne yone haredisayot. may tama? lav mishshum dehane mezonotan alecha, vehane en mezonotan alecha.
Velitamaych, may irya mayya? afillu chitte useare name la! ella, shane mayya dishchichi beagma.

Derash rabbi yona appitcha deve nesia: may dichtiv "yodea tzaddik din dallim" — yodea hakkadosh baruch hu bakkelev shemmezonotav muatin, lefichach shoha achilato bemeav shelosha yamim. keditnan: kamma tishhe achilato bemeav vihe tame — bakkelev shelosha yamim meet leet, uvaofot uvaddagim kede shettippol laur vetissaref.

Amar rav hamenuna: shema minna orach ara lemishde umetza lechalba. vechamma? amar rav mari: meshach udeneh, vechutera abbatreh. hane mille bedavra, aval bemata la, deate lemisrach. amar rav pappa: let deani mikkalba, velet deattir mechazira.
Zohar, Vayikra 3: Raya mehemna patach veamar bati leganni achoti challa, ihi malchut, adonay. ariti mori, da chesed, darga deavraham, deittemar aleh elech li el har hammor. im besami, da netztzach, darga deaharon, dichtiv beh (Shemot 30:23) veatta kach lecha besamim rosh. veinnun deroa yemina, beyarcha yemina. veraza demilla, (Tehillim 16:11) neimot bimincha netztzach. veinnun teren birkan lokovleh, chad magen avraham, vtinyayna avoda, dehu retztze.

Achalti yari, da gevura pachad yitztzechak. im divshi hod, darga dedavd, vehayeynu deroa semala, im yarcha semala. shatiti yeni im chalavi, guf uverit, yaakov im shelomo. levatar ichlu reim shetu vshichru dodim, 12 shevatim, 14 birchan. tosefet birkat hamminin, man achil lah, hahu deittemar beh bati leganni achoti chala.

Veit defalig lon beraza ochora, ariti mori im besami, guf uverit, yari im divshi, shoka yemina im semala. yeni im chalavi, deroa semala bimina, deinnun yini gevura, chalavi chesed. (ad kan raya mehemana)

Ribbi yehuda amar, ichlu reim shetu vshichru dodim, illen kol mare divava vilala, deitbesamu kullehu veitberachu kachada. deha misseudata demalka mithanyayn kolla. veematay achle kullehu. beshaata demalka (sefer acher ateacheday) ate chade. veal da malka itchade, vechadde lematronita bekadmita, levatar kullehu achlan vechaddan.

Ribbi abba amar, ichlu reim shetu veshichru dodim, illen innun shit dekamran, veillen innun dichtiv behu, (Shir hashshirim 1:4) hviani hammelech chadarav vegomer. shetu veshichru, mehahu yayin deravvi lecholla. ribbi elazar amar, kol innun diltatta, dechevan deinnun shit itbarchan, kullehu diltatta mitbarchan.

Ribbi shimon amar, kolla shappir, aval raza demilla, ichlu reim leella, shetu veshichru dodim letatta. amar leh ribbi elazar, man innun leella, uman innun letatta. amar leh yaut shailta, da atar illaa deinnun beachaduta bechedvavta dela mitparshan lealmin, illen ikrun reim. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden, veeden vehahu nahar la mitparshan lealmin, veishtechachu lealmin biruta beachaduta bechedvavta. shetu veshichru dodim, illen innun letatta, deikrun dodim, lezimnin yedian veha okimna.

Ta chaze beinnun illae ketiv behu achila bela shetiyya. may tama. man deit leh garbe dechamra, achila baya. uvegin detaman sharya chamra demintera, ketiv behu achila. uveinnun tattae devayayn shakyu, ketiv behu shetiyya, deha kol netian shakyu bayayn minnachala deamika. veal da, beillen achila, uveillen shetiyya. illen reim veillen dodim.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, itchaze deha dodim chavivuta innun, amay innun tattae. amar leh, innun detaavin da leda, vela mishtakkechin tadir, ikru dodim. veinnun demishtakkeche tadir, vela mitkasseyayn vela mitparshan da min da, ikru reim. veal da, illen dodim, veillen reim, illen biruta beachaduta tadir, veillen betiuveta lezimnin. veda hu shelemuta decholla, begin detitbarcha keneset yisrael, ucheden chedvavta bechullehu almin.
Ribbi chizkiyya okim hay kera bekarbenin, begin deinnun seudata demalka, lekarba kammeh, umithanyayn mineh marehon dedinin, umitbasseman kullehu, veishtechach chedvavta becholla.

Ribbi acha okim hay kera, beshaata dealat shechinta lemashkena, deishtechachu birchan vechedvavn becholla, vealat shechinta kechalla lachuppa, ucheden ishtelimu ishtekachu yisrael letatta, veitachadu beh bekudesha berich hu beara. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash vshachanti betocham, ucheden illae vetattae itbessamu.
Zohar, Vayikra 61: Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, o hoda elav chattato asher chata. hoda elav, missitra deman, o yada (nusach acher noda) chattato mibbae leh, mahu hoda elav. ella kudesha berich hu pakid lichneset yisrael, leodaa leh levar nash, hahu chova dehu chav, uvamma muda leh, bedinaha. kema deat amer (iyyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. hoda elav, keman defakid leochora.

Detaninan beshaata debar nash chav kame kudesha berich hu, vela ashgach bachataeh leahadra betiyyuveta kame mareh, vashde leh batar kitfeh, nishmateh mammash salkat veashidat kame kudesha berich hu. keden, pakid malka lichneset yisrael, veamar o hoda elav chattato asher chata, oshit dina aleh, veoda leh choveh, kema deat amer (yechezkel 16:2) hoda et yerushala 40 et toavoteha.

Batar demate aleh dina, keden ittear rucha lemehadar betiyyuveta kame mareh, veitkanna lemikrav karbena, deha man delibbeh gas beh, chate, veanshe chataeh, vela ashgach aleh, vekudesha berich hu zammin lokovleh, ufakid leodaa leh lehahu chova, begin dela yitneshe minneh.

Amar ribbi yose, hachi hu vday (sefer acher menalan dehachi) vehachi ashkachna bedavid, dechevan deavad hahu ovada devat sheva, la ashgach beh. amar leh kudesha berich hu, at anshit leh, ana adkarna lach. miyyad ma ketiv, (Shmuel b 12:7) atta haish ko amar Adonai, atta haish dela dacharit leh, atta haish deanshit leh, uvemma oda leh bedina.

Uf hacha, kudesha berich hu kaamar, hoda elav chattato asher chata veshappir milla, vehachi hu, dela ketiv o noda elav, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 21:36) o noda ki shor naggach hu, uman dekaim belelya lemile beorayyta, orayyta ka moda leh choveh, vela beorach dina ella keimma deodaa livrah, bemilla rachich, vehu la anshe leh, vetav betiyyuveta kame mareh.

Vi tema david, dehava kam befalgu lelya, amay attearu aleh bedina, ella shani david, deihu avar bemma deitkeshar, uvaa dina, uvemma deavar ittedan. hu chata lokovleh demalchuta kaddisha ulegabbe yerushalam kaddisha, uvegin da ittarach miyrushalam, umalchuta adiu minneh, ad deittekan kedka yeot. (veitanish)

Amar ribbi yehuda, mahu dekudesha berich hu anish leh ledavid al yeda divreh, dichtiv, (Shmuel b 12:11) hinni mekim alecha raa mibbetecha. amar ribbi yose, ha okimna, begin dei yekum aleh bar nash ochora, la yerachem aleh. amar leh, veha avshalom baa lekatla leavuy bechamma etin bishin (davar) aleh, yattir mibbar nash ochora. amar leh la shemana.

Amar leh, ana shemana, david chata bevat sheva setam. amar kudesha berich hu, lete bera devat el nichar, veyinkom nukemata, uman ihu. da avshalom, dibberah diyfat toar hava, mikkerava. mikkan olifna, man denatil itteta da bikrava, vechamid ba, lesof nafik minnah ben sorer umore. may tama begin dead kean, la paska minnah zuhama, veha ukemuha.
Zohar, Vayikra 62: Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, kol zimna debar nash chate kamme dekudesha berich hu, it darga deishtemoda leella lokovle hay chattaa, ledayyeyna leh lebar nash, veistakkal (sefer acher vaasatekan) aleh, i tav bityuveta shelemata kame mareh, itavar choveh, vedina la shalta aloy, vela mate aloy. i la tav, itreshim hahu chattaa legabbe hahu darga. osif lemechote, ha darga ochora izdeman lekavleh, veistekam bedarga kadmaa, keden baya teshuva yattir. (vei lo tav) vei osif lemechete, osif darga al darga, ad deashlim lachamisha dargin.

Kevan deittekan yemina lokovleh, veistekam aleh. ha semala zemina, leaskema bimina, uleitkallela beh. kevan dismala istekam bimina, keden la talya bitshuva, veha ukemuha, ucheden kolla istekamu aleh bedina, vdina sharya aleh.

Vchad dina ishtelim vesharya aleh debar nash, keden istayaym veittekanu etzbean, chamesh bego chamesh, yemina bismala, leachazaa deha kolla istechamu aleh behahu dina, veyadoy mityashsheran, leachazaa milla bela kavavna debar nash, vela yitkeuvn beh. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. leitkallela semala bimina, veashlim dina, ucheden hu kayyayma decholla. veal da, kad baa kudesha berich hu lekayyeyma kolla, ketiv (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo vegomer.
Zohar, Vayikra 8: Ta chazi, adam ki yakriv, laafuke man dela itnesiv, deha karbaneh lav karban, uvirkan la mishtakkechan legabbeh, (sefer acher al yedeh) la leella, vela letatta. mimmashma dichtiv adam ki yakriv, shane hacha, delav ihu adam, vela bichlala deadam hu, ushechinta la sharya alohi, begin deihu pagim, veikre baal mum, umare demuma itrachaka mikkolla, kol shekken lemadbecha lekarva karbena.

Vnadav vaavihu ochachan, dichtiv, (Vayikra 9:24) vattetze esh millifni Adonai. uvegine kach ketiv, adam ki yakriv mikkem karban laAdonai, adam deishtechachu dechar venukeba, hay chaze lekarva karbena da, vla ochora.

Veamar ribbi abba, af al gav deukemuha lenadav vaavihu bemilla ochora, hachi hu vday. aval ketoret, illaa hu mikkol karbenin dealma, dealeh itbarchan illae vetattae. vekarbena da deihu leella mikkol karbenin la itchazun innun lekarva, deha la itnesivu, lekarbana la itchazun, kol shekken lemillin illain, deyitbarchun al yedayyhu.

Vei tema vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam, amay. lebar nash deata kame matronita, levassera lah deha malka ate levetah, veyishre bah bematronita, lemechde immah. ata lekame malka, chama malka hahu bar nash deihu mare demumin. amar malka, lav hu yekara dili, deal yedoy dehay pagim, iul lematronita. addehachi atkenat matronita beta lemalka, kevan dechamat demalka hava zammin lemete legabbah, vehahu bar nash garim leistalleka malka minnah, keden pekidat matronita lekatla lehahu bar nash.

Kacha bezimna dealu nadav vaavihu, uketoret bidayyhu, chaddat matronita, veittakkenat lekabbela lemalka. kevan dechama malka innun guvrin pegimin, mare demumin, la baa malka deal yedayyhu yete lemishre immah, veistellak malka minnah. kad chamat matronita divginehon istallak malka minnah, miyyad vattetze esh millifne Adonai vattochal otam.

Vchol da begin deman dela itnesiv hu pagim. mareh demumin kodam malka, kedushsha demalka istallak minneh, vela sharya bifgimu. veal da ketiv adam ki yakriv mikkem karban, man deikre adam yakriv, uman dela ikre adam la yakriv.
Min habbehema kelal. min habbakar umin hatztzon perat, levatar illen dechashrin lemechal, udela kashshiryan lemechal asir lekarva. velaatar ochora istaliku innun dechashran veinnun dela kashran.
Zohar, Yitro 28: (Shemot 20:12) kabbed et avicha veet immecha. rabbi chiyyay patach, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden vegomer. venahar, da neviu demabbua, denafik tadir vela pasak. uminnahara demabbua da, itshakya kol ginta deeden. vehahu nahara demabbua kaddisha, ikre av. may taama. mishshum deihu nevia leittezana leginta.

Rabbi abba amar, eden mammash ikre av. mishshum dehay eden, mishtechach mehahu atar, deikre ayin. uvegini kach, ikre av. veha ukimna, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, veikre av. kema (ayyen sof hassefer 13 mispar livnat hassappir) deat amar, (Yeshayahu 63:16) ki atta avinu.

Rabbi elazar amar, kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. et avicha, et dayyka, leachlela shechinta (davar achar ilaa). rabbi yehuda amar, kabbed et avicha, setam. veet immecha, setam. deha kolla hava beminyayna. et, lerabbot kol ma dilella vetatta.

Rabbi yosi amar, hay deamar rabbi abba, meatar deshare leitmashshecha kolla, ikre atta, shappir. deha olifna, hahu detamir vela it beh sheruta, karenan hu. meatar (Vayikra 2, amud alef 78, 290 amud alef) desheruta ishtechach, karenan atta. veikre av. vecholla chad. berich shemeh lealam ulealme almayya amen.

Rabbi chizkiyya amar, vadday kolla chad. kabbed et avicha, da kudesha berich hu. veet immecha, da keneset yisrael. deha tenan, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, hahu atar deikre banim. uvegine kach setima demilla, kabbed et avicha veet immecha, leachlela kolla, dilella vetatta. Rabbi yitzchak amar, leachlela beh rabbeh, dehu ail leh lealma deate. amar rabbi yehuda, bichlala dekudesha berich hu have.

Tana, behane chamesh amiran, kalil kolla. behane chamesh amiran, itgelifu chamesh acharanin, vadday chamesh go chamesh. ha ketzad. anochi Adonai elohecha, (84 amud bet) lokovel lo tirtzach. detanenan, (amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yehuda) teren illen, bichlala chada itteklilan, deman dekatil, azir demuta vetzalma demareh. dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:6) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uchetiv (yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam.

Amar Rabbi chiyyay, ketiv (bareasheytet) sofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech vegomer, (shofech dam haadam) man deshafich dama, keillu azir demuta vetzalma dilella, kelomar, la azar demuta da, ella demuta achara, mashma dichtiv shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech. baadam illaa, mate hay pegimuta, mehahu dama deoshid. may taama. mishshum ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. uvegin kach, ha beha talya.

Lo yihye lecha, lokovel lo tinaf da meshakker bishma dekudesha berich hu, deitreshim beh bevar nash. uveda, kamma vechamma chovin vegazrin veonashin, talyayn. uman dimshakker behay, meshakker beh bemalka, dichtiv, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu. uchetiv lo tishtachave lahem velo taavdem, veha beha talya.
Lo tissa lokovel lo tignov. uchetiv (Mishlei 29:24) cholak im gannav sone nafsho alla yishma velo yaggid. vadday ha beha talya, deha gannava leda izdaman, leumaa beshikra. man deavid da, avid da.

Zachor et yom hashshabbat, lokovel lo taan vereacha ed shaker. deamar Rabbi yosi, shabbat sahaduta ikre. uvae bar nash lesahada al ha dichtiv ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai vegomer. veshabbat kelala (nusach acher sahaduta) decholla. veamar Rabbi yosi, may dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, kema deat amar (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, uman deashid shikra, meshakker beshabbat, dehi sahaduta dikshot, uman dimshakker beshabbat, meshakker beorayyta kulla. ubbegin kach, ha beha talya.

Kabbed et avicha, lokovel lo tachmod eshet reecha. veamar Rabbi yitzchak, kabbed et avicha, avicha mammash. deha man dechamid itteta, veolid bar, hahu bar okir leachara, dela avuy. uchetiv kabbed et avicha vegomer, lo tachmod bet reecha, sadehu. uchetiv hacha, al haadama asher Adonai elohecha noten lach. hahu deyahav lach, yehe dilach, velo tachmod achara. vadday ha beha talya.

Veillen chamesh kadmae, kelilan chamesh acharanin. uvegine kach, (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo. decholla itavid yemina. veal da, bachamishsha kalin orayyta ityeyhivat. amar Rabbi yehuda, kullehu havo chamesh go chamesh. lokovlehon chamishsha chumeshe tora.

Tane Rabbi elazar, beillen eser amiran, itgelifu kol pikkude orayyta, gezirin veonashin. dachya umesaava. anfin vesharashin. ilanin unetiin. shemayya veara. yamma utehome. deha orayyta shema dekudesha berich hu havi, ma shema dekudesha berich hu itgelif beeser amiran, uf orayyta itgelifa beeser amiran. illen eser amiran innun shema dekudesha berich hu. veorayyta kolla shema chad have, shema kaddisha dekudesha berich hu mammash.

Zakkaa chulakeh, deman dezache bah. man dezache beorayyta, zache bishma kaddisha. (dekudesha berich hu mammash) Rabbi yosi amar, bekudesha berich hu mammash zache, (sefer acher ucheneset yisrael) deha hu ushemeh chad hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin amen.

rashi: Velo yada veashem, vehevi. hainyan hazze medabber bemi shebba sefek karet leyado velo yada im avar alav im lav, kegon chelev veshumman lefanav, uchesavur shetehen hetter veachal et haechad, amru lo achat shel chelev hayta, velo yada im zo shel chelev achal, hare ze mevi asham taluy, umegen alav kol zeman shello noda lo shevvadday chata, veim noda lo leachar zeman, yavi chattat (keritut 22):

Velo yada veashem venasa avono. rabbi yose haggelili omer, hare hakkatuv anash et mi shello yada, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyaanish et mi sheyyada, rabbi yose omer, im nafshecha leda mattan shocharan shel tzaddikim, tze ulemad meadam harishon shello nitztavva ella al mitzvat lo taase veavar aleha, ree kamma mitot niknesu alav uledorotav. vechi ezo midda merubba shel tova o shel puranut? heve omer midda tova, im middat puranut meuta, ree kamma mitot niknesu lo uledorotav, midda tova hamerubba hayyoshev lo min happiggulin vehannotarot vehammitanne beyom hakkippurim — aakkav sheyyizke lo uledorotav uledorot dorotav ad sof kol haddorot; rabbi akiva omer, hare hu omer al pi shenayim edim o shelosha vegomer (Devarim 17), im mitkayyemet haedut bishnayim, lamma peret lecha hakkatuv 3? ella lehavi shelishi lehachamir alav velaasot dino kayyotze baellu leinyan onesh bahazama; im kach anash hakkatuv lannitpal leovre avera keovre avera, al achat kamma vechamma sheyyeshallem shachar tov lannitpal leose mitzva keose mitzva (sanhedrin 9); rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, ki tiktzor ketzircha vesadecha veshachachta omer bassade hare hu omer lemaan yevarechcha vegomer (Devarim 24) — kava hakkatuv beracha lemi shebbat al yado mitzva belo yada — emor meatta, hayta sela tzerura bichnafav venafla hemennu umetzaah heani venitparnes bah, hare hakkabba kovea lo beracha (sifra):
Shelamim. shemmetilim shalom baolam; davar acher: shelamim sheyyesh bahem shalom lammizbeach velakkohanim velabbealim (sifra):
ohc: Im zachar. shello laasot haderaga lezachar bishlamim, laze amar "im", vehaven:

rashi: Ose chullam Adonai. kesheani omer leashir: parneseni, vehu one kashot, ose chullam Adonai. hakkadosh baruch hu ose otam chadashim, laze ani velaze ashir (temura 16.):
targum: Attira umiskena fagan chad bechad vetarvehon elaha vera inun:

rashi: Adam toe midderech hasekel. poresh min hattora:
Bikhal refaim. baadat gehinnom (bava batra et.):
targum: Bar nasha detae min orcha desikkula im bene ara nittenach:

ohc: Veim nefesh vegomer. amar veim beVav lehosif al inyan rishon ma sherasham mehaddinim befarasha zo, sheen bahem negdiyyut lehaamur bema shellefaneha.

Meam haaretz. darshu razal (horayot 11.) lemaet kohen mashiach beshiggato belo helem davar shello yavi afillu seira. gam mem shel "meam" amru lemaet nasi behecha sheachal chatzi zayit vehu hedyot vachatzi zayit vehu melech sheeno mevi kisba. perush, mittechilla doresh "am haaretz" shehu leappoke haggadol umeyuchad shebbahem shehu kohen hammashiach, uderasha zo hayta nidreshet hagam shehaya omer "beam haaretz", umeamro "meam" chazar vechillek gam chelek mehahedyot, uchegon hedyot sheachal chatzi zayit venitmanna vehishlimo, sheeno mevi.

Baasotah. lo haya tzarich lomar, vedarshu mimmenna betorat kohanim miut veribbuy: miut – sheim asa al pi horaat bet din patur, desalka datach amina ma shekkava hakkatuv par hakkahal eno ella al bet din shehayu sibba behoraatam lachato, aval haosim kedinam omdim lehavi kisba o seira, ka mashma lan dedavka hattole beatzmo. ribbuy – sheim tala bevet din, perush shehoru bevet din veasa al pihem, im haya yodea shettau eno niftar mitztzad horaatam vechayyav bisira o kisba, hagam sheyyaviu bet din par hachattat kemishpato. haribbuy ramuz betevat "baasot", vehammiut bedikduk "baasotah", mashma baasot otah velo acheret, uvaze tavin shete baraytot betorat kohanim al nachon.

rashi: Hakkesalim. 560 belaaz; shehachelev sheal hakkelayot keshehabbehema chayya hu begova hakkesalim millematta, veze hachelev shettachat hammatnayim — shekkorin belaaz lavenabeylevash — loven hannire lemala begova hakkesalim, uvetachtito habbashar chofehu:
Hayyoteret. hu dofen hammasach shekkorin 523, uvelashon arammi chitzra dechavda:
Al hakkaved. sheyyittol min hakkaved immah meat, uvemakom acher hu omer veet hayyoteret min hakkaved (Vayikra 9):
Al hakkaved al hakkelayot. levad min hakkaved ulevad min hakkelayot yesirenna lezo:
Uchesil adam. uchesilut shel adam:
targum: Simita riginta umishcha bedireh dechakkima vesichla divne nasha nivleinun:

rashi: Adat yisrael. ellu sanhedrin (sham):
Venelam davar. tau lehorot beachat mikkol karetot shebbattora shehu muttar (horayot 8):
Hakkahal veasu. sheasu tzibbur al pihem:
ohc: Veim kol adat vegomer. betorat kohanim darshu "adat" – zo sanhedrin, neemar kan "eda" veneemar lehallan vechulei (Bamidbar 35:24-25), "yisrael" darshu hammeyuchedet shebbeyisrael, shehi shel shivim veechad, "yishgu" yachol yihyu hammeyuchadim chayyavim al shiggat maase, talmud lomar "venelam", enam chayyavin ella al helem davar. veamru od: horu bet din veasu yachol yihyu chayyavin – talmud lomar "hakkahal veasu", hahoraa bevet din vehammaase bakkahal, ad kan.

Uvederech remez yirtze, sheim yishgu haeda veyitu midderech hayyashar, gam sanhedre yisrael toratam tihye neelemet mehem, letzad shello hishgichu al adat Adonai leyashsher hammaakashshim, ki hachet yolid chet acher, vetze ulemad (gittin 60.) mehoraat abbayye belo netilat reshut merabbo sheshshagag beotah horaa vehirgish ki den garma, vechidita besanhedrin (5:).

rashi: Ola. leshem ola yaktirennu:
Ishshe. kesheyyishchatennu yehe shochato leshem haesh; vechol ishshe leshon esh, paveshayyr belaaz:
Nichoach. nachat ruach lefanay, sheamarti venaasha retzoni (sham):
ohc: Et hakkol. amru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim kan) lerabbot hakkarnayim vehattelafayim. vekashe, lamma lo hikriv avraham et hasse leola bekarnav vegomer (Bereshit 22:14) vehinniach karnav leshofarot kemaamaram zichronam livracha (pirki derabbi eliezer lo). veulay shehikriv hakkol ufaka meal hammizbeach, kidtenan (zevachim 86.) vechullan sheppaku meal hammizbeach lo yachzir.

O efshar shennitlash mealav kodem zerika, velo nitrabbu hakkarnayim vechulei lehakerava ella beodan mechubbarim, aval nitleshu afillu alu lerosh hammizbeach yerdu, dichtiv (Devarim 12:27) "veasita olotecha habbasar" vegomer, umuttar bahanaa, vechidrabbi zera sheamar befarashat hammizbeach mekaddesh (zevachim 86.), nitlash kodem zerika share lemebad minnayyhu afillu kata desakkine.

O efshar sheadayin lo nittena tora, vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (yoma koach.) kiyyem avraham avinu afillu eruve tavshilin, kevar katavti befarashiyyot avot shezze haya leratzon, kol sheen hechreach baddavar leezo sibbat zechut, kemo shettomar nissue tamar lihuda, nissue shete achayot leyaakov, uchemo chen karne ayil amdu lenes behodaat neviim, velaze lo kiyyemu mitzvot haatidot lehaketir karnav.

rashi: Ze yomar laAdonai ani. ellu tzaddikim gemurim:
Veze yikra veshem yaakov. ellu ketannim, bene reshaim:
Ze yichtov yado laAdonai. ellu baale teshuva:
Uveshem yisrael yechanne. ellu haggerim meovde kochavim umazzalot. kach shenuya beavot derabbi natan (avot derabbi natan lo 1):
targum: Den yemar midachalaya dayya ana veden yetzale veshum yaakov veden yekarev kurebane kodam Adonai uvishma deyisrael yitkere:

rashi: Zorea avla. yiktzar aven lefi zeriato ketzirato, lefi peullato yihye kabbalat maskurto:
Veshevet evrato yichle. kene hashshibbolet shello kale veholech lo. yesh omrim (62): shevet chamato, sherode bene adam, kale veholech lo, lefi shemmafsid et yechalto:
targum: Dezarea avla nechtzad aata veshivta decheryaneh nigmor:

rashi: Hazekireni. kol tagmul sheyyesh lecha velaavotecha alay:
Nishshafta yachad. navo lemishpat:
targum: Emar kean nedon kachada ishtae at vedil im tikkul vetizke:

rashi: Lo tinnasheni. lo tihye shachuach miyyirati:
targum: Idkar ilen yaakov veyisrael are avdi at atkentach lemeheve aved pelach kodamay at yisrael la titneshe dechalti:

rashi: Pitzchu. leshon pitchon pe:
targum: Shabbachu shemaya are avad Adonai furekan leame yabbivu yesode ara buu turaya tushebachta churesha vechol ilanaya deve are ferak Adonai yaakov uveyisrael yishtabbach:

rashi: Ki etztzak mayim al tzame. kemo sheani yotzek mayim al tzame, ken etztzok ruchi al zarecha:
targum: Are chema demityahavin maya al ara bet tzachavana umitnagdin al yabbeshta ken etten ruach kudeshi al benach uvirchati al bene venach:

rashi: Patot otah pittim. lerabbot kol hammenachot hanneefot kodem kemitza liftita (sham 75):
Veyatzakta aleha shamen mincha hiv. lerabbot kol hammenachot litzika; yachol af mincha maafe tannur ken, tal aleha; otzi et hachallot velo otzi et harkikin, tal hiv (sham):
Veatta shema. lashuv letorati, yaakov avdi:
targum: Uchean shema yaakov avdi veyisrael deitreeti veh:

rashi: Vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona. chattat kodemet laola (sifra); lema haddavar dome? lifraklit shennichnas leratztzot, ritztza peraklit, nichnas doron acharav (zevachim 7):
Velo yavdil. eno molek ella siman echad (chullin 21):
Oref. hu gova harosh hammashpia letzad hatztzavvar:
Mimmul orpo. mul haroe et haoref, vehu orech kol achore hatztzavvar (sham 19):
Murato. mekom hari, ze hazzefek (sifra):

Benotzatah. im bene meeha, venotza leshon davar hammaus, kemo ki natzu gam nau (Eicha 4), vezehu shettirgem unkelos beucheleh; vezehu midrasho shel abba yose ben chanan sheamar notel et hakkurkevan immah; verabbotenu zichrono livracha amru koder seviv hazzefek besakkin keen arubba venotlo im hannotza sheal haor (sifra); beolat behema sheenah ochelet ella beevus bealeha, neemar vehakkerev vehakkeraayim yirchatz bammayim vehiktir, uvaof shennazon min haggazel, neemar vehishlich et hammeayim, sheachal min haggazel (Vayikra Rabba 3):
Etzel hammizbeach kedma. bemizracho shel kevesh (sifra):
El mekom haddashen. makom shennotnin sham terumat haddeshen bechol boker vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora, vechullam nivlaim sham bimkoman:
Min haof. velo kol haof; lefi shenneemar tamim zachar babbakar bakkesavim uvaizzim — tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot — yachol af mechussar ever, tal min haof (sham):
Torim. gedolim velo ketannim:
Bene Yona. ketannim velo gedolim:
Min hattorim o min bene hayyona. perat litchillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze shehu pasul, sheggadol hu etzel bene yona vekatan etzel torim (chullin 22):
ohc: Veim min haof. gam ze mosif al inyan rishon, litten kol haamur lemala bo zulat peratim sheshshalal hakkatuv beferush bo. haechad sheen of ba ella ola, mimma sheddiyyek "haof ola", sheshshinna misseder shebbeolat bakar vetzon, o letzad hayyittur, veod miet "karbano" sheen ba of ola mitztzibbur, gam bedin melika shemmeakkev bechohen ma sheen meakkevet hashshechita beolat bakar vetzon, gam peratim shehucheplu beolat bakar veolat tzon lelo tzorech ba haddavar lemaet haof, aval shear devarim shemmiet hakkatuv beechad mishshenehem velamad ze mizze kegon nirba, muketze, veneevad, terefa, chole, zaken, gazul – kullam pesulim baof kabbehema, vechen hu mevoar bedivrehem uvarambam beferek 3 mehilchot issure mizbeach, velaze amar "veim min haof".

Karbano laAdonai. taam amro karbano laAdonai, ma shello amar ken beolat bakar vetzon, lefi shemmatzinu shehichshir hakkatuv baof baale mumin, keamram zichronam livracha (torat kohanim, kiddushin kad.) en zachrut vetammut baof, uchemo shekkatavnu besamuch, im ken tavo hassevara lomar ki pachut hu karban ze, ki mum bo, veen ze begeder karban laAdonai, laze amar karbano laAdonai ki en bo shum haderaga pechuta letzad bechina zo veen roshem bemumo kol ikkar.

Od yirtze al derech amro (yeshaya 57:15) "veet dakka ushefal ruach", veamru zichronam livracha (sota 5.): "ani et dakka", uleman deamar "itti dakka". umehattaam atzmo lo hizkir shemo yitbarach samuch lehazekarat karban ella bekarban of, ki mi darko lehavi of, hu heani, umevio beshivron lev letzad ma shehu heani uletzad miut hakkarban, vekara alav "veet dakka", ma sheen ken hammakriv bakar vetzon, shennafsho semecha alav behakeravat davar harauy lehitkabbed. vechayyotze baze darshu bizvachim (menachot 104:) bema sheamar hakkatuv bemincha "venefesh" yeuyyan sham.

rashi: Vehaya leadam levaer. vehaya oto etz miktzato letzarche adam levaer:
Vayyikkach min haetzim. vayyacham gufo lenegdam:
Af yassik. mehem tannur veofe lachem:
Af yifal el. min hannotar:
targum: Veheve leenasha leadlaka unesev minhon ushechen af aza veafa lechem af avde dachala useged itteche tzalma uvea mine:

rashi: Kofer latztzaddik rasha vetachat yesharim boged. tzaddik nechlatz verasha ba tachtav (yerushalmi berachot 9:1), kegon mardechay vehaman (Ester 7:9-10):
targum: Shalchofeh detzadika rashia veshalchofe ditritze vazoze:

rashi: Am zu yatzarti li. lemaan tehillati yesapperu:
targum: Ama den atkenet lefulechani vetushebachti yehon mishtaan:

rashi: Kaasher husar chelev meal zevach hashshelamim. keemure ez haamurim bashshelamim:
Berosho. hu hakkeren, rosh hammamon:

Vachamishitav. ribbeta hattora chamishiyyot harebe lekeren achat, sheim kafar bachomesh venishba vehoda, chozer umevi chomesh al oto chomesh, vechen mosif veholech ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren hannishba lo pachot mishshave peruta (bava kamma 103):
Laasher hu lo. lemi shehammamon shello (sham):

Vechi takriv vegomer. sheamar hare alay minchat maafe tannur; velimmed hakkatuv sheyyavi o challot o rekikin, hachallot belulot veharkikin meshuchin; venechleku rabbotenu bimshichatan, yesh omrim moshchan vechozer umoshchan ad shekkale kol hashshemen shebballog — shekkol hammenachot teunot log shemen — veyesh omrim moshchan kemin "chi" ushear hashshemen neechol bifne atzmo lakkohanim (menachot 75); ma tal bashshemen bashshemen shene peamim? lehacheshir shemen sheni ushelishi hayyotze min hazzetim, veen tzarich shemen rishon ella lammenora shenneemar bo zach (Shemot 27), veshaninu bimnachot kol hammenachot haafuyot lifne kemitzatan venikmatzot al yede petita, kullan baot esher esher challot, vehaamur ba rekikin baa asara rekikin (menachot 76):
ohc: Vechi takriv. amar vechi betosefet vav lismoch din ze leinyan rishon, lomar lecha sheggam bifrate hammincha nitrabba kohen mashiach, venitmaatu tzibbur gam litnae perate hahakrava shennirshemu bekometz minchat solet, gam lehavi levona hagam shello huzkera bah.

rashi: Velo yashiv el libbo. chetzyo sarafti vemo esh:
Velo daat velo tevuna bo lemor zot:
Levul etz. lerikvon etz:
targum: Vela metiv lelibbe vela mada vela sucheltanu lememar palge okedat benura veaf afiti al gumerohi lechem tevet bisra vaachalet usheere letoeva abed leyivle aa esgod:

rashi: Veim takriv. hare im meshammesh bilshon ki, shehare en ze reshut, shehare beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber shehi chova, vechen veim yihye hayyovel vegomer (Bamidbar 36):
Minchat bikkurim. beminchat haomer hakkatuv medabber shehi baa aviv — bishat bishshul hattevua, umin hasseorim hi baa, neemar kan aviv veneemar lehallan (Shemot 9), hasseora aviv:
Kaluy baesh. shemmeyabbeshin otah al haur beabbuv shel kallaim, sheillule chen enah nitchenet barechayim, lefi shehi lacha:
Geres karmel. gerusa beodah lacha:
Geres. geres leshon shevira utechina, gorsah berechayim shel garosot, kemo vayyagres bechatzatz (Eicha 3), vechen garsa nafshi (Tehillim 119):
Karmel. beod hakkar male, shehattevua lacha umelea bekashshin shellah, veal ken nikraim hammelilot karmel, vechen karmel betziklono (Melachim 2 4):
ohc: Veim takriv vegomer. perush, im yihye zeman hakeravat minchat bikkurim vegomer, takriv perush chova, ki chiyyuv mitzva zo bechol zeman, uvimkom zichron tenay hazzeman amar "veim".

rashi: Ekev anava. bishvil haanava yirat Adonai baa. davar acher: anava ikkar, vehayyira tefela veakev lah, midras leragleha (yerushalmi shabbat 1,3):
targum: Ekva deinvetanuta dechalta dayya utera vikara vechaye:

rashi: Asher yease meelle. meechad min hamminim hallalu:
Vehikrivah. bealeha el hakkohen:
Vehiggishah. hakkohen:
Vehiggishah el hammizbeach. maggishah lekeren deromit maaravit shel mizbeach (zevachim 63):
Charash barzel. charash shel barzel:
Maatzad. hu echad mikkele hannappachim:
Ufaal. happesel. bappecham. 358 109:
Uvammakkavot. 289 109:
Yitztzerehu. leshon 'tziyyur:
Vayyifalehu bizroa kocho gam raev vegomer. gam hu hayyotzer chasar koach vechallash hu, sheim yirav en bo koach, o im lo shata mayim vayyiaf lealtar. kal vachomer sheppeullato en bah toelet laazor:
targum: Nafcha mibbarzela chatzina aved unefach nur beshichurin uvemakuvin matkef leh veavid leh bitkof chele deim yichpan avde vela yechul la yehe veh chel veim yitzche vela yishte maya yehe meshalhe:

rashi: Bimkom asher yishchat et haola. batztzafon shehu meforash baola:
Chattat hu. lishmo kasher, shello lishmo pasul (sifra):

Korban reshit takrivu otam. ma yesh lecha lehavi min hasseor umin haddevash? karban reshit — shete hallechem shel atzeret habbaim min hasseor, shenneemar chametz teafena (Vayikra 23), uvikkurim min haddevash, kemo bikkure teenim utemarim (menachot 58):
Arum raa raa. onesh shel avera, venistar velo avar avera:
targum: Arima chaze vishta umitshe veshavre avdin vechasrin inun:

rashi: Veal tirhu. en lo dimyon, ufitrono lefi hainyan kemo 'al techattu millehodia et shemi leven haavovde kochavim umazzalot:
Halo meaz hishmaticha. mehar sinay, vehiggadti lachem sham sheen eloah mibbaladay:
Veattem eday. sheppatachti lachem shiva rekiim vehereti etchem sheen acher, veattem eday baddavar hazze sheen eloah mibbaladay:
Veen tzur bal yadati. tirgem yonatan: "velet detakkif elhen demin kodami mityehev leh takkif":
Bal yadati. leshon "vaedaacha veshem" (Shemot 33:17), "yada lechtecha" (Devarim 2:7), "ani yedaticha bammidbar" (Hoshea 13:5):
targum: La tidachalun vela tittabberun hala mibbechen vesartach vechaveti veattun sahadin kodamay hait elaha bar mini velet detakif elahen demin kodamay mityehav leh tekof:

ohc: Veim keves vegomer ad venislach lo. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lechallekam lishte parashiyyot, vehaya lo lomar lemala "vehevi karbano seirat izzim vegomer o chisba temima" vegomer velo haya tzarich lichtov kol happarasha. venire ki chillekam hakkatuv lattaam atzmo sheamru razal (torat kohanim 3) befarashat veim ez, shebba lerabbot alya bechattat min hakkisba, laze dikdek lomar bechisba "kaasher yuram chelev hakkesev", uvisira amar "veet kol chelbah yasir". vachada beshalme nedava vachada bechattat chova.

Gam roani sheyyesh chiddush bechol haamur, amro vesamach darshu razal (torat kohanim hacha) shebba lelammed al chattat nazir vechattat metzora shetteunin semicha. veamro veshachat otah lechattat darshu (zevachim 7.) shetztzarich shettihye shechita leshem chattat, uferat ze lo nirmaz befarashat seira umikkan atta lamed lishnehem. veamro bimkom asher vegomer amru bizvachim (zevachim moach:) beferek ezehu mekoman: chattat menalan devaya tzafon, dichtiv "veshachat hachattat bimkom haola", ashkechan lemitzva, leikkuva menalan, dichtiv "bimkom asher yishchat et haola" vegomer, ad kan. hare shehutzrechu shene ketuvim. vesham bashshas heela shellemedin lechol hachattaot lemitzva. veamro (torat kohanim kan) middam hachattat darshu shetztzarich lekabbel damah leshem chattat, vechen bechol ma shekkafal yesh bo chiddush mishpat, velaze chalkinnehu kera lelammed chukkim umishpatim vechulei.

rashi: Hakkohanim vekamatz. mikkemitza vaelach mitzvat kehunna (sham):
Vekamatz mishsham. mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot; lelammedcha shehakkemitza keshera bechol makom baazara, af bey amma shel mekom derisat ragle yishorael (yoma 16):

Melo kumtzo. yachol mevoratz — mevatzbetz veyotze lechol tzad, talo bemakom acher veherim mimmennu bekumtzo (Vayikra 6) — lo yehe kasher ella ma shebbetoch hakkometz, i bekumtzo yachol chaser, talo melo, ha ketzad? chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pas yado, vezehu kometz bemashma lashon haivrit (menachot 11):
Al kol levonatah. levad kol hallevona yehe hakkometz male:
Levonatah vehiktir. af hallevona behaketara:
Melo kumtzo missoltah umishshamnah. ha im kamatz veala beyado garger melach o koret levona pesula (sham 6):
Azkaratah. hakkometz haole legavoah hu zichron hammincha — shebbo nizkar bealeha letova ulenachat ruach:
Veim min hatztzon. 22 mosif al inyan rishon, velamma hufsak? litten revach lemoshe lehitbonen ben parasha lefarasha (sham):
Min hatztzon, min hakkesavim, min haizzim. hare ellu 3 miutin — perat lezaken ulechole velimzoham (sham):
ohc: Veim min hatztzon. amru betorat kohanim: hare ze mosif al inyan rishon, ad kan. hakkavvana baze litten kol haamur bemin habbakar velo huzekar batztzon, kegon semicha vedineha ushear hallimmudim. gam lidrosh im nichpal davar mehammuzekar kevar beven habbakar, velaze timtza sheddarshu kol happeratim shennichpelu, gam litten et haamur befarasha zo beshellefaneha, kegon shechitat tzafon vechulei ushear hadderashot hannilmadim meolat tzon.

Uvetorat kohanim mesayyem bah: velamma hifsik? kede litten revach lemoshe. hiksha harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi demikkan mashma shello hukesha leh lamma hifsik ella letzad dichtiv "veim" shemmosif, vesham betorat kohanim (parasha 1) babbarayta sheddana shehayta keria kodemet ledibbur katane: yachol af lehafesakot vechulei uma hayu hahafsakot meshammeshot vechulei, ad kan, mashma afillu belo vav hayu hahafsakot meshammeshot vechulei ad kan, veteretz vechulei, veen devarav nirim.

Vehannachon beenay hu, ki koach vetaam hammetaretz sham hu mikkan, shezzulat yittur vav haamur kan hayiti omer taam hahafsakot lo litten revach lemoshe lehitbonen, ella kede sheyyaskil moshe shello yilmad din mizze laze. umimma shemmatzinu sherasham Adonai kan veamar "veim min hatztzon" betosefet vav, ha lamadta sheddin kullan shave velitten haamur shel ze baze. im ken lamma hayu hahafsakot? behechreach lomar shehu litten revach lemoshe. umikkan lechol makom sheyyihyu hahafsakot hare shellecha lefanecha hattaam, vehu maamar hattanna bederech kelal, uma hayu hahafsakot meshammeshot.

rashi: Vehifshit vegomer. ma talmud lomar haola? lerabbot et kol haolot lehefshet venittuach:
Otah lintacheha. velo netacheha lintachim (sifra):
Veedehem hemma. happesilim hem edim al boshet ovdehem, shehare anu roin sheenan lo roin velo yodin, vehayu ovdin lahem:
Lemaan yevoshu. haovdim lahem:
targum: Avde tzalmaya kulehon lema ufalchehon dela yahanun lehon vesahadin inun benafshatehon dela chazan vela yadin bedin deyibbahatun:

rashi: Venatnu … esh. aappi shehaesh yoredet min hashshamayim mitzva lehavi min hahedyot (sham):
Bene aharon hakkohen. keshehu bechihuno, ha im avad bevigde kohen hedyot avodato pesula:
Af ki vezimma yeviennu. vechol shekken keshehu mevio lehareshio, uveetza raa, kegon karbenot bilam uvalak, shello hayu meviim ella lekallel et yisrael (Bamidbar 23):
targum: Divcha derashie merachek hu metul devaaverta mayte leh:

rashi: Lo heveta li se olotecha. ki im laavoda zara:
Lo heevadticha. avoda rabba bemincha, kometz meat ole laggavoah, vegam hu lo amarti lecha lehakeriv lecha chova, ella nedava:
targum: La ayteta kodamay imrin lealta venichsat kudeshach la yakarta kodamay la asgeti alach bekurebanin vela atkefet alach bilvonta:

rashi: Et pene parochet hakkodesh. keneged mekom kedushshatah — mechuvvan keneged ben habbaddim, velo hayu nogim damim bapparochet, veim nagu nagu:
Vetzaddik yitten. kol tzarche veto shehakkadosh baruch hu mezammen lo:
targum: Kol yoma raeg rigta vetzadika yahev vela machsech:

rashi: Im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta leashmat haam. midrasho: eno chayyav ella behelem davar im shiggat maashe, kemo shenneemar leashmat haam venelam davar meene hakkahal veasu (sham); ufeshuto lefi aggada: keshekkohen gadol chote, ashmat haam hu ze, shehen teluyin bo lechapper alehem ulehitpallel baadam, venaase mekulkal:
Par. yachol zaken, talmud lomar ben, i ben yachol katan, talmud lomar par, ha ketzad? ze par ben shalosh (sham):
ohc: Im hakkohen vegomer. hitchil bakkohen velo batztzibbur, uma gam sheamar leashmat haam sheddimma shiggato leshiggat haam umin harauy lehakedim beresha. veulay shebba lomar shetztzarich lehakedim karbano shel mashuach leshel tzibbur veen tzarich lomar leshel melech, vehattaam kemo sheamru bemassechet horayot (horayot 13.) kohen mechapper vetzibbur mitkapperin. umatzati lerazal (torat kohanim pasuk 13) sheamru, par kohen mashiach ufar haeda, par kohen mashiach kodem, uderashuha meamro "veim kol adat yisrael" vegomer, ha lamadta sheyyesh lehakedimo. od darshu meamro "kaasher saraf" vegomer, mikkan shetztzarich lehakedim par mashiach lefar haeda.

Vetzarich ladaat lamma lo hispik lerazal lilmod hakkedima mimma shehikdimo hakkatuv, shehutzrechu lechappes achar derashot acherim. veulay sheim lo hayta ella hakkedima basseder levad, hayiti omer shello siddero hakkatuv kodem karban tzibbur ella letzad sheim haya mesaddero achar karban tzibbur, haya nishma amro "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta leashmat haam", perush, haamura besamuch, shehoru bet din vehu hora immahem, veze eno, ki im hora im hatztzibbur mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur, vechidita bammishna (horayot 7.), laze kadam vesidder mishpato levad. vaadayin ani omer shello yakdim karbano leshel tzibbur, laze darshu meamro "veim" vegomer. vaadayin kashe lamma hutzrechu shete derashot laze, derashat "veim", uderashat "kaasher saraf" (Vayikra 4:21). venire ki echad lirshut veechad lechova. uma sheraiti levaal karban aharon shennatan taam shehayiti omer lemiktzat velo lechullah, en taam betamo. od nire lomar, echad leim kadam vehevi vaadayin lo heviu par haeda veheviu achar kach vahare shenehem omdim, vechad leim bau keachat par mashiach ufar haeda, af al pi chen takdim shel mashiach.

Leashmat haam. yitbaer al derech asher amru zichronam livracha (avot 5:18): hamezakke et harabbim en chet ba al yado, uvirot ki kohen hammashiach chata – ze yaggid shello zachu hazzochim al yado kede shello yavo chet al yado bishvilam, vehu amro leashmat haam.

Uvetorat kohanim darshu ki "leashmat haam" yechavven hakkatuv lehareot min hachet asher yitchayyev alav karban, shehu helem davar im shiggat maase, kaamur "leashmat haam" (Vayikra 4:13) "venelam davar" vegomer. veim hakkohen hammashiach shagag beshiggat maase levad, haddavar taluy im yitchayyev lehavi karban hedyot o lo, vedarshu zichronam livracha (horayot 11.) befasuk "meam haaretz" lehotzi kohen mashiach ki patur legamre. veim hakkohen hammashiach eno chacham mufla hare ze patur (horayot 7.) mikkol min karban, ben behelem davar veshiggat maase ben beshiggat maase levad, vetzarich latet taam ledavar ze. veulay ki haose behelem davar vehu chacham mufla, shegaga zo osa roshem gadol benishmato umarchik nafsho mishsharshah, velo yoil zechutam shel yisrael shehu mechapper baadan limnoa mimmennu happegam, ma sheen ken kol sheshshagag bemaase levad o behelem davar veeno chacham mufla, chet ze lo yafil pegam bivchinat nefesh kohen mashiach lerachakah mishsharshah kede sheyyitztarech lekarban lekarvah, ki beemtzaut zechut harabbim hen el kabbir lo yimas, gam lo yaspik ze lesiman ki haam ashemim mimma shebba leyad hammashiach shogeg ze mehattaam atzmo shekkatavnu.

Vehannoteret vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal pasuk ze shene peamim. veulay sheyyitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (menachot noach.) bechol hammenachot shemmuttar leechol sheyare menachot bidvash, aval im hechmitz sheyareha loke, vedarshu (menachot noah.) mimma sheamar hakkatuv "lo teafe chametz chelkam", perush gam chelkam, ad kan. vaadayin ani omer davka al haafiyya hu loke, aval im hechmitzah velo afaah lo, laze amar hakkatuv "vehannoteret vegomer kol hammincha asher takrivu lo tease chametz", perush afillu sheyareha. vahagam sherabbotenu zichronam livracha (sham) darshu mippasuk "lo teafe chametz" vesamich leh "chelkam", meotah derasha en lechayyev al sheyareha ella al haafiyya velo al shear maase, uvefasuk ze levad lo yaspik lechayyev al sheyareha al kol perat uferat. vahagam sheddarshu sham betorat kohanim afiyya bichlal hayta velamma yatzta, lomar lecha ma afiyya maase yechidi vechayyav alav af ani avi kol maase yechidi, adayin ani omer davka kumetzah velo sheyareha, ka mashma lan "vehannoteret" vegomer.
