Od yitbaer al derech amro betorat kohanim "vehannoteret" – af al pi shello humelcha, af al pi shello hugesha, af al pi shello hiktir kol levonatah, "min hammincha" – perat leshechasra vechulei, veshello hiktir millevonatah kelum. vechatav haraavad ki vav vehe ribbuya hu lerabbot hannizkar ad kan. veen dati masseget ribbuy ze shiuro, sheen mashmaut latteva behasir vav vehe. uvaal karban aharon peresh ki vav levad hu deiyyetar, vegam al ze yesh legamgem. veod minnayin lattanna lomar shelosha ribbuyim: melicha vehaggasha vechol hallevona? bishlama ma shemmiet 3 mehammincha yesh lidrosh kol dimyon shebbammincha leakkev, ma sheen ken ribbuy echad en lanu leharebot harebe peratim.

Achen nire ki letzad sheamar hakkatuv shalosh mitzvot elle: hamelacha, vehaggasha, vehaketarat kol levonatah, mefuzzarim bishlosha mekomot. haketarat kol levonatah ketavah befarashat minchat solet, haggasha beminchat marcheshet, hamelacha achar tashlum zichron kol dine menachot. umatzinu sheamar hakkatuv "vehannoteret min hammincha" achar zichron minchat solet, hagam shello huzkar bah haggasha. ha lamadta sheen haggasha meakkevet bah, shehare hagam shello huzkar bah haggasha amar "vehannoteret vegomer leaharon uvanav". vahagam sheanu omrim midderashat semichut vav haamura bitchillat kol hafesaka vehafesaka, sheyyechavven hakkatuv litten et haamur shel ze baze, veim ken gam hahaggasha shenneemra beminchat marcheshet tzericha lihyot gam beminchat solet vegomer, mimma shekkatav "vehannoteret" beemtza hammenachot gilla ki hallimmud eno ella lechattechilla aval eno meakkev lifsol bishvilah, aval kol hallevona meakkev. veod matzinu shechazar hakkatuv veamar "vehannoteret" vegomer achar din minchat marcheshet, ufasuk ze kol roe yaggid shehu atzmo notar, shehaddevarim kichtavan neemru lemala. ha vadday lo ba ella lomar shebbifrate dinim harshumim sham yaspik lihyot hannoteret leaharon vegomer, vesham lo huzkar haketarat levona kol ikkar ella hakkometz, dichtiv "veherim hakkohen vegomer azkaratah", perush hakkometz, velo huzkar levona. ha lamadta sheal ze ba hakkatuv lelammed, shehagam shello hiktir kol levona karashum befarashat minchat solet, hannoteret leaharon. vehu maamar hattanna: "vehannoteret" af al pi shello hugesha, af al pi shello hiktir kol levonatah. vekatane gam ken: af al pi shello humelcha, ki rainu shetztzivva achar amro "vehannoteret leaharon", ha lamadta sheyyeshno hashsheyarayim behetter hagam shello humelcha.

rashi: Hen kol chaverav. shel oto yotzer venosech pesilim, hammitchabberim elav laavod et yetzirato venisko, yevoshu:
Vecharashim hemma. otam yotzrim venoschim mibbene adam hem, kal vachomer litziratam shehi hevel:
targum: Ha kol palchehon yibbahatun veumanin uvedanin mibbene enasha yitkansun kulehon yekumun yittabberun yivahatun kachada:

rashi: Veet kol chelbo yarim. af al pi shello peresh kan yoteret ushete kelayot, lemedin hem mivveasa lappar kaasher asa vegomer umippene ma lo nitparshu bo? tana deve rabbi yishmael mashal lemelech shezzaam al ohavo umiet besirchono mippene chibbato (sham 41):

Marcheshet. keli hu shehaya bammikdash, amok, umittoch shehi amukka, shamnah tzavur veen haur sorfo, lefichach maase mincha haasuyin letochah rochashin; kol davar rach al yede mashke nire kerochesh umenaanea (sifra):
Kammishpat. kaddat haamur beolat haof shel nedava berosh happarasha:
ohc: Mechattato asher chata. taam shebbekarban ashir amar (pasuk 6) "mechattato", uvekarban ani amar "mechattato asher chata", yitbaer al pi ma shepperesh betorat kohanim (Vayikra 5:13) bekarban dalle dallut: yachol hachamurim shebbahem yihyu bechisba useira, hakkallim yihyu betorim uvene yona, hakkallim shebbakkallim yihyu baasirit haefa, talmud lomar "meachat meelle" lehashevot hakkallim lachamurim vechulei ad kan. perush, lefi sheyyesh befarasha zo shelosha mine chattaot: tumeat mikdash vekadashav sheyyesh bah onesh karet – zo chamura mikkullan, ushevuat haedut shechayyav al zedonah veshiggatah – zo kalla mishshellefaneha vachamura mishshelleachareha shehi shevuat bittuy sheeno chayyav ella al shiggatah, yachol hachamurim vechulei.

Kashe, ech yachol adam lomar ken, vehakkatuv omer "veim lo taggia" vegomer, mashma shebbimtziut atzmo shechayyav kisba useira hu medabber. vechen "im lo tassig yado" vegomer shebbedalle dallut. veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shepperesh "veim lo taggia" – shello naga yado bemaal shechayyav baavuro kisba vechulei, ella lemaal kal mimmennu hammuzkar bapparasha, yavi shete torim vegomer, veim (lo) hissig yado bemaal shechayyav lehavi baavuro shene bene yona vegomer ad kan. ulederech ze yityashshev amro mechattato asher chata, letzad shechalukka zo hi chalukkat hakkallim shehi shevuat haedut, kede shello tite sheen karban ze shel of ella lechet ze hakkal, aval lechamur mimmennu, shehu tumat mikdash vekadashav, en of ba afillu baaniyyut, talmud lomar "mechattato asher chata", shete chattaot neemru, echad lishvuat haedut, veechad letumat mikdash vekadashav shello tite bo kannizkar, vechazar hakkatuv befarashat dalle dallut veribba afillu leinyan asirit haefa sheyyeshnah bechol hashshalosh. ella shennire beenay perush harm zichrono livracha dachuk beyoter, ki ech yekabbel haddaat lefaresh amro "im lo tassig yado" shehakkavvana hi lechet yoter, kemo zar nechshav hainyan.

Veulay nuchal lefaresh kavvanat hattanna al ze hadderech, sheim lo amar hakkatuv "meachat meelle" hayiti omer hachamurim shebbahem shehu tumat mikdash vekadashav karbanam kavua bechisba, uma sheamar hakkatuv: veim lo taggia yado de se vehevi torim uvene yona – lo lakkol hu omer ella lakkarban hakkal shebbechullan hu shehekel bechapparato, shehagam shebbeashro chiyyevo kisba, beanyo im lo taggia yado lechisba yavi torim, vehabba lomar sheyyoil gam lechamur alav lehavi reaya. vegam amro: veim lo tassig yado lishte torim vegomer yavi asirit haefa – hayiti omer al hakkal shebbakkallot hu omer sheyyoil karban ze shehu shevuat bittuy, velo al shevuat haedut shehi chamura, veen tzarich lomar tumat mikdash vekadashav shello yakel bo Adonai lechapper alav baasirit haefa. vehayiti dan lechazzek ze mimma shemmatzinu shekkava Adonai karban kisba useira lechol hashshegagot, kaamur bapparasha shellefaneha, lamma yiggara karet ze shel tumat mikdash vekadashav? ha vadday lo ba karban ole veyored ella al hakkallin. vehu al seder ze: heashir yavi al kullan kisba useira, haddal hekel bo hakkatuv lehavi torim uvene yona al shevuat haedut, aval al tumat mikdash vekadashav lo yatza mikkelal hachattaot shechiyyev bapparasha shellefaneha, dichtiv "nefesh vegomer ki techeta vishgaga", dalle dallut hekel bo hakkatuv lehavi asirit haefa al shevuat bittuy, aval al shevuat haedut shehi chamura lo yavi asirit haefa. veze hu ikkar hattaut shehayiti toe bainyan, detalmud lomar "meachat meelle" – hare hishva hakkatuv et kullan lehavi afillu al tumat mikdash vekadashav asirit haefa, umikkol shekken torim uvene yona, vehu kavvanat hattanna sheamar "yachol". ella ma sheamar bachalukat hashevaat kallim lachamurim, kede nasba, veen ikkar hattaut shealav ba hakkatuv ella chalukkot hashevaat chamurim lekallim.

Od nire lefaresh divre hattanna al ze hadderech, lefi shessidder hakkatuv shalosh mine chattaot, veroani ki yesh bahem shalosh haderagot, uva lesadder hachattaot hatztzerichin lechappara. hitchil bechamur shebbechullan veamar "yavi kisba", veim lo tassig yado yavi karban hashshayyach lema shellefanav shehu shevuat haedut – "shete torim vegomer o shene bene yona", shehu ba al shevuat haedut ben baashirut ben baaniyyut, veal tumat mikdash vekadashav ba bedallut velo baashirut. veamro "veim lo tassig yado", perush, al shevuot haedut hu omer shekkavua lo torim uvene yona, im lo tassig yado hare ze mevi karban hakkavua lishvuat bittuy.

Nimtzeta omer: al shevuat bittuy mevi asirit haefa kevua vaafillu ashir, al shevuat haedut beashro yavi torim uvene yona uveanyo yavi asirit haefa, al tumat mikdash vekadashav ashir yavi kisba o seira, beanyo yavi torim uvene yona aval lo asirit haefa, vehu maamar hattanna: "hachamurim shebbahem yihyu bechisba", perush – hem hu sheyyaviu kisba velo hakkallim shehem shevuat haedut ushevuat bittuy vaafillu beashram. velo chash hattanna alecha shettite sheyyihyu bechisba levad velo betorim uvene yona, shehare tevarcha betziddecha "veim lo taggia yado", ella lomar sheen hakkallim bechisba. veamro "hakkallim beof", perush – hem yaviu velo kal shebbakkallim shehem baale shevuat bittuy yaviu of ella asirit haefa. velo chash alecha litot sheen mevi al shevuat haedut asirit beoni, shehare ketiv "veim lo tassig" vegomer.

Nimtzeta omer sheen kisba ella bechamur velo bishne kallim, veen of bakkal shebbakkallim ella bakkal. veamro hakkallim shebbakkallim yihyu baasirit haefa, perush, velo hechamur shehu tumat mikdash vekadashav baasirit haefa. velo chash alecha litot shebba lishlol shevuat haedut shehare behedya ketiv "veim lo tassig" samuch lo. gam en lomar shebba lishlol sheen kal shebbakkallim betorim uvene yona veen tzarich lomar bechisba, shehare davar ze hu ma shepperesh beamro hachamurim shebbahem bechisba lishlol hakkallim veen tzarich lomar kalle kallim, umeofot gam ken hu ma shemmiet beamro hakkallim beofot lishlol kalle kallim meofot. nimtzeta omer shevuat bittuy enah ella baasirit haefa velo betorim veen tzarich lomar bechisba, ushevuat haedut eno ella betorim uvene yona uveoni baasirit haefa velo bechisba, vetumat mikdash vekadashav enah kol ikkar baasirit haefa ella beosher kisba uveoni torim uvene yona, talmud lomar "meachat meelle", perush, mehashshelosha chattaot haamurot, yavi asirit haefa al kol achat mehashshelosha, vehishvu gam kallim lachamurim meamro "meachat meelle" al ze hadderech "al chattato asher chata meachat", perush, meachat shettihye lo al hakkallim levad ella al kullan. "meelle" chazar vehishva otam paam sheniyya lomar ki elle shavim hem lehavi karban kisba gam al hakkalla shebbakkallot beashro. o sover hattanna ki meamro "achat meelle" hishva otam lechol ma shebbaze yesh baze. veen lomar shessover hattanna kevan shehishva hakkatuv hechamur lakkal baasirit haefa mikkol shekken hakkal bechisba, ze eno, ki anu al hachiyyuv anu danim lechayyevo uminnayin lanu lechayyevo.

Od nire lomar, ki hattanna doresh hashevaat kallim lachamurim sheyyaviu kisba, mimma sheamar hakkatuv bitchillat happarasha (Vayikra 5:5) "vehaya chi yesham leachat meelle vegomer vehevi et ashamo vegomer kisba", hare shehishva otan kallin lachamurim, vechan hishva chamurim lakkallim. vahagam shekkava hadderasha mippasuk echad, samach al pasuk acher lavo lehakeshot, vekava shene hachalukkot bemakom echad, vechen derech hattanna.

Uvaze en anu tzerichin ledachko shel 241 sheamar ki pasuk rishon ba lehashevotam levidduy haamur sham, shezze dochak, ki keshehishva otam hakkatuv veamar "vehitvadda vehevi et ashamo", minnayin timtza lechallek velomar shello hishva ella lismoch mammash, ki bamme chillek hakkatuv lemaamar "vehevi et ashamo"? adrabba, vav samcheh.

Umeatta navo ledayyek amro "mechattato asher chata" al ze hadderech, shello tomar sheen karban ze shel of ba ella al hakkal, shehu shevuat haedut, aval hechamur shehu tumat mikdash vekadashav lo, talmud lomar "asher chata" lerabbot chet chamur, ucheshehizkir parashat dalle dallut ribba gam ken asirit haefa bechullan, meamro "meachat meelle", vaafillu betumat mikdash vekadashav.

Veim tomar, yashmienu bekarban dalle dallut sheyyeshno bechamur umikkol shekken karban dallut. nire lomar ki letzad shebbedalle dallut amar "veim lo tassig yado lishte torim" velo amar keamro befarashat dallut "veim lo taggia yado de se", vedarshu betorat kohanim afillu yesh lo se im en lo tzerachav, hare ze mevi karban ani, uferashnuhu lemala:

Vehinne derashat hattanna haya mimma shello amar kemo sheamar kan "veim lo (taggia) [tassig] yado lishte torim", vechen peresh baal karban aharon, ufashut hu. im ken kan shello amar hakkatuv "de shete torim", haddevarim mochichim ki im yesh lo hare ze chayyav lehavi, afillu hu tzarich lahem. umeatta hutzrach hakkatuv lerabbot beof sheyyavi lechamur shehu tumat mikdash vekadashav, hagam shehaya lo keves, im hu tzarich lo, vehaven:

Gam ma shepperesh rabbenu hillel "veen lo tzerachav", shel se kaamar, yutzdeku devarenu, ki hishmianu sheyyippater baze gam lachamurot shehu tumat mikdash [vekadashav], ma shello haya nishma ze mikkarban asirit haefa.

rashi: Veet damo. sheyare haddam:
Machiti chaav peshaecha. bemitzrayim uvammidbar, gam atta shuva elay:
targum: Mecheti cheeva chovach vechaanan ade kol chetach tuv lefulechani are feraktach:

rashi: Et azkaratah. hi hakkometz:
Betumat adam. zo tumat met:
Lechol tumato. lerabbot tumat magga zavin vezavot:
Asher yitma. lerabbot hannogea bevoel nidda:
Bah. lerabbot bolea nivlat of tahor (sifra):
Venelam. velo yada sheshshachach hattuma:
Veashem. baachilat kodesh o beviat mikdash:

Veim mincha al hammachavat. sheamar hare alay minchat machavat; ucheli hu shehaya bammikdash, sheofin bo mincha zo al haur beshemen, vehakkeli eno amok ella tzaf, umaase hammincha shebbetocho kashin, shemmittoch shehi tzafa, haur soref et hashshemen. vechullan teunot shalosh mattenot shemen — yetzika uvelila umattan shemen bichli kodem laashiyyatan (sham 74):
Solet belula vashshemen. melammed shebbollan beodan solet (menachot 74):
Chanoch lannaar. lefi ma shettelammed lannaar utechannechehu bidvarim, im letov im lera, gam ki yazkin lo yasur mimmenna:
targum: Adrecha letalya likvel orcheh dela chad nesuv niste mineh:

rashi: Veshachat otah lechattat. shettehe shechitatah leshem chattat (zevachim 7):
Chukkat olam. yafe meforash betorat kohanim kol happasuk hazze:
ohc: Chukkat olam vegomer. mikkan pattish lehakkot al kadkod hattoe lomar shello neesar chelev ella shel kadashim, vahare ketiv "chukkat olam ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem", veech yoomad chay pasuk ze im lo neesar ella chelev shel kadashim? vechen peresh betorat kohanim: "chukkat olam" – levet olamim, "ledorotechem" – sheyyinhag ledorot, "bechol moshvotechem" – baaretz uvechutz laaretz, ad kan. vehinne achar sheamar "chukkat olam", ma makom lomar ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem? ella vadday shehakkavvana hu al ze hadderech: "chukkat olam" nimshechet im shellemala shehu al inyan hakkadashim, veamar tihye azhara od ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem "kol chelev" vegomer, vehu amro sheyyinhag ledorot issur hachelev bechol moshvotechem afillu bechutz laaretz, sheyyaale al datecha lomar shello asar ella bizman sheyyeshno karev al gabbe hammizbeach velo bishar zemannim, o afillu bizman sheeno karev, im hu bemakom shehu karev, aval bemakom sheeno karev lo – talmud lomar "ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem". veim yite hattoe sheeno asur ella chelev hakkarev, achar sheamar "chukkat olam" bamme yesh litot shehutzrach lomar "ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem"?

rashi: Kaasher yusar chelev hakkesev. shennitrabbu emurav baalya, af chattat keshehi baa kivsa teuna alya im haemurin:
Al ishshe Adonai. al medurot haesh haasuyot lashshem, paveayyleysh belaaz:
Bene aharon hakkohanim. keshehem bechihunam, ha kohen hedyot sheavad bishmona begadim avodato pesula (zevachim 18):
Et hannetachim et harosh. lefi sheen harosh bichlal hefshet, shekkevar huttaz bishchita, lefichach hutzrach limnoto leatzmo (chullin 27):
Veet happader. lamma neemar? lelammedcha shemmaalehu im harosh umechasse bo et bet hashshechita, vezehu derech kavod shel mala (sham):
Asher al hammizbeach. shello yihyu haggezirin yotzin chutz lammaaracha (sifra):
Lechem ishshe laAdonai. lachmo shel esh leshem gavoah:
Lechem. leshon maachol, vechen nashchita etz belachmo (Yirmeyahu 11), avad lechem rav (Daniel Adonai), lishochok oshim lechem (Kohelet 10):
Heez ish rasha befanav. harasha mare azzuto bishat kaaso:
Befanav. milleshon "af" (Mishlei 29:22):
targum: Machatzef appoy gavra rashia uteritza hu metaken orcheh:

rashi: Al chattato asher chata. kan shinna hakkatuv, shehare baashirut uvedallut neemar mechattato, vechan bedalle dallut neemar al chattato, dikdeku rabbotenu mikkan, sheim chata keshehu ashir vehifrish maot lechisba o seira veheeni, yavi mimmiktzatan shete torim, hifrish maot lishte torim veheeni, yavi mimmiktzatan asirit haefa, hifrish maot laasirit haefa veheeshir, yosif alehen veyavi karban ashir, lechach neemar kan al chattato:

Meachat meelle. meachat mishshalosh kapparot haamurot bainyan — o baashirut o bedallut o bedalle dallut; uma talmud lomar? sheyyachol hachamurim shebbahem yihyu bechisba o seira, vehakkallin yihyu beof, vehakkallin shebbakkalin yihyu baasirit haefa, talmud lomar meachat meelle, lehashevot kallin lachamurin lechisba useira im hissiga yado, veet hachamurin lakkallin laasirit haefa bedalle dallut (sifra):

Vehayta lakkohen kammincha. lelammed al minchat chote sheyyihyu sheyareha neechalin, zehu lefi peshuto; verabbotenu darshu: "vehayta lakkohen" — veim chote ze kohen hu, tehe kishar minchat nidvat kohen, shehi bechalil tihye lo teachel (sifra):
Kechelev zevach hashshelamim. keotan emurin hameforashim beez haamur etzel shelamim:
Yesod mizbach haola asher petach ohel moed. ze yesod maaravi shehu keneged happetach (sham nusach acher):

Nefesh ki techeta. amar rabbi akiva, ma tal umaala maal baAdonai? lefi shekkol hammalve vehallove vehannoshe vehannoten eno ose ella beedim uvishtar, lefichach bizman shehu mechachesh, mechachesh baedim uvashshetar, aval hammafkid etzel chavero eno rotze shetteda bo neshama ella shelishi shebbenehem, lefichach keshehu mechachesh mechachesh bashshelishi shebbenehem (sham):
Vitsumet yad. shessam beyado mamon lehitassek o bemilve:
O vegazel. sheggazal miyyado kelum:
O ashak. hu shochar shachir (sham):
ohc: Nefesh ki techeta umaala vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar ki techeta, veen lanu lefaresh kan ki hachet hu hahachchasha, shehare hu omer "vechichesh baamito". od amro "maal baAdonai" ma shello amar bechol hachattaot. od amro "vechichesh baamito" shello haya tzarich lomar "baamito". gam shiur hatteva eno medukdak.

Veulay ki yodia hakkatuv shelosha anfe resha sheyyaase baal avera zo. haechad netilat davar sheeno shello, hu anaf haggazel. sheni – "umaala maal baAdonai", perush baAdonai kivyachol asa hammaal, perush leshon shinnuy, ki hu shafat al pi hammaasim vezikka laze sheyyihye lo mamon, ucheshezze ba vegozlo nimtza sheggorem meila baAdonai sheshshinna alav et haddin, shello amad beyado mimma shehiggio kefi mishpat Adonai, venimtza Adonai kivyachol nechshad shello asa mishpat tzedek. veulay shekkafal lomar "umaala maal", velo hispik lomar "umaala baAdonai", nitkavven lichlol gam ken tzad haggazlan, ki gam letziddo maal baAdonai kivyachol ki hu dano bechesron hallakuach, vehu notel ma shello niktzav alav bemishpete Adonai. shelishi – "vechichesh baamito", perush shemmarshia et hatztzaddik keshettovea mimmennu pikdono vechulei vehu omer lo "lo hayu devarim meolam", umesimo mechachesh, vehu amro "vechichesh baamito", perush mesim hakkichush baamito, shehu hannigzal mimmennu, mesimo rasha, shettovea davar sheeno shello veomer lo "lamma teshakker alay" veyariv immo. vehinne shene devarim ellu enam ella befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel kesheggozel mimmennu et shello, o oshek sechar sachir, aval bematza aveda en bah kichesh baamito, laze amar hakkatuv bifne atzmah, "o matza aveda vechichesh bah" vegomer:

Od yirmoz shelosha devarim raim haggoremet hannefesh hammurshaat. haechad hi nechseret meorah umimmaalatah, vehu amro "nefesh ki techeta" leshon chissaron bannefesh atzmah. sheni – "umaala maal baAdonai" al derech amru anshe emet ki en lecha nefesh miyyisrael sheen shefa nishmato yored lah lehitkayyem shezzulat ze en lah chiyyut, zulat hannefesh asher alta tzachanatah uvashah beavon pelili laze yikkaret mimmenna hashshefa haelohi, keamro (Bereshit 17:14) "venichreta hannefesh hahi", vederech hashshefa ba derech shene chutin dakkim, derech shene nikve haaf, vehu derech mekom devekut hannefesh im konah, keamro (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem".

Vehinne bachato haadam mehachataim kaelle, hannefesh hahi sholtim bah uveshifah hachitzonim kayyadua, venehenim mehashshefa haelohi harshaim hahem, vezehu amro "umaala maal baAdonai", kivyachol baor hannimshach mimmennu, vehu sod haramuz beamro (Mishlei 28:24) "gozel aviv veimmo vegomer chaver hu leish mashchit", perush letzad shemmitchabber livchinat hara hannikra ish mashchit, vehaven:

Hashshelishi ki gam lichlalut hakkahal hu gorem hachechasha, perush letzad shekkol yisrael keechad raat echad tesovev ra lechol hannetzer, vehu amro "vechichesh baamito" shennaaset amito kechusha mitztziddo rachamana litztzelan, vehu ma sheramuz bappasuk (Mishlei 28:24) "gozel aviv veimmo" veamru zichronam livracha (berachot la:) immo zo keneset yisrael, ki beemtzaut anshe chayil mitrabbe bichlalut am Adonai hashshalom vehattov vehachayyim:
Chassalat parashat Vayikra

rashi: Al yerech hammizbeach. al tzad hammizbeach:
Tzafona lifne Adonai. veen tzafon bevama (sham):
Veshama kol ala. bedavar shehu ed bo — shehishbiuhu shevua, sheim yodea lo beedut, sheyyaid lo (sifra):
ohc: Ki techeta. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan amar "ki techeta", shello haya lo lomar ella "ki tishma kol" vegomer, venire ki leheyot shello hutzrach ze lehashebio laze ala letzad shello ratza lehaid edut sheyyesh lo lizchuto, ki battechilla yishal mimmennu eduto belo hashebaa, veal kefirato kore alav hakkatuv "ki techeta", ki chet hu ze ledabber shekarim, veim shama kol vegomer titchayyev bekarban. uvaze tityashshev vav shel "veshama", sheyyore shezzulat ze hu hachet harashum bo chata.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru beferek shevuat haedut (shavuot 30.): vechayyavin al zedon hashshevua veal shiggatah im zedon haedut, veenan chayyavin al shiggatah, uferesh Rashi: veen chayyavin al shiggatah, im shoggin hem legamre, kisvurin sheen yodin lo edut vechulei. vechatav harambam beferek 1 mehilchot shevuot: ketzad shiggat shevuat haedut, kegon shennelam mimmennu shechayyavin aleha karban veyada sheshshevua zo asura vechulei veshehi sheker, ad kan. hare shehashshegaga shechayyav aleha hu sheyyodea al kol panim shehi asura vesheker, vehu amro nefesh ki techeta, perush, ben bemezid ben beshogeg takkir shechotet, lishlol im shagga shechashva shemmuttar o sheshshachcha haedut, eno chayyav al shevua zo. uveaggadat anshe emet (zohar Vayikra 13:) nidrash pasuk ze al hannefesh biridatah laolam al nachon.

Veshama kol ala. yitbaer al derech ma sheamru beresh perek shevuat haedut (shavuot 30.) veze leshon hammishna: shevuat haedut vechulei bifne bet din veshello bifne bet din, mippi atzmo umippi acherim – en chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bevet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim – enam chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bifne bet din, ad kan. hinne lerabbi meir kol shehi bevet din en tzarich shettihye hashshevua mippi atzmo, ella bishmiat haozen levad mitchayyev. vehu amro veshama kol ala, perush hagam shello ana amen.

Velachachamim, lisvarat haraavad vehaacharonim, kol sheshshama kol ala ben bifne bet din ben shello bifne bet din, afillu lo ana amen, kol shehayta hakkefira bevet din afillu shello bishat hashshevua, chayyav. ulederech ze yeduyyak hakkatuv shebbechol hatztzedadin hu tole haddavar bishmiat kol ala veen tzarich bittuy sefatayim.

Verambam zichrono livracha, hagam sheppasak kachachamim shetztzarich sheyyihye hakkefira bevet din, af al pi chen chillek, sheim hayta hashshevua shello bifne bet din tzarich sheyyaane amen, kammevoar bidvarav beferek 9 halacha 1, uveferek 10 halacha 17. im ken sover shekkol shello bifne bet din lo mehanne mippi acherim ella mippi atzmo, o mippi acherim veana amen shehu kemotzi shevua mippiv, uchemo ma shekkatav bitchillat perek 2 mehilchot shevuot. vehissigo haraavad perek 9 halacha 10, ki en halacha kerabbi meir, veod ben lerabbi meir ben lachachamim ma tzorech sheyyihye habbet din bishat hashshevua, vahalo en makpidin vechulei ella al hakkefira, ad kan. vehakkesef mishne katav shello yada minnayin lo larambam chilluk ze.

Veli nire ki lo nechleku rabbi meir verabbanan ella benishba mippi atzmo chutz levet din velo hayta hakkefira bevet din kol ikkar, dilrabbi meir chayyav mishshum deyalef mishshevuat happikkadon, vedun minna uminna, keshem sheshsham mippi atzmo chayyav, uminna afillu shello bifne bet din chayyav, gam shevuat haedut kemo chen, verabbanan sovrim dun minna veoke beatrah kaamur sham (shavuot lo.), aval benishba mippi acherim shello bifne bet din vehayta hakkefira bevet din en machloket lahem baze, umashma dilchulle alma chayyav.

Ella detamo shel harambam shehitzrich bechol shevua shehayta shello bifne bet din lihyot mippi atzmo, hu mimma ditnan (shavuot lo:) veze leshonam: shevuat haedut ketzad? amar lishnayim bou vehaiduni, shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, o sheamru en anu yodin, mashbia ani alechem veamru amen – hare ellu chayyavin. hishbia alehem chamesh peamim chutz levet din uvau levet din vehodu – peturim, kafru – chayyavin al kol vechulei, ad kan. hare dekatane beferush "veamar amen", manni matnitin? i rabbi meir umayre shello hayta hakkefira bevet din, im ken hava leh machloket veachar kach setam, shebbammishna shekkadma katav rabbi machloket rabbi meir verabbanan, uvemishna zo shelleachareha katav setam kerabbi meir. umimma shemmatzinu sherambam hitzrich hakkefira bevet din afillu nishba mippi atzmo, im ken mefaresh matnitin kerabbanan, vekatane "veamar amen", uvemay? shello bifne vet din, sheim bifne vet din lechol hassevarot en tzarich sheyyomar amen. im ken hare lecha shelledivre chachamim tzarich sheyyomar amen shello bifne vet din.

Vehattosafot katvu shettaam sheamar "veamru amen" hi lekatztzer, vein hache namme im amru "en anu yodim lecha edut", veen ken daat rambam, ella kol shehashshevua chutz levet din tzarich sheyyomar amen dehaynu mippi atzmo. vehattaam hu ki lo amar hakkatuv "veshama kol" hagam shello amar hu mippiv ella bevet din shebbo medabber hakkatuv, dichtiv "im lo yaggid", aval shello bifne vet din tzarich sheyyotzi mippiv.

Vahagam sheamru sham (shavuot lev.) veze leshonam: menalan sheakkefira bevet din hu demichayyeve, achutz lo michayyeve? amar abbaye amar kera "im lo yaggid" vegomer, lo amarti ella bemakom sheim maggid ze mitchayyevin. amar leh rav pappa: i hache, ema shevua gufa bevet din in, shello bevet din lo? lo salka datach, detanya: "leachat" – lechayyev al kol achat. vei salka datach bevet din, mi michayyav al kol achat? vehatnan: hishbia alehen chamesh peamim bifne vet din vechafru – en chayyavin ella achat vechulei, ella lav shema minnah shevua chutz levet din, kefira bevet din. mashma ki hashshevua sheyyeshnah bevet din hi atzmah asher tihye chutz levet din umitchayyev aleha, veim ken afillu hishbiuhu acherim, lo shena bifne bet din lo shena shello bifne bet din.

Lichshennaamod al amittatan shel devarim mishsham degel ammud dino shel rambam zichrono livracha, ki mimma shemmochiach middetanya "leachat" lechayyev al kol achat. vekashe, vahalo "leachat" ketuva bishvuat bittuy veanu oskim bishvuat haedut, veenah doma shevua zo lezo. uvehechreach lomar ki eno mochiach ella lishvua mippi atzmo shellamduha sheyyeshnah bishvuat haedut mishshevuat bittuy bigzera shava detecheta techeta" kaamur sham, velaze mochiach shappir lishvuat haedut benishba mippiv hannilmad mimmenna, aval hishbiuhu acherim shehi shevua hammuzkeret befarashat shevuat haedut, davka bevet din hu shechayyav aleha ki en mochiach kelum milachat", veanu chozrim lema sheddiyyek rav pappa "bevet din in, shello bevet din lo", velo dacha abbaye ledivre rav pappa ella lema sheddikdek bidvarav "shevua vechulei shello bevet din lo" shemmashma sheen chiyyuv shevuat haedut ella bifne bet din, laze shalal ze middato, uleolam mippi acherim davka bevet din uchedaat rambam.

Nimtzenu omrim lederech ze ki amro veshama kol ala hu shehishbiuhu, vahagam shello ana amen, vedavka bevet din kemo sheddiyyek "im lo yaggid". veim hotzi shevua mippiv yitchayyev gam ken al perat hashshevua shechala alav bedin ze miggezera shava detecheta techeta" dishvuat bittuy, uvitnay shettihye hakkefira bevet din. uma shemmassik baggemara (shavuot lev.) "shema minnah shevua chutz levet din", perush, yeshnah lishvua chutz levet din uchegon shevua mippiv.

Umeatta hirvachnu peshat hakkatuv ledaat rambam al nachon, shemmedabber hakkatuv bimtziut echad, vehu shemmashbiin oto bevet din velo higgid bevet din, ushene devarim ellu leikkuv, ben hahashbaa mippi acherim tzericha lihyot bevet din vechutz levet din lo, hagam shehayta hakkefira bevet din bizman acher, vechen hakkefira gam ken tzericha lihyot bevet din, vezulat ze hagam shennishba mippi atzmo shellamduhu mittecheta techeta" mishshevuat bittuy eno chayyav. vehecha shehayta hakkefira bevet din vehashshevua shello bifne bet din lamdinan mishshevuat bittuy im nishba befiv chayyav, vehammaskil yavin sheddino shel rambam meir, vehakkatuv mesayyeo, vehaomer sheshshevua mippi acherim toil shello bifne bet din alav lehavi reaya, ki limmud "leachat" enah ella lenishba mippi atzmo o hishbiuhu acherim veamar amen, dehaynu mippi atzmo:

rashi: Veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem. keren vechomesh lahekdesh:

Kaasher yuram. meotan emurin hameforashin beshor zevach hashshelamim; vechi ma peresh bezevach hashshelamim shelo peresh kan? ella lehakkisho lishlamim, ma shelamim lishman af ze lishmo, uma shelamim shalom laolam, af ze shalom laolam; uvishchitat kodashim matzricho lilmod hemennu sheen lemedin lamed min hallamed bokodashim, beferek ezehu mekoman (zevachim 49):
Al hakkaved al hakkelayot. al rosho veal keraav. kullan leshon tosefet hen, kemo millevad:

ohc: Veim lo taggia yado vegomer. perush, hagam shehiggia yado leyoter mishshete torim ushene bene yona, kol od shello hissig yado de se chaser issar o chaser punedyon, hare ze mevi karban ani.

Uvetorat kohanim darshu yado – en omrim lo lilvot veen omrim lo asok beumanuto vechulei, hattaam mishshum dachaviva mitzva bishatah, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (torat kohanim kan; fesachim sach.) bappasuk "veim lo tassig yado de se", yesh lo se veen lo tzerachav, minnayin sheyyavi karban ani? talmud lomar de se, perush, haya lo leadam ze se aval hu lo litzrachav shel ze haadam, kemo shettomar haya lo o lichsuto o lemichyato, hare hu keillu en lo, vehu sheddikdek lomar "de se" perush beyado lehavi se, veze hagam sheyyesh lo hasse en bechocho lahavio ki hu tzarich lo.

Veraiti lerabbenu hillel shepperesh "tzerachav" – perush, shel se sheen lo, shehaddin hu shehu tzarich lehittappel bo lahavio laazara. veze dochak, ki ma torach baze yoter mehavaat torim uvene yona? veim al godel hakkeves – yolich beyado maot lammikdash vesham yikne. veim letzad shehasse tzarich semicha, vahalo semicha enah meakkevet, velamma yivtal karbano bishvil hassemicha veyavi karban ani? veanu shaninu besof massechet negaim (negaim 94 52): ashir shehikriv karban ani lo yatza. vahagam shebbemassechet negaim shanu lah, hu haddin lechol karban ole veyored, vechen muchach bedivre rambam perek 10 mehilchot shegagot. aval hassemicha enah ella sheyare mitzva, veim lo samach kipper, keamram beresh zevachim (zevachim 6:).

Shuv raiti sheddarshu betorat kohanim befarashat yoledet "im lo timtza yadah" vegomer, yesh lah se veen lah tzerachav minnayin shettavi karban ani? talmud lomar "de se", ad kan. hinne derasha zo tzericha leinyan nesachim, ki hannesachim meakkevin vekarban yoledet ola hu shettaun nesachim. umeatta ribbuy ze sheribba hakkatuv befarasha zo shel chattat ma hu? im lismicha, kashe lamma itzterich lomar "de se" beola, vahalo kal vachomer hu – im bechattat sheen tzeracheha meakkevin mikkol shekken sheyyavi karban ani bishvilah, ola shetztzorcheha meakkevin mikkol shekken sheyyavi karban ani! ella vadday nire kemo shekkatavti, vechen raiti shehiskim harav baal karban aharon.

rashi: Veet kol chelev par. chelbo haya lo lomar, ma talmud lomar par? lerabbot par shel yom hakkippurim lichlayot velachalavim veyoteret (sifra):
Hachattat. lehavi shoire aza lichlayot velachalavim uleyoteret (sham):
Yarim mimmennu. min hamechubbar — shello yenattechennu kodem hasarat chelbo, torat kohanim:
Nasach. leshon yetzika umassecha, vehannun batteva yesod hannofel mimmennu, kegon nun shel 'nashach veshel 'nagaf:
targum: Man avad dachala vetzalma atich bedil dela lahanaa:

rashi: Vetzamchu beven chatzir. betoch amalek, al yede gerim sheyyitvassefu alehem. 'ben chatzir hu amalek, shenneemar alav "vehayta neve tannim chatzir livnot yaana" (Yeshayahu 34:13):
targum: Veyitrabbun tzadikaya rakkichin umefankin kelavlave asav keilan dimshalach sharshohi al nagdin demayin:

rashi: Vechichesh bah. shekkafar al achat mikkol elle asher yaase haadam lachato ulehishshava al sheker lichfirat mamon:
Charash etzim. veim ba laasoto shel etz, vecharash etzim hu, kach darko:
Nata kav. kederech hannaggarim, veal pi hakkav yetaarehu vassered, meyashsher oto bemassor, shekkorin 243 109. yetaarehu. yeyappehu:
Yaasehu bammaktzuot. umachliko berahitni veizmel; maktzuot tirgem yonatan: "izmelayya":
Uvammechuga yetoorehu. leshon "vetaar haggevul" (Yehoshua 15:9), im ba laasot bo tziyyurim agulim, mesabbev oto bammechuga, 536 109:
Ketiferet adam. hi haishsha, shehi tiferet balah:
targum: Nagar ain nafetz bechuta mesar leh bemashkuleta megaze leh beizmelaya uvintzurin meached leh veaved leh kidmut gevar ketushebchat itteta lemittav beveta:

rashi: Mikkol mitzvot Adonai. pershu rabbotenu en chattat baa ella al davar shezzedono lav vecharet (sifra):
Meachat mehenna. mimmikketzat achat mehen, kegon hakkotev beshabbat sham mishshimon, noach minnachor, dan middaniyyel (sham):
ohc: Dabber el bene yisrael vegomer. betorat kohanim darshu bene yisrael meviim chattat velo goyim meviim chattat al sheva mitzvot bene noach. vekashe, minnayin yaale al daat lomar sheyyaviu shehutzrach lemaatam? veim minnedarim unedavot, ma lindarim unedavot sheenam lechappara, tomar bechattat? uchederech sheamru bechullin (chullin 5.) bitzrichut miuta demumar demiateh kera beola uvechattat, deitzterich lemaet mumar beola velo gamrinan leh mimmiut chattat, mishshum dilchappara hu, ma sheen ken ola, ad kan. uminah behecha denitrabbu beola shehi nedavot unedarim sheen lilmod chattat shehi lechappara. venire lomar shehakkavvana hi lishmor shello terabbe goyim miyyittur "nefesh" sheamar hakkatuv, laze amar bene yisrael lemaet goyim, veribbuy nefesh lerabbot gerim.

Vekashe, lo haya lo lichtov lo "bene yisrael" velo "nefesh", vaani yodea shehaggoyim lo mittaam shekkatavnu, vegerim meviin, deminnayin yaale al daat lemaatam. zo enah kushya, ki halo matzinu shehutzrach hakkatuv lerabbotam bitchillat happarasha, dichtiv (Vayikra 1:2) "adam", vedarshu sham betorat kohanim lehavi gerim, veim ken salka datach amena shello ribba otam ella leola velo lechattat, ka mashma lan. veim ken im lo haya miut shemmiet beyittur "bene yisrael" haya tzad lomar ki gerim lo itzterich, mishshum dechevan denitrabbu bitchillat happarasha nitrabbu lechol peratim harshumim bechol happarasha, velo ba ribbuy sheribba beyittur "nefesh" ella lerabbot haggoyim shemmeviin chattat. laze amar "bene yisrael" lemaet goyim, ha lamadta sheamro "nefesh" enah ella lerabbot gerim, velo hispik ribbuy shebbitchillat happarasha letzad madregat chattat adifa meola, gam letzad shehifsik bainyan veen lemedin, laze itzterich. veod nire lomar ki lo miyyittur "bene yisrael" doresh ella mimmashmaut "bene yisrael" yaggid ki lo goyim, uletzad shebbemashmaut "bene yisrael" yitmaatu gam haggerim, laze amar "nefesh" lerabbot haggerim. umeatta hagam ki "bene yisrael" tzericha legufah bechol hattora kullah lehodia lemi baa mitzva zo, mimmela mitmaatim haggoyim.
Nefesh. amru razal (torat kohanim), lerabbot gerim, veim lichlol nashim haya lo lomar "adam ki yecheta", ki adam kolel zachar unekeva, dichtiv (Bereshit 5:2) "vayyikra shemam adam".

Uvederech remez yechavven, ki letzad shennefesh shel adam rasha hi nechseret letzad maase hara beemtzaut heavon bemezid, velaze yikkare harasha bechayyav met, dichtiv (Yechezkel 18:32) "bemot hammet", ki en lo nefesh. vehu gam ken amro (Mishlei 23:2) "im baal nefesh atta". vehodio hakkatuv ki techsar hannefesh gam bechet hashshogeg, haemet shello techsar kullah ella miktzatah, uletzad machsor kaze hu asher amar Adonai ki yavi karban, uvaze titkarev hannefesh lesharshah veyair orah kevattechilla. aval bemezid shettechsar kullah lo yoil takkanat hakkarban, ki en nefesh bammetziut lekarvah ad asher yashuv veyaavor alav yom hakkippurim veyichye, al derech amro (Yechezkel 18:32) "hashivu vichyu".

rashi: Veet kol dam. sheyare haddam (zevachim 25):
ohc: Lifne Adonai. betorat kohanim: ma talmud lomar? amar rabbi nechemya: lefi shemmatzinu befar habba beyom hakkippurim shehu omed lifnim min hammizbeach umazze al happarochet, yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar "hammizbeach lifne Adonai" velo kohen lifne Adonai, ad kan. mashma sheim lo matzinu befar habba beyom hakkippurim lo haya tzarich lehashemienu "lifne Adonai". vekashe, uminnayin ani yodea mekom amidato? umechamat sheen ani yodea mehakkatuv sheyyesh lo makom yadua, navo lomar: ratza – omed lifnim min hammizbeach omed, ratza – omed chutz lammizbeach omed? talmud lomar "lifne Adonai", lomar ki tzarich laamod chutz lammizbeach. velamma hutzrach lomar "lifne Adonai"? od kashe, minnayin makom lidrosh sheyyazze al happarochet vehu chutz lammizbeach? dilma legufa ba sheyyazze al hammizbeach vehu chutz lammizbeach, uchederech amro befar yom kippur (Vayikra 16:18) "veyatza el hammizbeach", uleolam hazzaat happarochet tihye vehu lifnim.

Veillu lo haya lanu ella dikduk ze haya makom leyashshev. ella sheraiti od befarashat achare mot (Vayikra 16:18): tanya "veyatza el hammizbeach", ma talmud lomar? amar rabbi nechemya: lefi shemmatzinu befar habba al hammitzvot shehu omed chutz lammizbeach umazze al happarochet, yachol af ze ken? talmud lomar "veyatza", vehechan haya? "lifne Adonai", ad kan. kashe, ma hi koach kushyat "ma talmud lomar"? vahalo itzterich lomar sheyyetze mimmekomo velo yazze al hammizbeach vehu bifnim. od amro "lefi shenneemar" mashma davka letzad shenneemar, aval zulat shenneemar lo yodienu hakkatuv mekom amidato kesheyyazze al happarochet. veod lefi devarav lo haya lo lomar lo "veyatza" shemmimmennu nitchayyev lomar "lifne Adonai" befar hammitzvot kemo shemmedakdek bidvarav "ma talmud lomar lifne Adonai" lefi shemmatzinu vechulei, velo "lifne Adonai" shemmimmenna nitchayyev lomar "veyatza" befarashat par yom kippur keamro "ma talmud lomar veyatza" lefi shemmatzinu vechulei. veod kashe amro "lefi shemmatzinu befar habba al hammitzvot sheomed chutz lammizbeach umazze al happarochet", hechan matzinu sheamar hakkatuv ken? veim meamro "lifne Adonai", dilma al hazzaat hammizbeach hu omer kifshat hakkatuv velo al hazzaat happarochet. veod nire anachnu, im lo haya omer lo "veyatza" velo "lifne Adonai" ayye mekom kevod amidato, veim ken ech yachol tanna lomar "ma talmud lomar" bishnehem?

Achen derashat hattanna hi keseder ze, ki im lo amar hakkatuv lo "veyatza" velo yittur "lifne Adonai", pashut hu shennishpot bo sheyyachol lehazzot ben al happarochet ben al hammizbeach bechol ofen sheyyihye, ben hammizbeach bifnim ben hu bifnim. veachar shebba hakkatuv vezachar befar helem mitzvat mizbeach bifnim, ufeshat hakkatuv hu al hazzaat mizbeach, vezachar befar yom kippur gam ken mizbeach bifnim, kaamur "veyatza el hammizbeach", uvifrat ze hushvu par yom kippur im par hammitzvot. gam hishmianu befar yom kippur shehazzaat parochet tihye vehu bifnim, ki meamro "veyatza" mikkelal shehaya bifnim. vehinne haddaat notenet shehu haddin befar hammitzvot tihye hazzaat happarochet vehu lifnim mehammizbeach, veyillamed ma shechaser befar helem mippar yom hakkippurim, venimtzeu par yom kippurim ufar hammitzvot shavim sheyyazze al happarochet vehu lifnim veyetze veyazze al hammizbeach. asher al ken ba hattanna vehotzi davar ze millev shomea bechoach hadderasha, veamar: "lifne Adonai" ma talmud lomar? perush, achar sheamar hakkatuv befar yom kippurim "veyatza", ha lamadta shehazzaat hammizbeach tihye umizbeach lifnim, im ken lamma hutzrach lomar kan "lifne Adonai"? im lelammed ba shello yazze al hammizbeach vehu bachutz, eno tzarich, veyillamed hakkol mippar yom kippurim. veteretz rabbi nechemya ki hutzrach lomar "lifne Adonai", perush, mimma sheanu roim shello ratza hakkatuv lilmod par mitzvot mippar yom kippurim, hare ze mare baetzba sheen dome lo. uvamme en dome lo? lefi shemmatzinu bo perat echad shello huzkar befar hammitzvot, vehu hazzaat happarochet vehu bifnim. vehu amro: "lefi shemmatzinu befar yom kippurim shehu omed lifnim umazze al happarochet", veim hayiti dan par mitzvot mimmennu hayiti yachol lomar gam ze, talmud lomar "lifne Adonai" vechulei. umeatta amro "mizbeach lifne Adonai" sholel kohen lifne Adonai bechol hahazzaot, ben shel mizbeach ben shel parochet, sheal mi samach alav hakkatuv lehavin ayye mekom amidato bishat hazzaat parochet? im lilmod mippar yom kippur nilmad gam ken hakkol, ella vadday shekkana lo mekomo "mizbeach lifne Adonai" velo kohen lifne Adonai bechol hahazzaot haamurim beinyan ze. uvefasuk "veyatza" haamur beyom hakkippurim darash al ze hadderech: ma talmud lomar? perush, mashmaut peshat hakkatuv hu shello yazze al hammizbeach ad sheyyetze, umashmienu gam ken shekkodem keshehizza al happarochet haya lifnim.

Vehinne derasha rishona nishmaat bakkatuv shetztzarich latzet lehazzot al hammizbeach, aval hazzaat parochet shetztzarich laamod bifnim en hechreach baddavar, veyachol lehazzot ben shehu lifnim ben shehu lachutz, uletzad ki reshut yesh lo laamod bemakom sheyyirtze lehazzot al happarochet hizhir hakkatuv shekkesheyyigmor bifnim lehazzot al happarochet yetze lehazzot al hammizbeach. laze ba hattanna veamar hadderasha shebbishvilah bana hakkushya, vehu, lefi shemmatzinu befar habba al hammitzvot shehu omed vechulei, perush hagam shello huzkar sham ella gabbe hazzaat hammizbeach velo lamadnu al hazzaat happarochet ella mimma shello lamad mippar yom kippur vehutzrach lomar "lifne Adonai", af al pi chen lefi ma sheanu danim alav atta hu im lo neemar befar yom kippur "veyatza" ella "lifne Adonai" shebbefar helem, uvimtziut ze kesheani ba ladun al mekom amidato bishat hazzaat happarochet hayiti omer ki ratza omed bifnim ratza omed bachutz, shello hikpid hakkatuv ella al hazzaat hammizbeach shetztzarich sheyyaamod bachutz, aval bishat hazzaato al happarochet en ikkuv baddavar. nimtzeta omer ki yachol laamod bechutz lammizbeach umazze al happarochet, vehu amro "lefi shemmatzinu vechulei shehu omed chutz lammizbeach umazze al happarochet yachol gam ze ken talmud lomar veyatza", perush, leikkuva, shetztzarich laamod bifnim bishat hazzaat happarochet, sheim atta omer reshut lo haya tzarich lo lomar velomed ani mippar helem. ha lamadta shemmikkoach amro "lifne Adonai" befar helem atta mitchayyev lomar ki amro "veyatza" befar yom kippur ba lomar shetztzarich laamod bifnim bishat hazzaa al happarochet, sheim reshut lo haya tzarich lomar, vehaya lamed mippar helem shene devarim: shetztzarich laamod behazzot al hammizbeach bachutz, uvehazzot al happarochet yaamod bemakom sheyyirtze. ha lamadta meamro "veyatza" shene devarim: shetztzarich laamod bifnim kesheyyazze al happarochet, vetzarich laamod bachutz kesheyyazze al hammizbeach. ulefi ze nityashshevu tzarich iyyun shehinniach harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi befarashat achare mot (Vayikra 16:18) bidrashat "veyatza", veayyen sham devarav.

Ella shetztzarich lachakor zot, lefi barayta zot shehichricha amidat penim behazzaat happarochet mimma shello lamad par yom kippur mippar helem, im ken keshennachzor lehavin barayta delifne Adonai" lamma neemar vechulei, kashe – vahalo tzarich ladaat "lifne Adonai", shezzulatah lo hayiti yodea ki kavvanat amro "veyatza" hu lehatzerich amida bifnim behazzaat happarochet kannizkar. umeatta nachzor lema shehaya ole al datenu lomar ki gam befar helem yaamod bifnim bishat hazzaa al happarochet kasseder haamur befar yom kippur. ma tomar, lamma hutzrach lomar? itzterich kede legallot al par yom kippur shechova laamod bifnim behazzaat happarochet kaamur, shezzulat ze hayiti omer reshut. veyesh lomar ki sover hattanna shello tavo "lifne Adonai" laasot mimmennu pilpul ze levad, dehaynu lehakeshot yilmod mimmennu par yom kippur umimma shello lamad vechulei kannizkar, ki en ze derech hakkatuv, sheal kol panim tihye tzericha lilmod davar legufah, sheim lo haya kavvanat Adonai ella legallot al "veyatza" kannizkar haya lo lefaresh haddavar bimkomo befar yom kippur.
Od nire lomar, ki kevan shedderasha zo tzodeket keshennakdim lehakeshot lamma neemar "lifne Adonai" veyillamed mivyatza", lamma tiddache derasha zo meidach, hilkach lamdinan tarvayyhu.

rashi: Roe efer lev hutal hittahu. libbo asher hutal, hittahu laasot lo roe shel efer haddemut, shennisraf chetzyo venaasa efer. hashshote hazze haya omer shehu lo leroe ulemfarnes. davar acher: roe efer leshon 'reut, oved avodat acherim umechabber elav avodat acherim shehi efer:
Velo yatztzil. hannite et nafsho lemor halo sheker bimini, veyippared mealav:
targum: Ha dechalta falge kitma libbe shatya ataye vela yeshezev yat nafshe vela yemar hala shikra avadet bimini:

rashi: Ki chattat hiv. veen baddin sheyyehe karbano mehuddar (menachot 6):
Ki yecheta veashem. kesheyyakkir beatzmo lashuv bitshuva, uvedato lehitvaddot ki chata veashem:
Vezarku. shete mattanot shehen arba; veal yede hakkeli hu zorek, veeno noten baetzba ella chattat (zevachim 55):
Melach berit. shehabberit keruta lammelach mishsheshet yeme bereshit, shehuvtechu hammayim hattachtonim likkarev bammizbeach bammelach venissuch hammayim bechag:
Al kol korbancha. al olat behema vaof veemure kol hakkadashim kullan (menachot 20):
Beerkecha leasham. baerech haamur lemala:
Asher shagag vehu lo yada. ha im yada leachar zeman, lo nitkapper lo beasham ze ad sheyyavi chattat, ha lema ze dome? leegla arufa shennitarfa veachar kach nimtza hahoreg, hare ze yehareg (sham):
Anochi anochi. ani hu shemmechitim meaz, vaani moche otam gam atta:
Lemaani. lo bizchutecha velo betzidkat avotecha:
targum: Ana hu shavek lechovach bedil shemi vechetach la yidkerun:

rashi: Veshissa. en shissua ella bayyad, vechen hu omer beshimshon vayshasseehu keshassa haggedi vegomer (Shoftim 14):
Vichnafav. im kenafav — eno tzarich limrot kanfe notzato:

Vichnafav. notza mammash; vahalo en lecha hedyot shemmeriach reach kenafayim nishorafim veen nafsho katza alav, velamma amar hakkatuv yakriv? kede sheyyehe hammizbeach shavea umehuddar bekarbano shel ani (316 3):

Lo yavdil. eno mefarko legamre, lishte chatichot, ella koro miggabbo; neemar baof reach nichoach veneemar babbehema reach nichoach, lomar lecha echad hammarbe veechad hammamit uvilvad sheyyechavven et libbo lashshamayim (sifra):
ohc: Ishshe reach nichoach. razal amru (menachot 110): neemar beolat behema "ishshe reach" vegomer, veneemar beolat haof "ishshe" vegomer, lomar lecha echad hammarbe veechad hammamit vechulei, ad kan. hinne nitkavvenu razal letaretz ma shekkashe ki yomar hakkatuv "ishshe reach nichoach" baof shehu shave isar, umikkol shekken beolat habbehema. laze dikdeku bilshonam veamru, lomar lecha echad hammarbe vechulei, perush shebba hakkatuv lehodienu sheen hefresh ben hammuat lamrubbe, shello tomar sheen ze ella letzad she mitztzad rachamav mitratztze bekarban heani hagam sheeno chashuv kekarban heashir, veal kol panim en hammuchash nichchash ki ze mevi par veze mevi of. laze nitchakkem hakkatuv veamar "reach nichoach" babbehema velo hispik lo bema sheamar baof lilmod mimmennu, lehaircha uleharotcha ki lo pachut hu mikkarban behema lilmod mimmennu, vetzarich hu lehodiacha gam bekarban behema "ishshe reach nichoach". vehu ma sheddikdek hattanna beamro neemar veneemar vechulei, perush, velo hispik lo lomar haddavar bammadrega hakketanna, nitkavven lomar lecha baze, echad hammarbe veechad hammamit, perush, behashevaa hem. velaze lo amar hattanna "lomar hammemaet kammarbe" sheaz batla lah hakkavvana shepperashti bidvarav, ki keshennaggia lomar ze kaze yitchayyev lomar ki hannilmad katan mehamelammed kemishpat harav vetalmido. umiddikduk leshon amro "echad veechad" hare ze mare beetzba hassechel ki en haderaga leechad mechavero. uvaze hu shehissig terutz lamma lo amar "reach nichoach" baof, ki ba lelammedenu davar ze sheen maala leashir beshoro velo kelum. umittaam ze gam ken hutzrach lomar "ishshe reach nichoach" batztzon velo hispik babbakar vaof shehem shene ketzavot, ki beinyan ze en davar nilmad mechavero letzad hammuva.

rashi: Ashir berashim yimshol. am haaretz tzarich letalmid chacham leolam (shabbat kalat.):
targum: Attira bemiskene nishtalet veavda yozif legavra mozfana:

rashi: Veet kol hachelev vegomer. lehavi chelev sheal hakkeva divre rabbi yishmael, rabbi akiva omer lehavi chelev sheal haddakkin (sham):

Asham hu asham asham. harishon kullo kamutz, shehu shem davar, vehaacharon chetzyo kamatz vechetzyo pattach shehu leshon paal; veim tomar mikra shello letzorech hu, kevar darush hu betorat kohanim, asham asham — lehavi asham shifcha charufa sheyyehe ayil ben shete selaim, yachol sheani merabbe asham nazir vaasham metzora, talmud lomar hu (sham):
Chelbo. hammuvchar shebbo, umahu? ze haalya temima:
Leummat heatze. lemala min hakkelayot hayyoatzot:
Veshachat vehikrivu, hakkohanim. mikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna — limmed al hashshechita shekkeshera bezar (sham):
Lifne Adonai. baazara:
Vehikrivu. zo kabbala, shehi harishona, umashmaah leshon holacha, lamadnu shetehen:
Bene aharon. yachol chalalim, tal hakkohanim:

Et haddam vezarku et haddam. ma tal dam dam shene peamim? lehavi et shennitarev bemino o besheeno mino, yachol af bifsulim o bechattaot happenimiyyot o bechattaot hachitzoniyyot, sheellu lemala vehi lematta, tal bemakom acher damo (zevachim 81):

Vezarku. omed lematta vezorek min hakkeli lechotel hammizbeach lematta michut hassikra keneged hazzaviyyot, lechach neemar saviv — sheyyehe haddam natun bearba ruchot hammizbeach; o yachol yakkifennu kechut, tal vezarku vei efshar lehakkif bizrika, i vezarku yachol bizrika achat, tal saviv, ha ketzad? noten shete mattanot shehen arba (sifra):
Asher petach ohel moed. velo bizman shehu meforak (sham):
Vehikrivo. afillu pereda achat yavi (sifra):
Hakkohen, umalak. en melika bichli ella beatzmo shel kohen, kotzetz betzipparno mimmul haoref vechotech mafrakto ad shemmaggia lassimanin vekotztzan (sham):
Venimtza damo. leshon mitz appayim (Mishlei 30), ki afes hammetz (Yeshayahu 16), kovesh bet hashshechita al kir hammizbeach vehaddam mitmatztze veyored (zevachim 65):

Umalak, vehiktir, venimtza. elo ken meachar shehu maktir hu motze? ella ma haketara harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo, af melika ken. ufeshuto shel mikra mesoras hu — umalak vehiktir, vekodem haketara venimtza damo kevar:
Vechol devash. kol metikat peri keruya devash:
Veish shomea. shekkibbel ma shekkatuv battora "lo taane vereacha vegomer" (Shemot 20:13):
Lanetzach. tamid:
targum: Sahada dechadavuta yevad vegavra shamoa sherirait memalel:

rashi: O hoda. kemo im hoda haddavar; harebe o yesh shemmeshammeshin bilshon im, veim bimkom o, vechen o noda ki shor naggach hu (Shemot 21):
Hoda elav. keshechata haya savur shehu hetter, uleachar mikkan noda lo sheissur haya:
ohc: O hoda. amro "o", letzad shekkadam veamar "veashem", veamru zichronam livracha (torat kohanim 4:23) melammed shemmevi asham taluy im nistappek, laze amar "o hoda" perush im hoda elav vadday.

rashi: Et pene happarochet. ulemala hu omer et pene parochet hakkodesh mashal lemelech shessarcha alav medina, im miutah sarcha, pamalya shello mitkayyemet veim kullah sarcha, en pamalya shello mitkayyemet, af kan, keshechata kohen mashiach adayin shem kedushshat hammakom al hammikdash, mishshechatu kullam, chas veshalom nistalleka hakkedushsha (zevachim 41):
Ki timol maal. en meila bechol makom ella shinnuy, vechen hu omer vayyimalu velohe avotehem vayyiznu achare elohe amme haaretz (20 Adonai), vechen hu omer besota umaala vo maal (Bamidbar Adonai):

Vechata bishgaga mikkodshe Adonai. shennehena min hahekdesh; vehechan huzhar? neemar kan chet, veneemar lehallan chet bitruma, velo yishou alav chet (Vayikra 22), ma lehallan hizhir, af kan hizhir; i ma lehallan lo hizhir ella al haochel, af kan lo hizhir ella al haochel, talo timol maal — ribba (sifra):
Mikkodshe Adonai. hameyuchadim lashshem, yatzu kadashim kallim (sham):
Ayil. leshon kashe, kemo veet ele haaretz lakach (Yechezkel 17), af kan kashe — ben shete shanim (sifra):
Beerkecha kesef shekalim. sheyyehe shave shete selaim:
Ish machsor. mi sheohev simchat mishte tamid:
targum: Gavra di chasar leh verachem chedvata verachem chamra uvisma la netar:

rashi: Chattat hiv. nikmetza veniktera lishmah keshera, shello lishmah pesula:
Nivchar shem meosher rav. shem tov:
Mikkesef umizzahav. nivchar chen tov:
targum: Shema tava itbechar min utera sagia umikkaspa umin dahava shappir chisda:

rashi: Lo kanita li vakkesef kane. liktoret lo hutzrachta liknotah bechesef, lefi shehayta metzuya beartzechem harebe. amar rabbi abba: kinnamoniyya hayta gedela beeretz yisrael, vehayu ochlin otah izzim utzevayim (Eicha Rabba Petichta 10):

Heevadtani bechattovtecha. attem geramtem li lihyot shammash leovde pesilim, kemo sheraa yechezkel "vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon" (Yechezkel 1:4), shehayta chozeret merkevet hashshechina mibbavel, shehalcha lichbosh et kol haolam tachat yado shel nevuchadnetztzar, shello yomru beyad umma shefala masar et banav, kidita bachagiga (chagiga 13 2):
targum: La zeventa kodamay bichsaf kani besam uterav nichsat kudeshach la dehenta al madbechi beram asgeta kodamay bechovach atkefta kodamay baavayatach:

ohc: Vehikriv vegomer et hakkol vehiktir vegomer. hinne kevar amar ze befarashat olat ben bakar, veen lomar shennitkavven lerabbot ma sheen beven bakar, vehu hatztzemer shebberashe kevasim vehassear shebbizkan hatteyashim, shekkol ellu lo hayu nishmaim meamro "et hakkol" beolat ben bakar, shehare matzinu sheddarshu betorat kohanim tzemer usear hatteyashim mippasuk haamur beolat bakar, umashma lahem ki maamar "et hakkol", hagam shello nichtav ella babbakar, yeshno gam batztzon bechol hashshayyach bahem. veod, kan lo amar "hakkol" ella bahakerava velo samuch lahaketara, vedarshu razal (torat kohanim kan) beamro "vehikriv et hakkol" vegomer – zo aliyyat kevesh shetztzarich kohen, sheddin ze lo nishma beolat bakar. im ken haketarat hammizbeach beolat tzon lamma itzterich?
Venire lefaresh al pi ma sheamru betorat kohanim, veze leshonam: "vehiktir" – af al pi sheyyotze, af al pi sheppasul, af al pi sheppiggul venotar vechulei, keshehen berosh hammizbeach, ad kan.

Vekashe minnayin matza tanna lidrosh hetter happesulin legabbe hammizbeach. veharav baal karban aharon peresh middela katav "vehiktiram" mashma sheyyaktir mikkol makom, ad kan. lidvarav zichrono livracha yitchayyev lidrosh kemo chen beamro "vehikriv et hakkol" mimma shello amar "vehikrivam" sheyyakriv mikkol makom afillu pesulin, umiddeha leta ha nammi leta. vehannachon hu shehattanna doresh lah miyyittur "vehiktir" "vehiktir" shete peamim, vehu kushyatenu atzmah, shello haya lo lomar ella beechad mishshene mekomot, o beolat bakar o beolat tzon, ella vadday lidrasha ba lerabbot haketarat pesulin venotar vechulei achar shealu hammizbecha:

Ola hu. amar "hu", darshu betorat kohanim shebba leakkev shechita batztzafon bediavad, sheim lo shachat batztzafon pesula. velaze lo katva hattora haribbuy ella befarasha shennizkera bah tzafona, lomar ki al perat ze ba hammiut, velo ketavo befarashat ben bakar shehuzekar sham hassemicha, ki adrabba aleha ba ribbuy tevat "ola" (Vayikra 1:9) sheenah meakkevet semicha haamura sham. vahagam shehakkatuv amar chelek meharibbuyim umehammiutim meechad vechelek meharibbuyim vehammiutim beechad, veanu omrim keillu amar kol haribbuyim vehammiutim bechol echad mehem, shane perat ze kevan shehizkir shete mitzvot, shehem semicha vetzafon, umiet veribba veen yadua leezo mehem miet uleezo mehem ribba, darshinan hassamuch lammiut vehassamuch laribbuy, uma matzinu, ma samach leribbuy semicha ma samach lemiut tzafon. vahagam ki gam sham neemar ribbuy, ba lenittuach sheeno meakkev kehefshet shennitmaet baribbuy shehuzekar beolat bakar. veyesh od leharechiv tzedadim sheyyeshnam bainyan, vehammaskil yavin meatzmo.

Uvabberayta (torat kohanim kan) natan taam sheddarshu haribbuy al hassemicha sheenah meakkevet, umiut hu al hatztzafon shemmeakkev, ki hassemicha enah bechol haolot, sheolat tzibbur enah teuna semicha vechulei. veulay ki leravcha demilleta amru chen, ki hagam shehaya haddavar shakul yuchra mittaam shekkatavnu, vahagam shehashshete parashiyyot inyan echad hem, af al pi chen lehacheria safek kaze yaspik. vetimtza bidrashat "ola hu" haamura baof darshu razal betorat kohanim kemo chen "ola" lerabbot afillu lo mitztza dam harosh, "hu" lemaet im lo mitztza dam hagguf, ad kan, vehiksha baggemara (zevachim 66:) may talmuda, umeshanne mishshum derov damim bagguf shechiche, ad kan. hare devisvara matte hassafek, vediyyukenu mehakkatuv adif:

rashi: Venefesh ki takriv. lo neemar nefesh bechol karbenot nedava ella bammincha, mi darko lehitnaddev mincha? ani. amar hakkabba, maale ani alav keillu hikriv nafsho (menachot 104):

Solet yihye korbano. haomer hare alay mincha setam, mevi minchat solet, shehi harishona shebbammenachot venikmetzet keshehi solet, kemo shemmeforash bainyan; lefi shenneemru kan chamishsha mine menachot, vechullan baot afuyot kodem kemitza chutz mizzo, lechach keruya minchat solet:
Solet. en solet ella min hachittin, shenneemar solet chittim (Shemot 29), veen mincha pechuta meissaron, shenneemar veissaron solet … lemincha (Vayikra 14) — issaron lechol mincha:
Veyatzak aleha shemen. al kullah:

Venatan aleha levona. al miktzatah — manniach kometz levona aleha letzad echad. uma raita lomar ken? sheen ribbuy achar ribbuy battora ella lemaet; davar acher: shemen al kullah, mippene shehu nivlal immah venikmatz immah, kemo shenneemar missaltah umishshamnah, ulevona al miktzatah, sheenah nivlelet immah velo nikmetzet immah, shenneemar al kol levonatah, shelleachar shekkamatz melakket et hallevona kullah mealeha umaktirah (sifra):
Veyatzak, venatan, vehevia. melammed sheyyetzika uvelila kesherim bezar (sham):
ohc: Venefesh vegomer. betorat kohanim darshu yittur "venefesh" sheyyesh bo miut veribbuy: miut "nefesh" leshon yachid – lemaet tzibbur shello yaviu minchat nedava, ribbuy beyitron havvav – lerabbot yachid sheeno mevi mincha al tumat mikdash vekadashav, shehu kohen mashiach, shemmevi minchat nedava.

Vetaam hakkatuv shekkatav kan ribbuy umiut beteva achat. ulay ki letzad shello huchrach lemaet hatztzibbur ella letzad sheribba kohen mashiach, laze ramaz shenehem yachad hagam shehem shene devarim hafekiyyim, ki lule ribbuy kohen mashiach en tzorech lemaet tzibbur, ki minnayin yaale al datenu sheyyaviu sheyyutzrach lemaet, veachar shebba ribbuy kohen mashiach yetze lanu din chadash sheyyeshno bimlammed letzibbur, keamram sham betorat kohanim, laze hutzrach lemaet:

rashi: Yahir. gas ruach, sofo lihyot letz sheeno chash lishmoa musar:
targum: Memikna mericha zedana shemeh aved cheryana bezedanuteh:

rashi: Tov shevet beeretz midbar. gam ze al silluk hashshechina neemar:
targum: Tav lemittav baara madbera min itteta tagranita umargezanita:

rashi: Al haola. millevad haola; limmedanu shettikdom olat tamid lechol karban al hammaaracha (zevachim 89):
Al rosh haola. lehavi olat chova lismicha ulehavi olat hatztzon (sham):
Haola. perat leolat haof (sham):
Venirtza lo. al ma hu meratztze lo? im tomar al karetot umitot bet din o mita bide shamayim o malkut, hare anshan amur, ha eno meratztze ella al ashe veal lav shennittak laashe (sham):
O nefesh asher tigga vegomer. uleachar hattuma hazzo yochal kadashim o yikkanes lammikdash, shehu davar shezzedono karet; bemassechet shevuot (daf 14) nidrash ken:
Venelam mimmennu. hattuma:
Veashem. baachilat kodesh o beviat mikdash:
Zachar. velo nekeva; keshehu omer zachar lematta — sheen talo — zachar velo tumtum veanderoginos:
Tamim. belo mum:

El petach ohel moed. metappel bahavaato ad haazara; mahu omer yakriv yakriv? afillu nitarva olat reuven beolat shimon yakriv kol echad leshem mi shehu, vechen ola bechullin, yimmachru hachullin letzarche olot, vahare hen kullan olot, vetikrav kol echad leshem mi shehu; yachol afillu nitarva bifsulin o besheeno mino, talmud lomar "yakrivennu" (sifra):
Yakriv oto. melammed shekkofin oto, yachol beal karcho, talmud lomar "lirtzono", ha ketzad? kofin oto ad sheyyomar rotze ani (sham):
Lifne Adonai vesamach. en semicha bevama (sham):
ohc: Im ola karbano. kashe lamma shinna mishshete parashiyyot hassedurot achare zot "veim min hatztzon vegomer leola", "veim min haof ola", gam kan haya lo lomar "im min habbakar ola" vegomer? veyitbaer al pi hassevara sheamru betorat kohanim (3:20) bema sheamar hakkatuv lemala mizze "et karbanchem", melammed shehi baa nidvat tzibbur, ad kan. laze amar samuch leamro "karbanchem" im ola, perush, davka ola hi sheani mattir shebbaa nidvat tzibbur velo shelamim, kidtanya (torat kohanim 3) shelamim en bain nidvat tzibbur.

Od, im haya omer hakkatuv "im min habbakar ola" haya nishma shello hittir lehavi ola ella min habbakar velo min hatztzon, laze amar im ola lomar ki ma shemmerabbe beamro "karbanchem" hu perat haola, ben im yihye min habbakar ben im yihye min hatztzon. veen litot beolat haof, shehare beer hakkatuv veamar "karbano" yetera kemo sheddarshu betorat kohanim lemaet tzibbur meolat haof.

Uvetorat kohanim (3:21) amru, veze leshonam: "ola" ma talmud lomar? sheyyachol lo yihyu kol happesulim ellu nohagim ella beolat nedava, olat chova minnayin vechulei? talmud lomar "im ola", ad kan. nire shehuksha lahem shehaya lo lomar "im karbano ola", vedarshu sheim haya omer "im karbano ola" az yihye nishma shemmedayyek hakkatuv beolat nedava shebbah mishtae kera, dichtiv "ki yakriv" reshut, veamar "im ola" perush kol ola shebbaolam ben shel chova ben shel nedava. veharaavad zichrono livracha peresh shettevat "ola" meyutteret, shehaya lo lismoch al zichronah levassof, vehu dochak:

Karbano. betorat kohanim darshu shebbaa lerabbot shelamim sheyyeshnam bechol happesulin harshumim, veen lomar shellemaatam ba hakkatuv velomar "karbano" haamur shehu ola velo shelamim, ki ze eno tzarich lemaet, ki mehecha tete leesor, velo darshu "karbano" bechinnuy shehu yoter pashut bakkatuv, ki hare hotziu din ze mikarbano" haamura beolat tzon (Vayikra 1:10).

rashi: Vayyikra el moshe. lechol dibberot ulechol amirot ulechol tziuuyim kadma keria, leshon chibba, lashon shemmalache hashsharet mishtammeshin bo, shenneemar vekara ze el ze (Yeshayahu 6), aval linvie ummot haolam nigla alehen bilshon arai vetuma, shenneemar vayyikkar elohim el bilam (Bamidbar 23):

Vayyikra el moshe. hakkol holech umaggia leaznav vechol yishorael lo shomin; yachol af lehafesakot hayta keria, tal vaydabber — ledibbur hayta keria velo lehafesakot, ume hayu hafesakot meshammeshot? litten revach lemoshe lehitbonen ben parasha lefarasha uven inyan leinyan; kava lehedyot hallomed min hahedyot:

Elav. lemaet et aharon; Rabbi yehuda omer 13 dibberot neemru battora lemoshe uleaharon uchenegdan neemru 13 miutin, lelammedcha shello leaharon neemru ella lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon, veellu hen 13 miutin: ledabber itto, middabber elav, vaydabber elav (Bamidbar 7), venoadti lecha (Shemot 25) — kullan betorat kohanim. yachol yishmeu et kol haddibbur talo kol lo, kol elav, moshe shomea vechol yishorael lo shamu:

Meohel moed. melammed shehaya hakkol nifsak velo haya yotze chutz laohel; yachol mippene shehakkol namuch, tal et hakkol, mahu hakkol? hu hakkol hameforash bithillim kol Adonai bakkoach kol Adonai behadar kol Adonai shover arazim (Tehillim 29), im ken lamma neemar meohel moed? melammed shehaya hakkol nifsak. kayyotze bo vekol kanfe hakkeruvim nishma ad hechatzer hachitzona (Yechezkel 10), yachol shehakkol namuch tal kekol el shadday bedabbero, im ken lamma neemar ad hechatzer hachitzona? shekkevvan shemmaggia sham haya nifsak:
Meohel moed lemor. yachol mikkol habbayit, tal meal hakkapporet, yachol meal hakkapporet kullah, tal mibben shene hakkeruvim:

Lemor. tze veemor lahem divre kibbushin — bishvilchem hu nidbar immi; shekken matzinu shekkol 38 shana shehayu yishorael bammidbar kimnuddim, min hameraggelim vaelach, lo nityached haddibbur im moshe, shenneemar vayhi chaasher tammu kol anshe hammilchama lamut … vaydabber Adonai elay lemor (Devarim 2), elay haya haddibbur. davar acher tze veemor lahen devaray vahashiveni im yekabbelum, kema shenneemar vayyashev moshe et divre haam vegomer (Shemot 19):
ohc: Vayyikra vegomer. taam hakkeria, velo hispik haddibbur levad, amru betorat kohanim ki bishlosha mekomot kadma hakkeria ledibbur: bassene, vesinay, veohel moed, velo matzinu lilmod ohel moed lo missene velo missinay. missene sheyyesh bo revuta shehaya techilla lechol haddibberot, sinay yesh bo revuta shehu lechol yisrael, veen lilmod mehem shel ohel moed. gam en lilmod ohel moed mitztzad hashshave shebbassene vesinay, ki yesh lomar ma latztzad hashshave shehayu baesh ma sheen ken ohel moed.

Hinne ma sheamru shenneemra keria besinay, katav harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shehu pasuk "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii" vegomer (Shemot 24:16), o "vayyikra Adonai lemoshe el rosh hahar" (Shemot 19:20), aval lo middichtiv "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar" (Shemot 19:3) kemo shepperesh rabbenu hillel, ki kera ze lo im esh neemar, uvarayta katane ma latztzad hashshave shehaya baesh vechulei ad kan. uvimchila mikkevodo lo dak baze, ki haemet hu shehallimmud hu ledibbur hu mippasuk "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar", ki "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hazze" en otah keria meyutteret veitztericha legufa shekkara lo laalot lashevet bahar arbaim yom kaamur sham "vayyikra el moshe vegomer vayyavo moshe vegomer vayhi moshe bahar arbaim yom", ukeria zo bimkom dibbur hi. vehakkeria sheanu danim bah keria shehi ledibbur, umazkir keria vedibbur. gam "vayyikra Adonai lemoshe el rosh hahar" shekkeria zo tzorech aliyya hayta, ki moshe haya lematta vekara lo laalot el rosh hahar vesham dibber elav, veim lo amar "vayyikra" vehaya medabber immo haya medabber immo vehu lematta min hahar, veanu roim shello dibber elav ad achar alot, veech yihye pe velashon lomar shello haya lo lomar ella "vaydabber". aval pasuk "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar" roim anu ki tachlit hakkeria lo haya ella lomar elav "ko tomar" vegomer, udevarim ellu amaram elav sham vehu lematta mibbeli alot, im ken ma tivah shel keria zo, enah ella kedima ledibbur.

Uma shennistayyea harav befasuk "vayyikra el moshe" (Shemot 24:16) mimma sheamar hakkatuv achar amro "vayyikra vaydabber vegomer veyikchu li" vegomer, lo heiru lemul pene harav bishne ketuvim uvahem shene inyanim shehifsiku ben hakkeria laddibbur: haechad "umare kevod Adonai" vegomer vehashsheni "vayyavo moshe vechulei vayhi sham bahar arbaim yom" vegomer, veachar ze amar hakkatuv "vaydabber Adonai" bassene lehaircha lehatzedik ma shekkatavnu, umi yomar sheddibbur ze lo haya achar shivto bahar esrim yom o sheloshim yom.

Uma sheddacha daat rabbenu hillel sheamar pasuk "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar" (Shemot 19:3) betaanat shello haya adayin esh, veamru sham betorat kohanim ma latztzad hashshave shel sene vesinay shehayu baesh vechulei, leheyoto sover harav shehaesh haya bishat hakkeria makshe, velo hi, shekkavvanat hattanna hu shebbeotah nevua haya bah davar ze letosefet, umide dahava shehayta bah maala zo shehayta baesh ma shello haya beohel moed haya bo gam ken hakkeria lemala, ulefi ze lu yehi shello haya adayin esh ma bechach, hare beotah hannevua haya esh, venishtannet nevua zo unevuat sene minnevuat ohel moed shello haya bo esh, uvaze en kushyat rav kashya. vetameah ani ech lo heiru lemul enav ma shehikshenu.

Veod, lu yihye kefi devarav, ech matze lememar tanna ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen shehayu baesh, vahalo "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar lemor" (Shemot 24:16) vegomer lo haya baesh, veligmor meotah keria ukeriat sene mitztzad hashshave shebbahem sheenam ella dibbur mippe kadosh lemoshe vehikdim keria ledibbur, ulehaamik bekushya zo yerae dimtabbera tinnare.

Veod, lamma hutzrach lomar shelosha kerae besinay shekkadma keria? velu yehi shello nachshov pasuk "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar", shenayim miha yeshnam shekkadma keria ledibbur lisvarat harav. vahalo kol tirchat hattanna hu al yittur "vayyikra" haamura beohel moed shello haya tzarich leamrah, veyigdal hakkushya bezichronah shete peamim besinay. ella vadday sheddivre harav kan shello bedikduk, velidvarenu eno makom lekushya achat mikkol ellu vehakkodmim. umeatta nimtzenu omrim ikkar limmud shekkadma keria ledibbur besinay hu pasuk "vayyikra elav Adonai min hahar vegomer ko tomar" veikkar.

Uma sheamru babbarayta "lo im amarta besinay shehu lechol yisrael" vegomer, lichora hu davar tamuah, shehare en lecha mitzva sheenah lechol yisrael. uvaal karban aharon peresh "lechol yisrael", uletzad ze haya tzorech sheyyihye hakkol behaderaga muetet meharagil ledabber im moshe, velaze amar "vayyikra el moshe" lehodia sheddibber elav bakkol haragil velo nitmaet mehaderagato bishvil yisrael. uledarko tzarich lomar keillu amar hattanna letzad shehaya lechol yisrael, ki lo hammaala hi heyoto lechol yisrael, veen devarim ellu mitkabbelim besichli. vehannachon beenay hu shehammaala hi shemmatzinu sheshshinna Adonai dibberotav sham shello amaram lemoshe levad vehu yedabber el bene yisrael, ella mippi elyon hayu lechol yisrael. ucheshem shennishtannet nevuat sinay lifrat ze, nishtannet gam ken lemaala zo shel keria mishshear dibberot hanneemarim lemoshe levad, velo hishmiam Adonai lechol yisrael, gam ken nomar shello hayta bahem maala zo shekkadma keria ledibbur.

Od siyyem beotah barayta: yachol lo hayta keria ella ledibbur ze? minnayin lechol haddibberot shebbattora? talmud lomar "meohel moed". yachol lo hayta keria ella ledibberot bilvad, minnayin lerabbot haamirot vehatztziuuyim? talmud lomar "dabber" "vaydabber" lerabbot af laamirot vetziuuyim vechulei, ad kan. perush haddevarim, ki mikkeriat ohel moed usene vesinay en lilmod leshum dibbur zulatam, vehattaam letzad shehaya hatechalat dibbur bammakom hahu, aval et asher yedabber od sham bammakom hahu lo yakdim bo hakkeria. talmud lomar "meohel moed" – kera yetera lomar kol asher yedabber meohel moed takdim lo hakkeria. vahagam shello ribba hakkatuv ella beohel moed, hare ze binyan av lakkol, ki en bo devar chiddush missinay velo missene lomar shelletzad oto chiddush hayta hakkeria. vechazar lomar: en li ella dibberot, shekken diyyek hakkatuv "vaydabber", minnayin lannevuot hammatchilot "vayyomer" o leshon tziuuy? veulay ki haddibbur yaggid tigboret hamedabber ma sheen ken haamirot vehatztziuuyim, minnayin sheyyakdim lahem hakkeria? talmud lomar "dabber vaydabber".

Veraiti girsa leharaavad: "talmud lomar dabber vaydabber lemor". ulegirsa zo darash yittur tevat "lemor" haamura bevaydabber" shello haya tzarich lomar achar sheamar "dabber", ha lamadta shebba lerabbot haamirot, vehatztziuuyim begeder amirot hem. veraiti levaal karban aharon shehissig al haggirsa lamma amar "talmud lomar dabber" shello haya lo lomar ella "talmud lomar lemor", ad kan. veen zo kushya, letzad shekkoach hadderasha hi mikkefel "dabber", shezzulatah tevat "lemor" enah meyutteret veitztericha leatzmah, lachen kegirsat haraavad ikkar.

Vehinne ma sheddan hattanna lehacheriach ki tzarich lomar "vayyikra" al dibbur rishon shebbeohel moed, mishshum sheeno nilmad lo missene velo missinay, en ze ella havechanat haemet mitztzad atzmo, ki zulat ze gam ken, hagam shehaya nilmad dibbur rishon hanneemar beohel moed missene vesinay, en yittur letevat "vayyikra", ki hutzrach lishar dibberot hannirmazim beyittur "meohel moed" vehannilmadim miyyittur "lemor", shezzulat zichron hakkeria kan lo hayinu yodim devarim hammitrabbim.

Ella sheyyesh latet lev babbarayta, lamma lo hiksha yittur "vayyikra" haamura bassene vesinay, veyilmedu mivayyikra" haamura beohel moed? veen tzarich lomar im yomar ohel moed vesinay o ohel moed usene, veyavo hashshelishi mitztzad hashshave shebbenehem. veod kashe ledivre hattanna sheddoresh amro "meohel moed" kera yetera lidrasha, lehavi kol haddibberot shenneemru beohel moed shekkadma bahem hakkeria velo paam rishona bilvad, im ken mi gara dibbur rishon shenneemar besinay shello takdim bo hakkeria shehutzrach lomar bo "vayyikra"? uchemo chen bassene lo haya tzarich lomar "vayyikra" lefi ma shellamad sham miyyittur dibbur "lemor" lerabbot kol haamirot.

Veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shennatan dato leyashshev haddikdukim, vechol ma shekkatav harav baze en dati holamto. rishona ma shekkatav ki lo matze lemelaf sinay usene meohel moed, letzad shehayta keria letaam shehaya moshe yare lavo, laze kara lo likkanes. kashe lichshennomar ki tanna detorat kohanim choshesh lidrasha zo, vead atta dilma lo kadma keria ledibbur beohel moed, ukeria zo enah ella kede sheyyikkanes velo yaamod bachutz letzad shehaya yare, vedavka besinay usene letzad tzad hashshave shebbahem sheeno beohel moed hu shekkadma hakkeria laddibbur.

Uma sheyyishshev sheachar haemet daat hattanna hu delamdinan sene missinay veohel moed, uchemo sheggilla dato sheddarash (Shemot 3:4) "vayyomer moshe moshe" sheen talmud lomar "vayyomer" ella lelammed al kol hakkeriot shehayu "moshe moshe", veim lo haya sover sheen tzorech lelammed bah shekkadma hakkeria letzad deyalef missinay veohel moed, hare itztericha legufa lehashemienu shekkadma lah hakkeria al kol panim. boshni middevarim ellu, ki ma sheanu lomdim shehakkeria kadma lehaddibbur eno al dibbur shehaya bakkeria atzmah ella al haddibbur hanneemar besamuch lah, ki haddibbur shebbakkeria atzmah lo matzinu oto velo haya beshum achat mishshalosh keriot zulat bassene peresh hakkatuv ofen hakkeria shehayta "moshe moshe", velo al dibbur ze anu omrim shekkadma keria laddibbur ella al haddibbur hanneemar lo achar hakkeria, vehinne lefanecha hammekomot sheanu omrim bahem shekkadma hakkeria bahem, besinay lo neemar ella "vayyikra", velo amar haddibbur shehaya bakkeria atzmah, veanu omrim bo shekkadma hakkeria laddibbur uvehechreach shehu dibbur hanneemar besamuch lakkeria. uchemo chen beohel moed anu omrim shekkadma hakkeria laddibbur, hagam shello neemar "vayyomer moshe", veim ken kemo chen tihye keriat hassene hagam shello haya omer hakkatuv "vayyomer" ella "vayyikra moshe moshe vegomer vayyomer shal nealecha" vegomer amrinan shekkadma keria laddibbur, veaytar leh "vayyomer" lidrosh ma sheddarash hattanna. utemehani alav shehu peresh shekkeria shekkadma laddibbur besinay hu pasuk "vayyikra bayyom hashshevii" vehaddibbur sheacharav hu "veyikchu li teruma" sheyyesh harebe richuk makom ben hakkeria laddibbur, uvikriat sene heelim enav merot haddibburim hanneemarim besamuch. veim harav chashav shehakkeria lechud vaamirat "moshe moshe" lechud, ze shegaga hu, vehaddevarim berurim leen kol ben daat, utemehani ech yatzu mippi kadosh devarim ellu, veyesh od lehakeshot ella sheen tzorech lidchot devarim kaelle.

Uma sheyyishshev lamma lo yilmad sinay usene mikkol haddibburim vehaamirot shennitrabbu befasuk ze shekkadma bahem hakkeria, veamar sheen kavvanat hattanna ella leotam devarim vaamirot shenneemru beohel moed bilvad veen lilmod mimmennu lishar dibberot shenneemru bishar mekomot, lefi ma sheheela shessetarnuhu besamuch, ki sene en bo kedimat keria, veohel moed letzad sheshshachan alav heanan velo yachol lavo, vedachak atzmo lefaresh gam bedivre Rashi sheamar setam lechol haddibberot vaamirot vechulei kadma keria vechulei sheeno ella otam shenneemru beohel moed ad kan. devarav zichrono livracha en sichli holmam, ki mimma sheribba hakkatuv kol haddibberot vehaamirot shehayu beohel moed shekkadma bahem hakkeria ayin roa velev shomea ki lo letzad sheshshachan heanan velo yachol lavo hayta hakkeria ella lehakedim hakkeria laddibbur, modia hakkatuv sheim mechamat hayyira keria achat taspik lakkol, veim lehodia shebbechol dibbur shehaya Adonai medabber haya moshe yare likkanes vehaya tzarich likro lo, en devarim ellu kedaim leamer, ki behechreach lomar shello haya haddavar ken bitmidut, shehare hakkohanim nichnasim umeshammeshim umoshe lo yare velo yifchad likkanes immahem, umin hassetam sheyyedabber Adonai immo bitmidut, im lo shettomar shebbechol et shehaya rotze Adonai ledabber immo haya heanan shochen vehayu yotzim hakkohanim chutz leohel moed, veze hevel gamur.

Veod timtza sheheela reem bed "meohel moed", ki tanna detorat kohanim sover keotah barayta dekatne (resh torat kohanim): katuv echad omer (Shemot 40:35) "velo yachol moshe lavo", vechatuv echad omer (Bamidbar 7:89) "uvevo moshe", ba hakkatuv hashshelishi vehichria benehem (Shemot 40:35) "ki shachan alav heanan". emor meatta: kol zeman shehaya heanan al hammishkan lo yachol, nistallek vechulei "uvevo" vegomer ad kan. hinne peshat derasha zo hi shemmeolam lo nichnas moshe ella achar shennistallek heanan, veaf al pi chen ribba hakkatuv lechol haddibberot shenneemru lo beohel moed shekkadma lahem hakkeria. veim tomar shello darash tanna ken ella achar shenneemar keria besinay, aval zulat ze haya mechazzer achar derashat rabbi tanchuma (resh parasha zo) sheddarash shehakkeria hayta letzad shehaya mityare lavo. hare lecha derashat rabbi tanchuma zichrono livracha: haya yare moshe likkanes dichtiv "velo yachol moshe", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: eno din vederech kavod shemmoshe shennitztaer bammishkan yihye omed bachutz vaani bifnim, ella hareni kore oto sheyyikkanes, lechach neemar "vayyikra". lisvara zo lo haya haddibbur ella befaam rishona, aval mishsham veelach harshut netuna lo meet hammelech likkanes veen pachad, veaf al pi chen amar hakkatuv shehaya makdim keria laddibbur. umeatta lamma lo lamdinan kol haddibberot, veen tzarich lomar sinay usene, meohel moed?

Vehannachon lomar hu, ki im lo amar hakkatuv kedimat keria ledibbur besinay usene, hagam shehaya omer beohel moed, hayinu omrim ki meohel moed miet sinay usene shello kadma hakkeria bo, shehassevara notenet lilmod meohel moed keshem shekkadma bo keria laddibbur kemo chen bassene vesinay, talmud lomar "meohel moed". veyesh taam lammiut, ki ulay letzad shekkava Adonai shechinato im yisrael hosif maala zo bitchillat shechinato shekkara lo kodem haddibbur, veribbuy "lemor" hayinu dorshim derash acheret. veteda sheen lecha parasha sheen bah yittur "lemor" veanu dorshim beofen acher, vetihye zot keachat mehenna. veachar sheamar hakkatuv keria bassene vesinay nitchayyavnu lomar ki meohel moed ba lerabbot shear dibburim, veachar shemmatzinu sheribba hakkatuv haddibburim darshinan gam ken "lemor" lema shellefanenu, shehem haamirot sheshshakul ani bahem im yihyu bichlal haddibberot, ki yoter yesh lanu lidrosh yittur hatteva lema sheanu tzerichin lah bimkomah millevakkesh derashot. veachar shehodianu hakkatuv kol haddibberot vehaamirot shenneemru beohel moed shekkadma lahem hakkeria, hu haddin lechol haddibberot vehaamirot shenneemru battora. vehattaam, ki bishlosha mekomot matzinu shehikdim hakkatuv keria laamira: sinay usene veohel moed, veen ani yodea im lo haya davar ze ella befaam rishona o bechol paam ufaam. keshebbeer hakkatuv beechad mehem shehu beohel moed shehaya bo bechol dibbur vaamira, hare nitgalla hassatum shehu haddin bechol haddibburim shehayu bechol hammekomot. o nomar al ze hadderech, sheachar shebbeer hakkatuv dibburim vaamirot shehayu beohel moed, anu chozrim velomdim missinay usene veohel moed lechol haddibburim al ze hadderech: ma sinay vechulei kadma keria af kol vechulei, ma lesinay usene shehaya techillat dibbur bammakom hahu, tomar bishar dibburim shello hayu techillat dibbur bammakom hahu? ohel moed yochiach shekkadma hakkeria lechol dibbur vedibbur shehaya sham. velichshennomar ma leohel moed shekken haya makom sheshshachan bo Adonai bikviut venaasa elohim shachen betochenu, sinay usene yochichu vechulei shekkadma hakkeria befaam rishona vechulei vechazar haddin vechulei, hatztzad hashshave shebbahem shehaya dibbur mippi kadosh lemoshe, af ani avi kol dibbur mippi kadosh lemoshe shekkadma bo hakkeria bechol makom sheddibber immo.

Vayyikra el moshe. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hizkir shem hakkore, vahagam shehizkiro achar kach, min harauy lehazekiro bitchilla umimmela muvan ki hu hammedabber kesheyyomar "vayyikra Adonai vegomer vaydabber".
