Veulay sheyyechavven hakkatuv lehodia taatzumotav yitbarach, sheyyikra bekol gadol velo yishmaennu zulat et asher yachpotz, vehu amro vayyikra el moshe shehagam shekkara lo nishma haddibbur ella el moshe velo lemi shellefanav. ulefi ze im haya omer hakkatuv "vayyikra Adonai el moshe" tavin she kara bekol gadol, aval haggaat hakkol lemoshe haya bekol namuch sheyyeshaer moshe bedato sheefshar sheotam sherchokim ketzat veenam besamuch lo lo yishmeu, veen kan chiddush pele Adonai. laze amar vayyikra el moshe, perush ki gam legabbe moshe hayta keria bekol gadol sheshshama kol gadol, vehen hen norotav yitbarach shello shama zulato.

Od nire taam shello hizkir shemo yitbarach bakkeria, sheyyoter bachar lemaalat hashshem lehazekiro bedibbur shel mitzva meal hakkeria sheen bah ella hazemana bealma o derech kavod lefi hammidrash. od yesh latet taam kefi hammidrash (vayyikra Rabba 1:8) sheamru shehayu aharon uvanav vehazzekenim omrim: "en anu yodim eze mehem chaviv lifne hammakom, ella lemi sheyyikra Adonai" vechulei – "vayyikra el moshe" vegomer. hinne lefi ze en makom lehazekir shemo bakkeria, ki maamar "vayyikra" hu inyan hahavchana shehayu metzappim lah gedole yisrael lemi yikra Adonai, laze en lomar ella "vayyikra el moshe", vehaven.

Ulederech ze yityashshev ma sheyyesh ledakdek od, lamma hutzrach lomar el moshe velo hispik beamro elav shechozer el moshe shehuzkar besamuch (Shemot 40:35), vedome laze timtza sheamar hakkatuv techillat parashat vayyera "elav" velo hizkir lemi nigla, vesamach al zichron avraham shebbapparasha hakkodemet, kemo chen haya lo lomar kan, uvema shekkatavnu lo kashe.

Vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed. taam shehutzrach lomar "elav", shello tomar shello mana Adonai kolo mishshemoa lezulat moshe ella beerech yisrael, aval kesheyyedabber beohel moed lo yimna shemiat haddibbur mehammizdammenim sham shehem meshartav kohane Adonai, laze amar "elav meohel moed" sheafillu begeshet moshe leohel moed velo yihyu sham ella kohane Adonai lo haya nishma haddibbur ella lemoshe.

Meohel moed vegomer. kashe, ki min harauy lehakedim hodaat hammakom shemmimmennu haddibbur veachar kach yazkir lemi yedabber, vechan icher sheamar "el moshe" achar kach amar "meohel moed". vehinne lefi ma sheddarshu betorat kohanim shekkatavti lemala, ki amro "meohel moed" lehodia al kol haddibberot shenneemru achar kach meohel moed shekkadma lahem hakkeria, yesh taam beichur zikkaron ze lomar ki lemerachok maggedet, vehaven:

Uvetorat kohanim darshu od, "meohel moed" melammed shehaya hakkol nifsak velo haya yotze meohel moed, ad kan. vekashe, vahalo kevar darshu mimmenna inyan hakkeria. od kashe, im haya nifsak hakkol velo yatza chutz, lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lemaet yisrael mishshemiat haddibbur. veraiti leharav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shekkatav shekkoach derashato hi mimma shello amar "vayyikra el moshe meohel moed", veamar "elav meohel moed" darshu sheyyirtze lomar shemmeohel moed haya elav been hefsek, ha lamadta shello yatza. vekusheya sheniyya teretz haraavad shemma shehutzrach hakkatuv lemaatam hu min haddibberot shehayu kodem hakamat hammishkan.

Veen dati mityashshevet bishne hatterutzim. mimma shekkatav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi sheddoresh meichur zichron meohel moed, halo en hashshinnuy ose roshem laasher yechavven elav, ki hagam shennishma shemmeohel moed yatza leozen moshe af al pi chen lo yitchayyev mizze lomar shello yatza hakkol, sheulay shemmoshe haya omed samuch leohel moed uleolam yatza chutz. veod lidvarav haya lo lehakedim techillat hakkol veachar kach tachlito al ze hadderech "meohel moed elav", umimma shehikdim "elav" hare ze sholel shello nitkavven bismichut ze lomar ken, ki ech yakdim shiur sof haddibbur kodem reshito. veyoter nire lomar sheddoresh meamro "meohel moed lemor" velo amar "vaydabber Adonai meohel moed elav lemor", sheyyesh lehakedim mekom hammedabber vezichron hannidbar elav, veyeshnam lechol hadderashot shekkadmu, yeshnah leyittur meohel moed lidrosh shear dibberot shekkadma hakkeria, gam yeshnah mufleget mimma shello amar "vayyikra meohel moed", gam yeshnah lidrashat "lemor" lerabbot shear amirot vetziuuyim shekkadma bahem hakkeria, shema minna shennitkavven lomar al ze hadderech "meohel moed lemor" perush mimmennu hu techillat dibbur haramuz beamro "vaydabber" uvo kalta haamira beamro "lemor", ha lamadta shello yatzta chutz. o nomar shehay tanna eno doresh yittur ohel moed lerabbot shear haddibberot vedoresh ben shear haddibberot ben haamirot kullan miyyittur tevat "lemor", vechevan shehi meyutteret im eno inyan lamdabber tenehu inyan lashshomea shello yishma ella mehaomdim beohel moed velo mehaomdim chutz. veulay sheamar "meohel" lomar lemaet otam shebbeohel moed shehem aharon uvanav, vahagam shemmiatu mittevat "elav", adayin yesh litot sheamro "elav" lemaet hazzekenim, aval aharon uvanav yesh makom lomar shello nimatu, laze amar "meohel moed".

Uma shetteretz haraabbad lekusheya sheniyya, shehammiut ba laddibberot shekkadmu, devarim temuhim hem, shehare hammiut hu bikriato meohel moed, vegam lisvarat hach tanna dimmaatim mippasuk (Shemot 25:22) "vedibbarti ittecha" vegomer (Bamidbar 7:89) "vekol elav", hakkol beohel moed haya. veyoter nachon lomar shello darshu shehaya hakkol nifsak beohel moed, ella bema sheddibber elav beohel moed, shekken katuv "vaydabber elav meohel moed", aval bakkeria mode sheyyatza hakkol chutz likrot lemoshe shehaya omed bachutz.

Uma shekkatav harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shettanna ze sover shehaya moshe bifnim vehaya bizman shennistallek heanan, ucheidach derasha derame ketiv "velo yachol moshe" vegomer (Shemot 40:35) uchetiv "uvevo moshe" (Bamidbar 7:89), ba hakkatuv hashshelishi vehichria benehem "ki shachan heanan" vegomer, meatta kol zeman shehaya anan vechulei, ad kan. vaani omer ki baal derasha zo lo yachchish shezzeman shenneemar "vayyikra el moshe" haya bizman sheshshachan heanan, uremiyyat hakketuvim hi al ze hadderech: ketiv "uvevo moshe" mashma sheharshut beyado bechol et, uchetiv "velo yachol" vegomer perush ki im al yede keria, vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv besof mishpatim "vayyikra el moshe vayyavo moshe betoch heanan" (Shemot 24:18), uchemo chen bema shellefanenu. vehaddevarim peshutim etzli ki en mi sheyyisbor lomar shennitakkev moshe chutz leohel moed ad achar shennistallek heanan vekara lo. vetimtza dekatane resha shel otah barayta veze leshono: otzi et kullan velo otzi malache hashsharet sheen moshe yachol likkanes letochan ad sheyyikra lo, talmud lomar "kol lo vegomer meohel moed", melammed shehaya hakkol nifsak vechulei, ad kan. hare shehattanna atzmo sover shello haya nichnas ella achar keria, ha lamadta chutz leohel moed haya. veim tomar im ken minnayin lattanna lidrosh shekkadma hakkeria laddibbur, halo keria zo letzorech hayta kede sheyyikkanes mippene shehaya yare? nire ki im lo haya tzorech bakkeria lehakedimah laddibbur kaamur, haya yachol Adonai lehasir pachad millibbo veyikkanes belo keria, ella mittaam shehikdim hakkeria laddibbur hu shekkara kannizkar, umoshe haya yare lavo leohel moed lehazemin atzmo sheyyihye muchan kesheyyikkare, venishar omed bachutz ad shekkara lo Adonai keminhago veaz nichnas, vekol hakkeria yatza lachutz, vekol haddibbur amad bimkomo beohel moed velo haya yotze lehishshama afillu havarato chutz laohel.

Uvederech remez yirmoz sheyyomar moshe leyisrael sham beohel moed kol asher yetzavvehu Adonai, laze samach meohel moed lemor, perush, mishsham yomar hu leyisrael. veyesh baze taam tov, kede sheyyihye emat haddibbur al shomav lifne hammelech hammetzavve baruch hu, gam sheyyatzdiku oto beyoter kesheyyomar haddevarim lefanav yitbarach, shello hotir velo hosif al devarav.

Od yirmoz al ze hadderech elav meohel moed, perush shello hissig lidvar Adonai elav ella letzad shemmachal Adonai al avon haegel veshachan beohel moed leot ulemofet, aval im lo hayta hammechila leyisrael harmuza beohel moed lo haya Adonai medabber elav, veamar lo sheyyomar davar ze leyisrael, vehu amro lemor. vetimtza sheamru sham betorat kohanim "lemor" – emor lahem divre kibbushim, bishvilchem medabber immi vechulei, ad kan, vehu mechuvvan leferushenu, ella shedderashatam kullah mittevat "lemor" velo middikduk hakkatuv sheamarnu. veulay sheggam razal zo hi kavvanatam. od amru razal (torat kohanim kan): yachol haya medabber immo letzorech atzmo, talmud lomar "lemor" – bishvil yisrael haya medabber immo velo bishvil atzmo, ad kan. kavvanat devarav ki tevat "lemor" miut hu, lemaet shello haya dibburo lemoshe zulat bishvil yisrael, perush ledabber lahem. mikkan atta lamed shello dibber Adonai im moshe ella divre tora shemmasar leyisrael, vehu maamar hattanna (avot 1:1): moshe kibbel tora missinay umesarah lihoshua, ha lamadta shekkol ma shekkibbel masar, umikkan atta lamed shello hodio Adonai sod shello limmedo et yisrael, vehushvu yisrael lemoshe bayyedia ella shehu lamad mippi haggevura veyisrael mippi ish.

rashi: Tzinnim pachim. kemo "litzninim betziddechem" (Bamidbar 33:55), "uvau alayich hotzen" (Yechezkel 23:24), leshon gedudim velistim:
Tzinnim pachim. hem temunim bedarche hammeakkesh derachav, kelomar: yissurim muchanim lo:
Shomer nafsho yirchak mehem. shemmeyashsher maasav yinnatzel mehem:
targum: Nishva bearcha akimata uman denater nafsheh yirchak minhon:

rashi: Tirza veallon. mine ilane serak:
Vayammetz lo baatze yaar. ose lo chizzukim, ben lechizzuk ben lenoy, bemine etzim hameshunnim ze mizze bemarehen:
Nata oren. keshemmotze yichur veneta harauy lechach, noto lechach, vehaggeshem megaddelo:
Oren. leshon 'neta yonek, 306 109:
targum: Lemikatz leh arzin unesiv terez uvelut umatkef leh baae churesha netzav urena umitra yerabbe:

rashi: Simcha latztzaddik asot mishpat. simcha lehakkadosh baruch hu laasot din batztzaddikim kede lezakkotam lechayye haolam habba, vesimcha latztzaddik shehakkadosh baruch hu mevi yissurin alehem kede sheyyizku laolam habba. kach nidrash bemidrash tehillim:
Umechitta. hi lefoale aven, lefi sheen notnin lev lashuv veen hayyissurin moilin lahen, umitztaarin velo lehoil:
targum: Chedvata detzadika lemebad dina veshatzya leilen deavdin ata:

rashi: Ir gibborim ala chacham. ze moshe rabbenu sheala leven hammalachim gibbore choach (tehillim 103:20). vayyored vegomer. tora:
targum: Limdinta degibbare selik chakkima veachet ushena desivra:

rashi: Leaharon ulevanav. kohen gadol notel chelek barosh shello bemachaloket vehahedyot bemachaloket (sifra):
Kodesh kodashim. hi lahem:
Meishshe Adonai. en lahem chelek bah ella leachar mattenot haishshim (sham):
Velo oti karata. veatta lo oti karata bifnotcha achare avoda zara:
Ki yagata bi. niletem maher baavodati (Pesikta rabbati 29):
targum: Emir al yede neviyaya vela bepulechani aritun devet yaakov are laetun beulefan orayti yisrael:

rashi: Im kesev. lefi sheyyesh beemure hakkesev ma sheen beemure haez, shehakkesev alyato kereva, lechach nechleku lishte parashiyyot (sifra):
Visfatayim. velo ballev (sham):
Lehara. leatzmo:
O lehetiv. leatzmo, kegon ochal velo ochal, ishan velo ishan (shavuot 27):
Lechol asher yevatte. lerabbot lesheavar:
Venelam mimmennu. veavar al shevuato, kol elle bekarban ole veyored, kammeforash kan, aval shevua sheyyesh bah kefirat mamon enah bekarban zo ella beasham:
Asher nasi yecheta. leshon ashre — ashre haddor shehannasi shello noten lev lehavi kappara al shiggato, kal vachomer shemmitcharet al zedonotav (sifra):
ohc: Asher nasi yecheta. perush, afillu behoraat bet din kol sheen chayyavin bet din veasa hu chayyav sair, vechen katav harambam (hilchot shegagot 15:8).

rashi: Avicha harishon chata. beamro "bamme eda" (Bereshit 15:8):
Umelitzecha pashu vi. en lecha bechol melitzim sheatta somech al zechutam, shello matzati bo pesha: yitzchak ahav et soni:
targum: Avuch kadmaa chata umalfach meradu vememri:

rashi: Umi chamoni yikra. umi yikra shehu kamoni, veyaggid veyaaroch li et kol ma shehaya missumi am olam vead atta?
Am olam. kol beriyyot:
Veotiyyot. divre mofet:
Vaasher tavona. veet haatidot lavo yaggidu, kemo sheani ose atta, sheadayin lo charav habbayit, velo gelitem, velo nolad koresh, vaani mevasser etchem alav:
targum: Uman kevati din arinah vichavinah visadrinah kodamay mishavayuti ama demin alma udeatyan vedaatidin lemete yechavun lana:

rashi: Vaachallel sare kodesh. bishvil avonotechem:
targum: Veappes ravreve kudesha veemsar lekatala yaakov veyisrael lechisudin:

rashi: Vehizza middam hachattat. baola lo hitin ella mitztzuy, uvachattat hazzaa umitztzuy, ochez baoref umattiz, vehaddam nittaz veholech lammizbeach:
Chattat hu. lishmah keshera, shelo lishmah pesula (sifra):

ohc: Veim ez vegomer. betorat kohanim amru: hifsik hainyan shello tehe haez teuna alya, ad kan. vetzarich ladaat bamme hifsik hainyan. uvaal karban aharon peresh mimma shehaya tzarich lomar "veim ez" veamar "im ez". udevarav shogeg hem ki "veim ez" ketiv.

Vehariva (tosfot fesachim tzav:) peresh, middela kalal oto bahade keves kulei velo shinna bo kelum vechulei. vehaddevarim peshutim etzli shekkavvanat hattanna hu letzad ki matzinu sheamar hakkatuv befarashat ola "veim min hatztzon vegomer min hakkevasim umin haizzim" (Vayikra 1:10), vechan befarashat shelamim hifsik hainyan veamar "min hatztzon" battechilla veachar kach chazar lefaret din haez bifne atzmah, lomar sheyyesh bo din chadash.

Uma shello amar "im ez", ha lamadta shehu samuch al inyan rishon bechol perate dinim harshumim beamro zevach shelamim zachar unekeva vegomer, ki rabbim hem, kullam yeshnam beshalme ez, velo nifseka parashat ez ella lealya, vehattaam lefi shechazar hakkatuv lefaret kol perate hachalavim vehishmit haalya, hare ze maggid shealya hifsik ben ez uven keves.

Veda shello hutzrach lemaet haalya ella beez, aval bevakar hagam sheamar "veim keves" vearvinhu kera lo hutzrach lemaet alya, vehattaam ki al kol panim alya devakar eno dome lealya detzon velo mikkarya alya, velaze hagam shemmearev hakkatuv shene dinim yachdav "veim min hatztzon" litten haamur shel ze baze, hayeynu bedavar sheyyeshno bammetziut, aval alya letzad sheen alya shel bakar karuy alya, minnayin lanu lerabbotah deitzterich kera lemaet, velaze hagam shello miatah hakkatuv amru betorat kohanim sheen bah din alya, vedavka beez letzad sherasham veamar "veim min hatztzon" veez tzon mikre, vesalka datach amena sheal shenehem amar hakkatuv haalya, laze hutzrach hakkatuv lechallek velomar "im kesev im ez" vegomer:

rashi: Adam ki yakriv mikkem. kesheyyakriv; bekarbenot nedava dibber hainyan:
Adam. lamma neemar? ma adam harishon lo hikriv min haggazel — shehakkol haya shello — af attem lo takrivu min haggazel (Vayikra Rabba):
Habbehema. yachol af chayya bichlal, talo bakar vatzon:
Min habbehema. velo kullah — lehotzi et harovea veet hannirba:
Min habbakar. lehotzi et hanneevad:
Min hatztzon. lehotzi et hammuktza:
Umin hatztzon. lehotzi et hannogeach shehemit; keshehu omer lematta min hainyan min habbakar — sheen tal — lehotzi et hatterefa (sifra):
Takrivu. melammed sheshshenayim mitnaddevim ola beshuttafut:
Korbanchem. melammed shehi baa nidvat tzibbur, hi olat kayitz hammizbeach, habbaa min hammotarot (shavuot 12):
ohc: Dabber vegomer veamarta. kafal lomar dabber veamarta, gam shinna ledabber bishne leshonot velo amar emor veamarta, letzad shetztzivva Adonai shene mine karban, echad habba leratzon niddar veniddav, veechad lechapparat chet ki yecheta adam, keneged ze amar dabber ki gezerat melech hi alav chovat chattat harshuma bechol perat uferat, ucheneged habba leratzon amar veamarta alehem en ze ella letzad rommut vechavod veen chova baddavar. od yirmoz gam al perat chattat hashshigyonot sheyyesh bahem dibbur – livchinat hachiyyuv, vaamira – shehu letzad sheyyitratztze Adonai lekabbel behema tachat nefesh hachotet, shemmin harauy hi tamut vaAdonai pada nefesh adam bese chesavim vese izzim velammarbe par ben bakar.

Veamro bene yisrael vegomer, betorat kohanim amru: "el bene yisrael" – lemaet goyim mehassemicha haamura besamuch. "bene" – velo benot. "veamarta alehem" – lassemicha haamura bassof shehi semichat shelamim. vekashe, achar sheddarshu besamuch yittur lemor, "dabber el bene yisrael" tzericha legufah. veen lomar ki mimmela muvan mittevat lemor kemo shepperesh baal karban aharon, bimchila mikkevodo, shehare im lo amar "dabber el bene yisrael" lo hayiti doresh ma sheddarashti belemor", uma makom lidrosh "dabber" vegomer.

Veulay kevan sheen yadua eze mehem shehi legufah veeze mehem shebbaa lidrasha, darshinan letarvayyhu. o efshar sheeno doresh hattanna "dabber", ella "bene yisrael", shehaya lo lomar "dabber alehem" umuvan haddavar sheal yisrael hu omer, umeamro "bene" memaet nashim shehaya lo lomar "dabber el bet yisrael", umeamro "yisrael" miet haggoyim. verishon ikkar, ki timtza ki sham betorat kohanim doresh "bene yisrael" lomar, ma bene yisrael mekabbele berit, uvah machriach derashato sheddoresh bappasuk "adam ki yakriv mikkem", hare ki doresh derashot harebe kol sheyyihyu nishmaim keechad, hache namme doresh yittur "lemor" kevan shennuchal lomar ki ze hu hammeyuttar, vechozer vedoresh "dabber el" vegomer kevan shennuchal lomar ze hu hammeyuttar.

Adam ki yakriv vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar tevat adam. verazal amru (torat kohanim hacha) lerabbot gerim, vehiksha harav baal karban aharon, lamma hutzrach lerabbot gerim kevan dekayyma lan (menachot ag:) mekabbelin miggoyim vechulei, veheela shessalka datach lemaet otam kevan shennichnesu begeder yisrael, umatzinu shemmiet hakkatuv beyisrael dichtiv "mikkem" velo kullechem, laze hutzrach lerabbot, ad kan. udevarav zichrono livracha shello bedikduk kol ikkar, ki im lo haya ribbuy ze sheribba gerim lo hayiti doresh meribbuy "ish ish" (Vayikra 22:18) lerabbot haggoyim ella lerabbot haggerim, laze kadam tanna vehodia ki gerim nitrabbu miyyitur "adam", im ken "ish ish" ba lerabbot haggoyim, uvaze telech bederech yashar bemashmaut kol otah barayta mibbeli tzorech dochakut.

Veen lehakeshot dilma "adam" ba lemaet haggoyim (bava metzia 114.) keamro: attem keruyim adam velo ummot haolam keruyim adam, veish ish" lerabbot haggerim, ki meamro "dabber el bene yisrael" hare en hakkatuv medabber ella beyisrael, uminnayin yaale al haddaat lekabbel mehaggoyim sheyyutzrach lemaatam, ella vadday lo ba ella lerabbot, veen lanu lerabbot ella geder echad meotam sheenam bene yisrael vehem haggerim, velichsheyyavo ribbuy acher az navin sheyyerabbe haggoyim. veribbuy shel haggerim lechulle alma mekabbelin kol min karban, aval ribbuy haggoyim nechleku (menachot ag:) rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva im davka olot vechulei.

Uvemidrash tanchuma amru: lamma amar adam velo amar ish? yirtze lomar ki yecheta haadam keadam harishon shehitchil lachato yavi karban, ad kan. hinne mimmashmaut divre hammidrash mashma ki adam harishon shogeg haya, shehare en meviin karban ella al chet shogeg, veze mechuvvan lema shepperashti befarashat bereshit befasuk (Bereshit 3:12) "hi natna li" vegomer. vechavvanat hammidrash hi ki ba Adonai lehitnaheg im bene yisrael ma shello nahag ken im adam harishon, ki adam harishon chata veniknesa alav mita velo hoil lo havaat karban, velahem yoil. veamro shehitchil lachato, natan hattaam lamma lo nahag Adonai kemo chen im adam harishon, ki adam hitchil lachato velo kadam lo bechinat hara lehachericho lachato, ma sheen ken habbaim acharav kevar kadam lahem bechinat hachet benafsham, veze lecha ot habberit asher arel besaro vetzivva Adonai lamul ma shello haya chen leadam harishon.

Ulederech ze hiskalti leyashshev chakira achat asher shafat leadam al avon rishon mishpat mavet, velo chash lemiddato baruch hu dichtiv (Iyov 33:29) "paamayim shalosh im gaver", veadrabba mishpat tzibbur yesh lo lehaavir lo gam avon shelishi, dichtiv (Amos 2:1) "al shelosha pishe yisrael" vegomer. ki yesh taam nachon baddavar, ki beyom bero Adonai haadam hechlito bivchinat hattov been pesolet, shehi bechinat hara hammatte et haadam midderech hattov, uvecheto nimshach bechinat hara venaasa seyag lechol nefesh ish yisrael benafsho rucho venishmato, gam begufo aral lev vaaral basar. velaze im yecheta ish yisrael yaavor lo Adonai paamayim shalosh vegomer letzad chelek hara haddavuk bo ra mishshenninar mibbeten immo vehu yitgabber alav lehachetio bemezid, gam yachtiennu behessach haddaat, velaze yoil lo karban al shigyono, ma sheen ken adam harishon hagam shello chata ella beshogeg, mishpat tzedek hu lo shello yaavor lo Adonai afillu chet echad, gam sheyyihye shogeg lo yoil lo karban al shigyono.

Ki yakriv mikkem. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar mikkem. od lamma icher lomar "mikkem" achar zichron hammifal mimmennu, ki min harauy lehakedim zichron happoel asher bo yedabber veachar kach hannifal mimmennu. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (chullin 5.) amru shebba lemaet mumar shebbeyisrael, vedarshu "min habbehema" lehavi mumar, ha ketzad miet mumar lechol hattora kullah o laavoda zara sheshshekula kechol hattora, veribba mumar sheeno lechol hattora. uledivrehem zichronam livracha nire leyashshev gam ma sheicher lomar "mikkem", sheim haya omer adam mikkem haya nishma shemmemaet bemakom shemmerabbe, o merabbe bemakom shemmemaet, velo chen hu kavvanat hakkatuv, sheharibbuy hu baggerim, vehammiut hu beyisrael levad, laze hivdil benehem betevat "ki yakriv". venire od lefaresh al pi ma sheamru bechullin (sham 70:) sheheviu barayta zo sheddarshu "mikkem" lehotzi hammumar, vehevi achareha barayta sheddarshu "meam haaretz" perat lammumar, rabbi shimon omer hashshav midiato, veamru sham mumar leechol chelev vehevi karban al haddam ikka benayhu, vekaamar sham chada bechattat vachada beola, ad kan.

Veamru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim "ki yakriv" eno ella reshut, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar "ki yakriv" kodem amro "mikkem", lomar shemma shemmemaet hu bedavar hanniddar veniddav uchedivre haggemara (chullin 5.) shemmassik chada beola, dela tema kevan sheddoron hu yekubbal, ka mashma lan, vachada bechattat. umiut hatztzarich bechattat hinne hu rashum bichtav emet beamro (Vayikra 4:27) "meam haaretz", umeshunne miut ze mimmiut haamur beola, ki miut haamur beola eno ella lemumar lechol hattora kullah, aval hammiut haamur bechattat yemaet afillu mumar laavera achat im tihye otah shemmevi karban al shigyonah. vechen mashma gam ken middivre harambam beferek 3 mehilchot maase hakkarbanot yeuyyan sham.

Uvederech remez yechavven al ze hadderech: letzad sherau shehikriv Adonai et moshe elav vayyikra lo mittoch kullam, veasa yekar ugedulla lemoshe, laze amar adam ki yakriv kol kach hakerava lashshechina – en ze ella mikkem, perush, mitztzad yisrael, ki beemtzautam hi hahassaga. uchemo shekkatavnu lemala shello haya medabber Adonai immo ella bishvil yisrael, vetze ulemad sheloshim ushemone shana shehayu yisrael nezufim nitrachek mealav hakkavod velo dibber itto elohim.

Od yirmoz letzauot et anshe chayil lehishtaddel lekarev levavot am bene yisrael laavodat Adonai, velaze yikkare "karban laAdonai", ki al yede chet haadam yippared haddevekut shel yisrael im avihem shebbashshamayim, dichtiv (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim baAdonai", veyihyu nivdalim umeruchakim mehashshechina, vehaadon baruch hu yakpid kivyachol al haddavar veyitavve lekarev otam elav, vetzivva lehochiach lechol harachok ulekarev libbo. gam heenish lammaalim ayin mehaddavar, veze lecha haot asher tzivva Adonai lehatechil mimmekuddashav vehigdil sechar hamezakke, kemaamar hattanna (avot 5:21): kol hamezakke et harabbim en chet ba al yado, ki yishmerennu Adonai mishshigyonot, vehem haddevarim hanneemarim kan.

Adam. dikdek lomar "adam" leshon chashivut, kaamur bazzohar (tazria moach): "ki yakriv" – veet mi yakriv? peresh hakkatuv veamar mikkem – min happechutim sheyyeshnam bachem asher pashu baAdonai vayyomru lael "sur mimmennu" venitrachaku middevekuto yitbarach, et ze yakriv. velaze yikkare karban laAdonai, ki yakriv netzer mattaav kodesh lesharsho (Yeshayahu 60:21). veadam kaze en tzarich lehavi lo neder velo nedava, gam en metziut lehavi lo chattat velo asham, al derech amram zichronam livracha (avot 85): kol hamezakke et harabbim en chet ba al yado, veim en shogeg en karban. veachar sheggamar omer maase karban hannichbad vehammeulle, amar min habbehema vegomer takrivu et karbanchem – davar ze yeshno bechol adam, ki lo kol yassigu bechinat rabbim heshiv meavon.

rashi: El ohel moed. lammishkan, uvevet olamim lahechol:
El makom tahor. lefi sheyyesh michutz lair makom muchan letuma — lehashelich avanim menuggaot ulevet hakkevarot — hutzrach lomar michutz lammachane ze — shehu chutz lair — sheyyehe hammakom tahor:
Michutz lammachane. chutz leshalosh machanot; uvet olamim chutz lair, kemo sheppershuhu rabbotenu bemassechet yoma (daf 68) uvesanhedrin (daf 42):
El shefech haddeshen. makom sheshshofchin bo haddeshen hamesullak min hammizbeach, kemo shenneemar vehotzi et haddeshen el michutz lammachane (Vayikra 6):
Al shefech haddeshen yissaref. sheen talmud lomar, ella lelammed sheafillu en sham deshen (sifra):

Veasa lappar ze kaasher asa lappar hachattat. kemo shemmeforash befar kohen mashiach — lehavi yoteret ushete kelayot shepperesh sham, ma shelo peresh kan, velichpol bemitzvat haavodot, lelammed sheim chisser achat mikkol hammattanot pasul; lefi shemmatzinu bannittanin al hammizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat kipper, hutzrach lomar kan shemmattana achat mehen meakkevet (sham 39):

targum: Usheare ledachala avad letzalma segid leh veeshtabed leh uvea mine vaamar shezvani are dechalti at:
Kidnan amar Adonai malka deyisrael ufarke Adonai tzevaot ana hu demilkadmin af alme almaya dili inun uvar mini let ele:
Rigta deatla memita leh dela tzavyan aydin deavdin avidta:
La yadun vela mistakkelin are metamteman milmecheze enehon milistakkala belibbehon:
Deradef tzidketa vechesda yashkach chaye vetzidketa vikara:
Denater pumeh velishaneh natar min akta nafsheh:
Kidnan amar Adonai deavdach udeatkenach mimin yesadinach la tidchal avdi yaakov veyisrael deitreiti veh:
Man detava hu ayneh hu nitberach metul deyahev min lachmeh lemiskena:
Palge okid benura al palge bisra achil teva tavi useva af shechin vaamar ach shachenit chazeti nur:

bart: Shenayim ochazin betallit. baggemara moke lematnitin kegon sheechad mehem tofes bachutin shebbisfat habbeged mitztzad ze, vehaechad tofes bachutin shebbisfat habbeged mitztzad ze. aval im hem adukim babbeged atzmo, ze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat veze notel ad makom sheyyado maggaat, vehashshear cholkim beshave, uvishvua:

Ze omer kullah shelli. ani kenitiha veli mecharah hammocher velo lecha. vehammocher machar leechad mehem velakach hammaot mishshenehem, meechad middato umeechad beal karcho, veeno yodea mehe middato umehe beal karcheh. deillu yada vehaya omer laze macharti, haya kan ed echad, vehaya shekkenegdo chayyav shevua deorayta lehachechish haed. achshav sheeno yodea, shenehem nishbaim shevua zo haamura vematnitin. uvedin hu sheyyihyu cholkim belo shevua, ella shettikkenu chachamim shello yittol shum echad mehem ella bishvua, kede shello yehe kol echad holech vetokef betallito shel chavero veomer shelli hi. veitzterich tanna leashmoinan beze omer ani metzatiha dehaynu bimtzia, uveze omer kullah shelli dehaynu mikkach umimkar. i tana metzia, hava amena metzia hu deramu rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore hettera leechoz bah shello kaddin, deamar chavrai lav mide chasar bah, azzil veetpos veeflog bahadeh, aval mikkach umimkar dei lo hava tzarich lah lo hava mahadar abbatra lemizbenah, veze shebba lachalok immo velitten chatzi dameha shello kaddin mechassero velekka lememar demore hettera, ema lo ramu rabbanan shevua aleh. vei ashmuinan bemikkach umimkar, hava amena mikkach umimkar hu deramu rabbanan shevua aleh mishshum demore hettera veamar chavrai deme ka yahev vaana deme ka yahevna, hasheta ditzricha ledidi ashshekleh ana, vechavrai litrach velezil velizvin achariti, aval metzia delekka lememar hachi, ema lo. tzericha:

Yishshava sheen lo vah pachot mechetzyah. veeno nishba shekkullah shello kidka tain meikkara, deha lo yahave leh kullah. vei mishtava shechetzyah shello kiddeka yahavi leh, hava merea leh ledibbureh kamma deamar kullah shelli. hilkach yishshava sheen lo bah pachot mechetzyah, demashma hachi, kullah shelli kidka amena meikkara, uledivrechem sheen attem maaminim li bechullah, shevua sheyyesh li bah veen li bah pachot mechetzyah:
Bet hatztzevita. garsinan. makom sheochazin hakkeli keshemmoshitin oto mizze laze. leshon vayyitzbot lah kali (Rut 2) shepperusho vayyoshet. veit degarse, bet hatztzevia, makom sheochez bo veetzbao:
Veyesh lahen bet hatztzevita. sheim nitmeu achorav, bet hatztzevita tahor. veim nitma bet hatztzevita, achorav tehorin:

Laareva gedola shel etz. yesh lah bet tzevita. aval lishar kelim, lo. shebbaareva gedola yesh hefresh ben bet hatztzevita laachorayim, sheim yesh mashkim baachore haareva veyadav temeot, ochez bevet hatztzevita veen choshesh shemma yigga bammashkin shebbaachorav veyachzeru vitammeu et haareva:
Rabbi akiva omer lechosot. af lechosot yesh lahen bet tzevita:

Leyadayim hattemeot vehattehorot. yesh hefresh ben bet hatztzevita laachorayim, leyadayim hattemeot kidfareshit, velithorot kedimfaresh lekamman ketzad. verabbi yose savar leyadayim tehorot bilvad lo chayshinan, aval leyadayim temeot chayshinan. vahalacha ketanna kamma uchedimfaresh rabbi yose:
Ezo hi aveda. shennikkar bah sheen habbealim yodim shehi sham:
En zo aveda. veeno chayyav lehachazir, shemmiddaat hinnichuha sham:
Ratza ben hakkeramim. shemmitkalkelim ragleha:
Hashev teshivem. hattora ribbeta hashavot harebe:
Lo yomar lo ten li sela. shezze omer lo, im asita melachtecha, hayita marbe torach, achshav lefi ma shettarachta tol:
Kefoel batel. kamma adam rotze littol velifchot missecharo libbatel mimmelacha zo keveda shehu osek bah velaasot bimlacha kalla kazo:

Im yesh sham bet din. im eno rotze libbatel mimmelachto, shessecharah merubbe, ma yaase. im yesh sham shelosha bene adam matne bifnehem veomer, reu sheani mistakker kach vechach, vei efshi libbatel littol sachar muat, im tomru sheettol sechari mishshalem, atappel bahashavat aveda zo:
Shello kodem. umanniach et haaveda:
Ellu metziot. matza ferot mefuzzarim. setaman nityaashu habbealim vehefker hem:
Maot mefuzzarot. hoil veen lahem siman nikkar, kevar iyyaushe iyyaash vehefker hen. vehayenu taama dechullehu:
Kerichot. omarim ketannim:
Birshut harabbim. shehakkol dashim alehem, vaafillu haya bahen siman, nifsad:
Shel nachtom. en bahem siman, shekkullam shavim. aval shel baal habbayit yesh lahem siman:
Habbaot mimmedinatan. laafoke habbaot mibbet haumman, kidkatane sefa:
Uleshonot shel argaman. tzemer tzavua argaman, umashuch kemin lashon:
Matza iggul. shel devela:

Enporya. kelim chadashim shello sevatan haayin veen labbealim bahem teviat ayin. sheppeamim shemmachazirim aveda bitviut ena, kegon letzureba merabbanan delo meshanne bedibbureh. veillu hakkelim sheyyadua sheen levaalehen bahen teviut ayin eno chayyav lehacheriz. vahalacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar. veematay, bizman shemmetzaan echad echad. aval metzaan shenayim shenayim chayyav lehacheriz, deminyana have siman. vehammotze metzia bisratya ufelatya gedola beir sherubbah nachrim, afillu davar sheyyesh bo siman eno chayyav lehacheriz. uveir sherubbah yisrael, chayyav lehacheriz:
Deyateke. tzavvaat shechiv mera. da tehe lemekam velihyot:
Veshovrim. sheose malve lelove shennifra mimmennu shetar chovo:
Leshatiach. lishtoach al gabbe karka veleshev alav:
Sekorteya. or shellovshim haabbedanim bishat melachtan:
Katavolya. or shemmatztziin al gabbe hammitta veshochvim alav:
Or hachammar. garsinan. velo garsinan or hachamor. kelomar or shemmesim hachammar al begadav keshemmechammer achar behemto:
Or hakkattan. or shennotnim lifnehem ummane fishtan kede shello yidbak hanneoret shel pishtan bevigdehem:
Or hakkattaf. shemmesim hakkattaf bichtefo shello yazzik lo hammasseoy sheal ketefo:
Or harofe. rofe hachabburot noten lefanav or shello yittannefu vegadav bedam happetzaim:
Or haarisa. shemmesimim al arisa shel katan:
Or hallev shel katan. regilim hayu lachgor or al matne hakkatan keneged libbo, shello yakkennu hechatul al libbo veyamut:
Or hakkar vehakkeset. shel mitta:
Or hassarok. or shechogrim ummane hammasrekot al matnehen:
Or hassorek. ummanim hassorkim pishtan:
Rabbi eliezer omer midras. vechol shekken teme met. deha tenan beferek ba siman [nidda daf mat] kol hattame midras mittamme teme met:
Vachachamim omrim teme met. velo midras, sheen asuyin leshev alehen. vahalacha kachachamim:

Kol hakkelim yesh lahem achorayim vatoch. kelim shennitmeu vemashkin temeim, im nagu hammashkin meachorehen shel kelim nitmeu achorehen velo nitma tochan, mishshum detumat mashkim letamme chelim lav deorayta, hekellu chachamim betumatan. aval im nitma tochan, kegon shennagu mashkin temein betochan, nitmeu achorehem. vehayenu ditnan yesh lahen achorayim vatoch, kelomar shechaluk din achorehem middin tochan:

Kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot. veaf al pi shemmishtammeshim bahen betochan uvaachorehen, sherauy lehafchan velaasot tochan achorehen vaachorehen tochan, af al pi chen chaluk din tochan middin achorehen:
Martzufin. sakkin gedolim shel or shemmolichim bahen sechorot bassefinot:
Kol sheyyesh lo tovrot. lulaot, kemo sheyyesh lemichnasayim, tefurot laachorav shel beged:

Yesh lo achorayim vatoch. dechevan deyesh lo tovrot lo chazi lehafcho, vetocho chaluk meachorav. aval kesheen lo tovrot, dachazi lehafcho, en tocho chaluk meachorav, ella cheshennagu mashkim temeim ben meachorav ben mittocho nitma chullo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hashshulchan vehaddelufki. kasavar rabbi yehuda, kevan defanav meshuppim vachalakin, happanim hahem niddonim tocho. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Matza vachanut hare ellu shello. bedavar sheen bo siman mayre. dehahu denafal minneh miyyaesh, shehakkol nichnasim lesham:
Ben teva. shehachenvani yoshev lefaneha, vetamid notel mimmenna, venoten lefanav umocher, umaot shennotnin lo noten betochah, velo nafal shum davar ella miyyad chenvani:

Lifne shulchani hare ellu shello. deamrinan min habbaim lehachalif maot naflu, shehare hashshulchan mafsik ben shulchani lammaot shennimtzeu, veim min hashshulchani hem haya lahem lehimmatze beno velakkisse shehashshulchan munnach alav:

Hallokeach perot mechavero vechulei. uchegon shechavero ze taggar shellakach tevua zo o ferot hallalu meanashim harebe velo yedia deman ninhu, vechevan delet behu siman nityaashu habbealim. aval im ze shemmachar et happerot likketan hu atzmo min hakkarka shello, shevvadday hammaot hallalu shello hen, chayyav lehachazir:
Veim hayu tzerurim. hakkesher o minyan shellahem have siman:
Nafa uchevara. shel or hem. ufeamim osim nafa missear, vedinah kedin sak. vechen peamim osim kevara mechavalim shel shifa veshel gemi, vedinah kedin mappatz:
Ad sheyyekatztzea. sheyyachtoch vitakken lemoshav. vahalacha kachachamim:

Af al pi sheen bo gavoah tefach. veaf al gav deshel gadol lo mittamme bivtzir mittefach, keditnan leel beferek hashshulchan vehaddelufki [mishna 3], kisse shel katan chazi lishiva afillu bivtzir mittefach:
Ad sheyyihye vo chashshiur. im hu mibbeged ad sheyyihye shelosha al shelosha, keshiur tumat habbeged lemidras:
Venimdad kaful. shelosha lefanav ushelosha leacharav, nimtza cheshepposhto shehu shishsha orech al shelosha rochav, arko chiflayim kerachbo:
Amar lishnayim gazalti leechad mikkem. vehem enam tovim lo kelum, ella hu ba latzet yede shamayim:

Noten laze mane velaze mane. aval shenayim shettevauhu vehoda sheggazal leechad mehem, yishshava kol echad mehem shello gazal, venoten mane laze umane laze. kenas kenasuhu chachamim mippene sheavar al lo tigzol. vechen shenayim shettavu leechad, kol echad omer avi hifkid etzlecha mane, vehu omer aviv shel echad mikkem hinniach li mane veeni yodea ezehu, hare kol echad mehem nishba sheaviv hinniach etzlo mane, venoten mane laze umane laze, deihu pasha benafsheh, dahava leh lemedak velizkor mi hinniach etzlo hammane:
Sevachot. kippa shennosot hannashim al roshan, asuya keen reshet sheyyesh bah nekavim dakkin:
Shel yalda. rauy lishiva, ulechach temea midras:

Shel zekena. maaseha mochichim aleha sheenah reuya lishiva. uvattosefta tanya, shel zekena temea midras, sheenah makpedet aleha ufeamim yoshevet aleha. veshel yalda shemmakpedet al keleha, enah yoshevet aleha, ulechach temea teme met:
Veshel yotzot hachutz. sudar shennotnot hannashim al roshan kesheyyotzot lachutz. veyesh mefarshim, yotzot hachutz, targum zona nafkat bara, kelomar sevachot shel zonot:
Tehorot. lefi sheenan chashuvot keli. perush acher, sevachot shennikreu verov sear haishsha yotze lachutz, sheenan mekabbelot rov sear roshah shel ishsha:
Or shehu tame midras. kegon shatiach vechayyotze vo:
Af haose mitpachat min haor. shehu tame midras:

Temea. hammitpachat, shehammitpachat doma leshatiach, difamim shehu yoshev aleha. aval im katzatz hakkesatot shel or hattemeot veasa mehen mitpachot, tehorot, midi dahave akkelim shennishberu. umihu mekabbelot tuma mikkan ulehabba, keditnan leel beferek 24:
Shennittelu shenatzav. lerabbanan mayre shello nittelu legamre ella shennitteku min hallulaot vaadayin teluyot bakkis. ulerabbi yose afillu nittelu legamre, mippene shehedyot yachol lehacheziram:
Nifshat. hakkis venaasa kemin or chalak sheen lo vet kibbul, tahor:
Tala alav matlit. natan beshulav telay, kelomar chaticha ketanna shel or chibber bo millematta, dederech hakkisim machnisim or katan ben hattefira ucheshepposhto nishar oto haor velo vatal kibbulo:
Lo nitma chavero. detumat mashkin letamme chelim lav deorayta vela chashiv chibbur:

Tzeror hammargalit. mannichin margalit betoch or lihyot shemura sham vekoshrim oto, ucheshemmotziin hammargalit nishar haor kemo chis ad sheyyitrach vifashshet, mechamat otah margalit sheamda yamim rabbim venitzrar:

Tzeror hammaot. kemo tzeror hammargalit. vetaama ditzror hammargalit mittamme tefe, mishshum dederech tzeror hammargalit laamod yoter mitztzeror hammaot, shetztzeror hammaot regilim lehattir tamid, mishshum dilhotzaa nittenu. vahalacha kachachamim:
Shechenav. shechene makom shennimtzet bo haaveda, shemma shellahen hi:

Kede sheyyelech kol echad leveto bishlosha yamim. mishsheyyishma hahachraza, veyeda im avad lo chelum, veim yire sheavad yachazor shelosha veyachriz yom echad ani ibbadti veellu simaneha. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. umishshecharav bet hammikdash hitkinu sheyyihyu machrizin bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. umishsherabbu haannasin deamre avedta lemalka, hitkinu sheyyehe modia lishchenav velimyuddaav vedayyo:
Chaticha shel kadshe kadashim. sheasura lezarim umutteret lakkohanim:
Veshel piggul veshel notar veshel tame. daasire ben lezarim ben lakkohanim:
Shennitbashshelu im hachatichot. shel chullin, veyesh bachullin kede levattel shel kadshe kadashim bifne atzman veshel piggul notar vetame bifne atzman:
Asur lezarim. rabbanan letaamayhu deamre shenayim ushelosha shemot mitztarfin leesor:
Rabbi shimon mattir lezarim. letaameh deamar shenayim o shelosha shemot mimmin echad [en] mitztarfin:
Haya ose shenayim min habbeged. shene tefachim:
Veechad min hassak. tefach echad:
Tahor. deen haggarua mashlim shiuro shel chashuv, dehaggarua shiuro merubbe. aval hechashuv mashlim shiuro shel garua, daafillu veshiur muat hechashuv mekabbel tuma:
Min hechamur. desaggi leh beshiur muat:

Min hakkal. devae shiur merubbe. vedavka chasseder hazze hakkatuv bammishna mitztarfin lakkal shebbahen, habbeged vehassak, hassak vehaor, haor vehammappatz. aval beged vaor, o beged umappatz, o sak umappatz, en mitztarfin, dehamchabberan batla dato etzel kol adam. umihu laasot mehen telay al gabbe mardaat shel chamor, kullan mitztarfin, demeeze mehen sheyyekatztzea tefach veyaase oto telay lemardaat shel chamor, mitztaref, deeno makpid lesham im hu mishshene minim:
Yesh meviin bikkurim vekorin. mikra bikkurim, mearammi oved avi ad sof happarasha:

Vehivrich letoch shel yachid. shechafar guma vehitmin yichur shel ilan betochah vechissahu beafar, vehotzi rosh hayyichur letoch sede chavero o virshut harabbim. vechen im hannetia omedet betoch shel chavero o virshut harabbim vehotzi rosh hayyichur betoch shello, eno mevi, kedimfaresh besamuch, lefi sheen kol haggiddulim meadmato:
Vederech hayyachid o derech harabbim baemtza. kegon sheyyesh lo shete ginnot mishshene tzidde hadderachim, eno mevi, sheen kol haggiddulim meadmato:

Kaze mevi. kevan sheyyesh lo reshut laasot ken, shemmuttar laasot chalal tachat reshut harabbim kesheeno mazzik larabbim kelum, admatcha karinan beh. umikkol makom savar rabbi yehuda sheaf al pi shemmevi eno kore. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
En lahem achorayim vatoch. dehannogea beechad mehen kenogea bechullo. veyesh lahen achorayim vatoch ditnan leel, davka litruma:
Veen matbilin kelim letoch kelim. kesheshshenehem temeim, mippene shekkavdo shel keli chotzetz. vechashu lekodesh yoter mibbatteruma:

Yordim lide tumatan bemachashava. kegon tabbaat behema sheenah mekabbelet tuma, chashav aleha littenah beetzba adam, mekabbelet tuma mikkan vaelach bemachashava zo. aval tabbaat adam shechashav aleha littenah livhema, leolam hi mekabbelet tuma, ad sheyyaase vah shinnuy maase leshannot tzuratah:

Umachashava enah mevattelet lo miyyad maase velo miyyad machashava. im leachar shechashav al tabbaat behema laasotah laadam, shehi mekabbelet tuma vemachashava zo, chazar vechashav aleha lehachezirah labbehema, en machashava zo hashsheniyya maala mide tuma sheyyarda lah bammachashava harishona:
Avedato kodemet. deamar kera (Devarim 15) efes ki lo yihye becha evyon, hizzaher shello tihye atta evyon:
Shel rabbo kodemet. vehu sheyyihye rabbo muvhak, shellamad rov chachmato mimmennu. vechen kol hanach rabbo deamrinan bematnitin shekodmin leaviv, enan ella berabbo muvhak:
Acharayut nechasim. shibud karkaot sheyyigbe mehem:

Lo yachazir. dechayshinan leferaon veliknuneya. shemma shetar parua hu umin hallove nafal, veha deka mode lo farati, etza shel rammaut hi benehem litrof et hallakochot shellakchu mimmennu karka shello veacharayut, vichallekuha benehem:

Ben kach uven kach lo yachazir. dishtar sheen bo acharayut mimmeshabede nammi gave, deacharayut taut sofer hu, vechayshinan leferaon veliknuneya. vahalacha kachachamim. vedavka bishtar sheen nizkar bo acharayut amru chachamim detaut sofer hu vegave mimmeshabede cheillu haya haacharayut katuv bo. aval im peresh bashshetar sheeno rotze lekabbel alav acharayut, modim chachamim deyachazir, dehashta lekka lemechash liknuneya:
Kol davar sheose veochel. im haaveda davar sheyyecholim lehaachilo et sechar maasav, kegon shor vachamor:

Yaase veyochal. velo yimkor oto hammotze, shekkol adam noach lo bivhemto shehikkira bo kevar velimmedah lirtzono. veeno chayyav lehittafel bah leolam, ella tarnegolet uvehema gassa metappel bah shenem asar chodesh. agalim useyachim shel reiyya, kelomar sheen megaddelim otam lefattem, vechen gedayim utelaim, metappel bahem shelosha chodashim. vaagalim shel pittum metappel bahem sheloshim yom. avazin vetarnegolim zecharim, hakketannim metappel bahen sheloshim yom, vehaggedolim sheochlim harebe metappel bahen shelosha yamim. mikkan vaelach lokeach otam hu leatzmo beshuma kefi shavyan, o mochran laacherim umeniach haddamim etzlo:

Lefichach im avdu chayyav beacharayutan. kevan desharu leh rabbanan leishtammushe behu, af al gav delo ishtammesh behu keman deishtammesh dame, vechayyav beacharayutan. vahalacha kerabbi tarfon bidme aveda shemmachar. aval maot atzman shel aveda, kegon shemmatza maot bakkis o shelosha matbeot zo al gabbe zo, lo yishtammesh bahem kelal:
Achat lishloshim yom. shemmitappeshin kesheshshohin millefatchan. vechol sifrehen hayu asuyin keen gillayon:
Gollan. mittechillatan lesofan, sheyyikkanes bahem haavir:
Battechilla. ma shello lamad meolam. lefi shetztzarich lehashehotan lefanav:
Velo yikra acher immo. lefi shezze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo venikra:
Shotchah letzarkah. lishlot bah avir, shello tochallenna ash:
Letzarkan. shemmitappeshim bakkarka. shetztzarich letittan bakkarka, dezo hi shemiratan. ulefichach mishtammesh bahem lifrakim:
Aval lo leshochokan. velo yishtammesh bahen zeman aroch ad sheyyishchakem:
Lo yigga bahen. zahav eno mitappesh baaretz. vechen zechuchit. veod shehu noach lehishshaver:
Sheen darko littol. davar sheggenay hu lo. vehattora amra vehitallamta mehem, peamim sheatta mitallem, kegon zaken veeno lefi kevodo:
Iggerot shum. sheshshamu bet din nichse love lammalve bechovo:
Veiggerot mazon. shekkibbel alav lazun et bat ishto. perush acher, sheyyimkeru mikkarka habbaal limzon haishsha vehabbanot:
Umeunin. shekkotvim bashshetar befanenu meana felonit bifloni balah. uviktanna shehissiuha immah veachiha sheenah tzericha get:
Shetare verurin. ze borer lo echad veze borer lo echad sheyyadunu lahem:
Matza. shetarot:
Bachafisa. chemet shel or ketanna:
Bidluskema. keli or shehazzekenim matzniim bah kele tashmisham shello yitztarchu lechappes acharehem:
Tachrich shel shetarot. shelosha shetarot o yoter keruchin ze vaze:
Agudda. mushkavim ze al ze, arko shel ze al arko shel ze:
Hare ze yachazir. dedavar sheyyesh bo siman hu, shehakkeli siman kesheyyomru habbealim bichli peloni matzata otam. vechen tachrich vaagudda siman hu:

Echad hallove mishshelosha. im shelosha shetarot shel love echad hen shellava mishshelosha vene adam, yachazirem hammotze lallove, devadday miyyado naflu, sheim miyyadam naflu mi kibbetzam lemakom echad. vedavka shehashshetarot mekuyyamim bevet din. aval im enam mekuyyamim chayshinan dilma lekayyominhu holichum shelosha hammalvim etzel sofer haddayyanim venaflu miyyad hassofer. veen lachush shemma leachar shekkiyyemu otam naflu miyyad hassofer, delo mashhe eynish kiumeh biyda desafra. veim shelosha lovim hem, shellavu meadam echad, yachazirem hammotze lammalve, shehaddavar yadua shemmimmennu naflu. veim hayu shelashtan ketivat sofer echad, chayshinan shemma miyyad hassofer naflu velo lavu meolam, ulefichach lo yachazir:
Matza shetar ben shetarotav veeno yodea ma tivo. etzlo. im hallove hifkido etzlo o hammalve, o shemma miktzato parua umesaruhu lo lihyot shalish benehem:
Yehe munnach. beyado, velo yachazir lo laze velo laze:
Im yesh immahen simponot. hammotze ben shetarotav shover shennichtav al echad mishshetarotav:

Yaase ma shebbassimpon. vehashshetar bechezkat parua. veaf al pi shehaya rauy lashshover hazze lihyot munnach beyad hallove velo beyad hammalve, amrinan heemino hallove lammalve. veamar lemachar tenehu li, veshachach. vehu shemmatza hammalve hashshetar hazze shennichtav alav hashshover, ben hashshetarot keruim, af al pi shello nikra:
Metzaah barefet. af al pi sheenah mishtammeret bah, kegon sheenah neula:

Veim hayta bevet hakkevarot. vehu kohen, lo yittamma lah. shehashavat aveda ase, hashev teshivem leachicha, uvetumat kohen, ase dikdoshim yihyu (Vayikra 21) velo taase dilnefesh lo yittamma beammav (sham). veen ase doche et lo taase vaase:

O sheamar lo al tachazir. vehaaveda bemakom shemmitzva lehachazir, hare ze lo yishma lo. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru, sheim avicha omer lecha challel et hashshabbat al tishma lo. vechen bishar kol hammitzvot:
Halach veyashav lo. baal hachamor:
Mitzva min hattora lifrok. bechinnam:
Aval lo liton. bechinnam. ella besachar:
Rabbi shimon omer af liton. bechinnam. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Rabbi yose haggelili omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Melo hassit. hu kede hefsek sheyyesh ben amma leetzba, kol ma sheyyachol leharechivo. vehefsek sheyyesh ben haaguddal laetzba kol ma sheyyuchal leharechivo hu hassit kaful, lefi shehu kaful mimma sheyyesh ben amma laetzba. umelo hassit hu shiur chashuv leissur, hilkach keshearago veveged veen yadua eze hu, rabbi meir omer yiddaleku, letaameh, vachachamim omrim yaalu veechad umatayim letaamayhu, kiflugta dilel:
Hassocher para mechavero. veamad socher vehishilah leacher birshut hammaskir. sheim lo natan lo hammaskir reshut, ha kayma lan shomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav:
Yishshava hassocher. lammaskir.
Shemmeta chedarkah ufatur. shehassocher patur min hoonasin:
Vehashshoel. shehu chayyav boonasin, meshallem lassocher, bishvua shehu nishba lammaskir:
Amar rabbi yose ketzad halla ose sechora vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Ella mishshivat hamminin. dichtiv (Devarim 26) mereshit, velo kol reshit, sheen kol happerot chayyavim babbikkurim ella shivat hamminin shennishtabbecha bahen eretz yisrael chitta useora vegomer, udevash hu devash temarim:
Mittemarim shebbeharim uferot shebbaamakim. lefi shehen geruin:
Velo mizzete shemen sheenam min hammuvchar. dichtiv (sham 9) zet shemen, zayit agori, shebbaim alav geshamim vehu oger shamno letocho, vehu muvchar umeshubbach:
En meviin bikkurim kodem laatzeret. dishte hallechem shemmeviin baatzeret ikkeru bikkurim (Vayikra 23), vehem mattirin hechadash bammikdash:
Haarisin. mekabbelin et hassade lemechetza lishlish velirvia:
Chachirot. mekabbel et hassade bedavar katzuv, kach vechach korim leshana, ben shehi osa harebe ben shehi osa meat:

Sikkarikon. horeg nefashot, venoten lo karka kede shello yahargennu. uleshon sikkarikon sa karka vahanicheni. veaf al gav deyahev leh lefi shaa, lo machil leh, desavar haidna lishkol ulemachar tevana leh bedina:
Sefek arla. kegon oved kochavim sheyyesh lo netiot shel arla beginnato, uveyado perot, veen yadua im mishshel arla im mishshel zekena:
Beeretz yisrael. dahave sefeka deorayta lechumra:
Uvesureya muttar. dechibbush yachid hu velav shemeh kibbush, vehechemiru vo ketzat:
Uvechutza laaretz yored velokeach. betoch hagginna vekone min haoved kochavim meotam shellikket kevar, uvilvad shello yirennu loket:
Uvechutza laaretz yored veloket. haoved kochavim yored veloket bifne hayyisrael veyisrael kone mimmennu, uvilvad shello yilkot yisrael bayyad:
Bechol makom. vaafillu bechutza laaretz, dichtiv (Vayikra 24) velechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu vegomer‏ bechol moshvotechem:
Vehaarla halacha. lemoshe missinay sheasur bechutza laaretz, veaf al pi chen sefekah muttar, shekkach neemra hahalacha lemoshe besinay, sheyyihye sefekah muttar bechutza laaretz:

Vehakkilayim middivre sofrim. davka kile hakkerem, kevan devaaretz chamire vaasurim bahanaa min hattora, bechutza laaretz gazru vah rabbanan, aval kile zeraim devaaretz sharu bahanaa, bechutza laaretz lo gazru behu rabbanan. veharekavat hailan asura bechutza laaretz min hattora, dichtiv (sham 19) behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim, ma behemtecha beharebaa af sadcha beharekava, uma behemtecha ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, af sadcha beharekava ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz:
Sheyyesh chesron melacha. sheadayin chasera maase veachar kach titkayyem [hammelacha]:

Ella hautzba. sheaf al pi shechasera melacha, machashava metammeatah, lefi sheen makpidin al chesron melacha shellah. veutzba hu or hamechasse et hammerkav, veenah tzericha kitztzua, dechevan daasuya lechissuy eno choshesh lekitztzua:
Shel baal habbayit. deeno asuy lemachran, veose mehen mittot vedulepkaot vetavlaot. chashav alehen ledavar sheruyin lo velo chesron melacha, mekabbelim tuma miyyad:
Veshel abbedan. deasuy limmacher, en hammachashava metammetan. daavid demimmelich umochran vehallokeach yaase mehen minalim, vaadayin lo nigmera melachtan lechach:
Shel gannav machashava metammetan. diknanhu veyeush. dekasavar setam geneva yeush bealim hu, delo yade mimman letavo:
Veshel gazlan en machashava metammetan. veaf al pi shechashav alehen ledavar sheen bo chesron melacha. distam gezela en bo yeush bealim, dechevan deyada man gazleh azel vetava leh bedina:

Chilluf haddevarim. setam gezela ikka yeush, dileneh shakal minneh umichza chaza deeynash alma hu umiyyaash, aval setam geneva, savar mashkachna leh laggannav vetavana leh ledina velo miyyaash. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Veyesh bo chede lechammetz asur. ha ka mashma lan delo amrinan hoil uvelo seor ze shel issur hayta haissa mitchammetzet al yede seor shel hetter shennafal bo techilla, lo nachush lisor shel issur:

Ellu nimdadim kefulin. detzarich sheyyihye hashshiur mishshene tzedadim, kevan deorchayhu lehishtammesh bahen mishshene tzedadim, i have hashshiur mitztzad echad lo mahane. perush acher, nimdadim kefulim, shekkol beged bimkom hachatach derech hachutim latzet mimmennu umitkalkel venoach likkara, vederech hattofrim lichpol meat seviv hachatach vetofer, vehayenu nimdad kaful dekatane, dilachar shennichpal tzarich sheyyihye vo chede middato, vei lekka chede middato af al pi sheim haya mattir hattefira ufoshto haya vo chede middato, lo mahane:
Anpalya. minal hammaggia ad haarkubba. ben shel beged ben shel or:
Pemolinya. kemin michnasayim gedolim mimmatnayim vead yerechayim, veyesh lehen shenatzim:
Vechova. shebbarosh:
Vechis shel punda. ezor chalul, vehu cheen kis heasuy lekabbel:
Matlit. telay:
Shettelayah al hassafa. shettefarah al hassafa saviv latztzavvar:
Im peshuta. sheenah tefura mishshene tzedadim ella o millefanav o meacharav. velapperush hashsheni, shello nichpal min hachut seviv hattefira:

Sheeno yachol lomar asher nishba laavotenu latet lanu. sheen avotav miyyisrael, vehaggerim lo natlu chelek baaretz. verambam katav sheen halacha kemishna zo, ella hagger mevi vekore, umatze lememar laavotenu latet lanu, mippene shehaaretz nittena leavraham, vehu av laggerim kemo leyisrael, dichtiv (Bereshit 17) ki av hamon goyim netatticha, vedarshinan beh [berachot 13.] lesheavar hayita av laaram achshav atta av lechol haolam. vechen keshehu mitpallel, ben beno leven atzmo ben bevet hakkeneset, omer elohe avotenu, afillu en immo miyyisrael:

Hakketannim. kol shessamuch al shulchan aviv afillu hu gadol kare leh katan, umetziato leaviv mishshum eva. vehabbat ben ketanna ben naara metziatah leaviha, dehattora zikketa kol shevach neureha leaviha:
Avdo veshifchato hakkenaanim. shehare gufan kanuy lo, kedichtiv (Vayikra 25) vehitnachaltem otam:
Metziat ishto. rabbanan takkinu leh mishshum eva:

Lo tinnase lakkehunna. dichtiv (Yechezkel 44) mizzera bet yisrael yikchu lahem nashim, [uchesheimmah] miyyisrael karena vah mizzera yisrael, demashma vaafillu miktzat zera. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov lechattechilla, aval bediavad im nasa en motziin otah mimmennu, uvaneha kesherim afillu lihyot kohanim gedolim:
Haappotroppos. hammemunne al hayetomim, ben shemminnuhu bet din ben shemminnahu avi yetomim. appotroppos avi hakketannim, bilshon romi korin leav 300 veliktannim 146:

Vehashshaliach. shellikketan mittechilla leshalchan beyad acher, az matze lemishlechinhu, aval likketan lahavian hu atzmo lo matze lemishlechinhu, shekkol bikkurim shenniru likria enan nittanim ella bikria:
Vehaishsha. aval im yesh lah baal, baalah mevi vekore, dichtiv (Devarim 26) asher natan lecha Adonai‏ elohecha ulevetecha, melammed sheadam mevi bikkure ishto vekore:
Sheen yecholin lomar asher natatta li. shello nitchalleka haaretz lannekevot. uchetiv (Bamidbar 26) ish lefi fekudav, ad sheyyihye vadday ish:

Mitztzemer habbechor. veasur ligzoz bechor, shenneemar (Devarim 15) velo tagoz bechor tzonecha. uvivchor baal mum ayre, ulehachi bae melo hassit, deillu bechor tam hare hu mukdashim, utenan uvammukdashim mekaddeshim kol shehu:
Misar hannazir. usearo asur bahanaa shenneemar (Bamidbar 6) kadosh yihye gaddel pera, giddulo shel pera yihye kadosh:
Umippeter chamor. leachar arifa kulle alma modu deasur bahanaa, degamrinan arifa arifa meegla arufa:
Besak. gabbe tzemer tena beged vegabbe sear tena sak dehachi orcheh:

Mikkullam. meeze mehen sheyyekatztzea tefach al tefach rauy littamme moshav. dehane shiure ditnan leel, habbeged shalosh al shalosh lemidras vehassak arbaa al arbaa vechulei, lo have ella vachatichat beged o sak o or o mappatz shello chatachah vetikkenah lishiva, aval hamekatztzea dehaynu hamechattech vehametakken meechad mikkullan tefach al tefach kede leshev alav, tame moshav, shekken lifamim maktziin veosim telay meechad mehen lemardaat shel chamor veyoshvim alav, velo have ella tefach al tefach:
Mikkol makom. vaafillu min hatztzedadim. verabbi shimon savar demin hatztzedadim lo chazi lemoshav. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Habbeged mittamme mishshum chamishsha shemot. kedimfaresh veazel, mishshum keli kibbul, mishshum moshav, mishshum ohalim, mishshum arig, mishshum shalosh al shalosh. vechol echad mehem meshunne shiuro ze mizze. ketzad, beged sheyyesh lo vet kibbul, kegon tzeror margalit ditnan leel, o vet kibbul shemen, o vet kibbul shaava, shiuro vechol shehu. [umishshum moshav, im nitma] bemidras hazzav, shiuro en pachot mishshelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim. veim naasa ohel lammet dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehizza al haohel, en tame befachot mittefach al tefach. veim hu avnet o chagor, mittamme mishshum arig, af al pi sheen bo shiur sheyyihye rauy lehikkare veged, sheen berachbo shalosh etzbaot, afillu hachi tame mippene shehu arig. veyalfinan leh missak, ma sak tavuy vearig af kol tavuy vearig. vechol shear tumot en beged mittamme velo metamme befachot mishshalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot, deeno chashuv lo laaniyyim velo laashirim veeno karuy beged:
Hassak. hu haarig missear venotza shel izzim:
Mishshum arbaa shemot. deshiur shalosh etzbaot [al shalosh etzbaot] en bo:
Haor mishshum shelosha. delet beh mishshum shalosh al shalosh, velet beh nammi mishshum arig:
Haetz mishshum shenayim. delet beh tumat ohalim, keditnan beferek bamme madlikin, kol hayyotze min haetz eno mittamme tumat ohalim. velet beh nammi mishshum arig, velo mishshum shalosh al shalosh:

Hacheres mishshum echad. mishshum bet kibbul bilvad. delet beh kol hane deamrinan. umidras nammi let beh, dichtiv bemidras hazzav (Vayikra 15) veish asher yigga bemishkavo, makkish mishkavo lo, ma hu sheyyesh lo tohora vemikve af kol sheyyesh lo tohora vemikve, perat lecheres sheen lo tohora vemikve sheeno naase mishkav lazzav:
En lo achorayim. sheen keli cheres mekabbel tuma meachorav, kedichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho vegomer. veim naga tuma meachorav lo nitma kelal:
Shehu mittamme mishshum arig. ma sheen ken beor, daafillu chatacho lirtzuot dakkot vaaragan eno chashuv arig:
Kaf lokte kotzim. kemin kaf yad shel or tofsim melakkete kotzim bidehen, shello yenukkevu yedehen bakkotzim:
Tehora. deenah asuya lekabbala:
Hazzon. ezor kemin avnet. uvilshon yevani korin lachagor 73:
Birkeyar. defus shel or natun al habbirkayim, kede sheyyuchelu laamod al birkehen:
Temeim. daasuyim lekabbala:
Sharvulim. kemin bet yad shel or dachuk vatzar shennotnim baale ummanut bizrootehen, kede shello yippelu vigdehen harchavim al yadan vivattelu otan mimmelachtan:
Perakminin. garsinan. vehu davar shemmechattel vekosher bo faddachto:
Bet etzbaot. kemin yad shel or asuy lehachenis etzbeotav letocho:
Kayyatzin. melakkete kotzim. perush acher, melakkete ferot hakkayitz:
Haog. peri adom hammatzuy bailan sheggadel bayyaar meelav. ufeamim shehamelakketim kotzim bayarim melakketim haog venotnim oto bevet etzbaot, nimtza shehu asuy lekabbala:
Kelim shessachan. kegon minalim ushear kelim shel or shessachin otan beshemen lerakkechan:

Vechazar vesachan beshemen tahor. leachar shennityabbesh hashshemen harishon vehitbilo lakkeli shennitma beshemen tame, chazar vesacho beshemen tahor, ucheshemmishtammeshim bakkeli niflat hashshemen lachutz:
Achar rishon ani ba. desavar rabbi eliezer rishon niflat lachutz:
Vachachamim omrim achar acharon. savre acharon niflat. vahalacha kachachamim:

Harova vaachorav temeim. harova hayenu tocho, vaachorav hayenu haddefanot hammakkifot et harova mibbachutz. aval dofen hammafsik ben shenehem, bichlal tocho shel chatzi rova, vetahor tzad shekkelappe chatzi rova. vechen keshennitma chatzi harova, chatzi rova vaachorav temein. chatzi harova hayenu tocho, vaachorav hayenu defanot hammakkifot chatzi harova mibbachutz, vedofen hammafsik, tzad shel kelappe harova bichlal tocho shel rova:
Nitmeu achore harova. hayenu defanot hammakkifot mibbachutz:
En cholkin et haggabbayim. hayenu haachorayim, vechol haachorayim temein keshennitma echad min haachorayim:

Matbil et kullo. rova vachatzi rova. veen halacha kerabbi meir. vedin dofen haemtzai meforash leel besof perek 2, derabbi yochanan ben nuri omer cholkin et avyo, hameshammesh lattame tame vehameshammesh lattahor tahor:
Nitpatztzeu haegozim. garsinan, velo garsinan ketzad, veka mashma lan matnitin dedavka shelemim lo betile, aval lo shevurim ufetzuim:
Nitparsu hakkikkarot. hay setama kerabbi akiva, dehilcheta kevateh:
Harova vachatzi harova. kegon chatichat etz ava vaarukka uvo shete middot chakukot zo etzel zo, echad machazik rova veechad machazik chatzi rova, vedofen mafsik ben zo lezo:
Keli shennitma tocho. bitmiha. vechi cheli shennitma tocho lo nitmeu achorav, veammay tenan lo nitma chatzi rova, vahalo achorav shel rova hi:

[Shelloot] kodmin hi. kol achat mehen lavta hakkedima mechavertah, kelomar sheen lahem kedima zo al zo. ucheshem sheatta omer shechatzi rova achorayim larova, kach tomar sheharova achorayim lachatzi rova, ucheshennitma harova, achorav shel chatzi rova nitmeu velo tocho. vegirsat rabbotay, shel kat kodmim hi, lefi shekkittot shel talmidim hayu yoshvim lefanav shurot, amar lahem sheela zo kevar shealuha mimmenni hakkat shel talmidim yoshvim bashshura hakkodemet, vechach heshavti lahem o shemma vechulei:
Mochin shehakkoves motzi. melabben hatztzemer motzi min hatztzemer davar muat al yede shetifa:
Hare ellu shello. sheen habbaal [habbayit] makpid. veim hikpid lo have kefeda:
Veshehassorek motzi. hassorek et hatztzemer vehamenappetzo, ma shemmotzi have davar chashuv uregilim lehakepid:

Hakkoves notel shelosha chutim. derech bigde tzemer lehanniach besof arigatan shelosha chutin mimmin acher. vehakkoves notlan umashve habbeged umeyappehu. veim chutin shechorin hem arugim beveged lavan, rashshay hakkoves littol hakkol, lefi shehashshachor ballavan meganne oto beyoter:
Hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede litpor bo. shehu kimlo orech hammachat:
Umatlit shehi shalosh al shalosh. garsinan. chayyat shehishva et tefirato vekotzea mimmenna matlit ketanna shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot, chayyav lehachazir levaal habbeged:
Maatzad. keli shemmachlik bo hannaggar et pene halluach. ushefain shehu motzi dakkin hen:
Kashshil. kardom. umappil shefain gassin:
Etzel baal habbayit. kischir yom:
Af hannesoret. dak dak hayyotze mittachat hammakdeach shehem dakkim meod, shel baal habbayit:
Kanne hakkelim. besise hakkelim. leshon veet kanno, dimtargeminan veyat besiseh:
Vehognehen. kemo veagnehen, kelomar siftotehen:
Veaznehen. makom shettochavin bo habbet yad:
Hamekabbelin. sheyyesh lahen toch:
Menaggevan vehen tehorin. dela chashive hane chibbur lehavi tumat mashkin lichli sheyyesh bo vet kibbul, vesaggi venigguv. aval lichli sheen lo toch bae tevila:
Veaznav veyadav tehorin. avadu rabbanan beh hekkera, ki hechi dela lisrof alayhu teruma vekadashim. vedavka vatteruma avadu hekkera, aval lo vakkadashim, keditnan lekamman befirkin:

Av kesut. kegon levadin sheasa mehen kesut, zehu av kesut. vechen av argaman, leved tzavua argaman. kach pershu rabbotay. vaani shamati, av kesut, or shemmechassim bo habbegadim. av argaman. or shemmechassim bo argaman:
Tachrich kesut. or shekkorchim bo habbegadim:
Tachrich argaman. or shekkorchim bo argaman:
Chippuy. michse. targum michse, chofaa:
Tahor. dehachi tanya, yachol sheani merabbe chippuye chelim letuma, talmud lomar (Vayikra 11) asher yease melacha vahem, perat lechippuye chelim:

Velammishkalot tame. veha ditnan leel sof perek kol keli etz shennechlak, ze hakkelal vechulei‏ heasuy lechippuy tahor, chippuy demishkalot shane, lefi shehu asuy lekabbala, vehammishkalot atzmah enah cheli. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Vechen shene chelim. lerabbanan itztericha leh. velo zo af zo katane, lo mibbaya bemane umatayim delekka peseda dishvirat keli, amru rabbanan noten laze mane velaze mane, ella afillu bishne chelim deikka peseda shetztzarich leshabber hakkeli haggadol kede latet mimmennu deme hakkatan, velichsheyyavo eliyyahu nimtza shebbaal hakkeli haggadol hifsid shennishbar hakkeli shello, vesalka datach amena divha modu rabbanan lerabbi yose shehakkol yehe munnach ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. kamashma lan. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bichlal kol elle. bichlal kol avedat achicha:
Velamma yatzat. vechen taase lesimlato:
Ma simla meyuchedet. setam simla yesh bah siman, vechol simla yesh lah bealim tovim otah, shennaaset bide adam velo bat min hahefker:
Af kol sheyyesh lo tovim. lemiute mide dimyaesh. veyeush hu, deshamineh deamar vay leh lechesron kis:
Hayu shenayim rochvim al gabbe vehema. ha kamashma lan derochev kane, veaf al pi sheeno manhig, shello zaza habbehema mimmekomah:

O shehaya echad rochev veechad manhig. bazzeman sherochev menaanea beraglav ki hechi detezil habbehema mechamateh, hu deshavim rochev umanhig. veim lo haya ella rochev bilvad, manhig kana, rochev lo kana. veim hodu o vau edim afillu leachar shennifsak haddin alehem sheyyachaloku bishvua, cholkim shello vishvua:
Tevalin shel teruma veshel kile hakkerem. beha nammi rabbanan letaamayhu verabbi shimon letaameh. vedin tevalin kedin seor:
Hammafkid. velo ratza lishshava. shevuat hashshomrin. shehaya yachol lippater im nishba shello fasha bah veshello shalach bah yad:

Lemi shehappikkadon etzlo. dechevan deshillem kana chol tashlumeha. vaafillu lo shillem, ella chevan sheamar bevet din hareni meshallem, kana kol tashlumeha, lo shena tashlume chefel velo shena tashlume arbaa vachamishsha:
Sandal imki. sandalim hannaasot bichfar imki:
Kis shel shenatzot. kemin retzuot techuvot belulaot bisfat hakkis umoshchim otan elach vaelach vehakkis nisgar meelav:
Kefifa mitzrit. sal asuy mitztzure haddekel. meviin netzarim vehutzin vekorin otan veosim mehen kemin chutin veosin mehen kefifa vachavalim:
Sandal ladiki. sandal sheosim anshe ladikya:

Hare ellu mittaharin umittammein shello veumman. mishshum dechol hane yesh lahen retzuot veen tzarich lekashran, ella moteach bartzuot vehen nisgarim mealehen, vechen niftachin mealehen al yede retzuot acherot shemmoshech bahen, keen sheosin lechisin bimkomenu. veim hutteru otan hartzuot deshuv en reuyin lisgor veliftoach, tehorim. verabbi yose savar deaf al pi shehen muttarim, temein, kevan dehedyot yachol lehacheziram. chutz min hakkefifa, deaf haumman eno yachol lehacheziram. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Achar haggappa. setimat kotel shel etz o shel kanim:
Gader. shel avanim:
Gozalot mekushsharin. bechanfehen. dechulle alma hachi mekattere lehu, vekesher kaze lo have siman:
Lo yigga bahen. deamrinan hane eynash atzneinhu vei shakel lehu let lehu lemarayhu simana begavvayhu. hilkach leshavkinhu ad deate marayhu veshakel lehu:
Mechusse lo yigga bo. deen ze aveda sheyyehe muzhar aleha belo tuchal lehitallem, demishtammer hu:

Matza vegal uvechotel yashan hare ellu shello. mippene sheyyachol lomar levaal haggal ulevaal hakkotel shel emoriyyim shehorishu avotenu haya. uvilvad sheyyihye vo chaludda rabba, shennikkar shemmizzeman harebe haya tamun sham:

Mechetzyo velachutz. beechad mechore kotel hassemuchim lirshut harabbim. im metzaah mechatzi avyo shel kotel velachutz, shello, deamrinan echad mibbene reshut harabbim netanno sham veshachach, vachaludda shealav mochachat shemmizzeman harebe haya sham uvevadday nityaashu habbealim. vedin ze davka bilshon zahav vachatichat kesef vechayyotze baze. aval im haya keli uvetocho maot, im pi hakkeli lachutz hare hu shello, veim pi hakkeli lifnim hare hu shel baal habbayit:
Afillu vetoch habbayit hare ellu shello. delo yada deman ninhu, uvealav noashu:

Verabbi shimon mattir. beresha lo paleg rabbi shimon, kevan denafal seor shel teruma kodem shennitchammetza beshel chullin, vahare hi memaheret lehitchammetz al yede seor shel teruma. aval besefa kevan dichvar nitchammetza beshel chullin, ki hadar nafel shel teruma eno ella pogem. verabbanan savre af al gav devishlama noten taam lifgam muttar, shane hacha shehu ose otah reuya lechammetz bah kamma issot acherot. vahalacha kachachamim:
Asur lezarim. rabbanan letaamayhu deamre leel tevalin mishshenayim ushelosha shemot mitztarfin leesor haddavar hannitbal:
Umuttar lakkohanim. ditruma sharya lehu, veen bechile hakkerem kede lehachamitz:
Rabbi shimon mattir lezarim. letaameh, deamar shenayim o shelosha shemot mimmin echad en mitztarfin:

Besar kadshe kadashim. asur lezarim, afillu tehorim. besar kadashim kallim share lezarim tehorim veasur lattemeim: uvishshelan im besar taava. besar chullin deshare af lattemeim, veyesh bo kede levattel kol echad bifne atzmo, mitztarfin leesor lattemeim, afillu lerabbi shimon, dekadshe kadashim vekadashim kallim shem echad lahem kidamrinan leel gabbe teruma vechalla uvikkurim:
Umuttar. lezarim tehorim, afillu lerabbanan, dekadshe kadashim en bahem kede leesor:

Ze shehechezik bah zacha vah. vedavka shehayta hammetzia birshut harabbim, sheen arba ammot shel adam konot lo birshut harabbim, lefichach hammachazik bah zacha. aval besimta shehi shevil shel yachid, o vetzidde reshut harabbim sheen rabbim dochakim sham, arba ammot shel adam konot lo kol metzia vechol hefker shessamuch lo bearba ammot, veen acher rashshay letafso. vetakkinu leh rabbanan ki hechi dela leto leinnetzoye:
Achar tzevi shavur. sheeno yachol larutz, umishtammer betoch hassade im lo yitteluhu acherim, vehave chimtzia:
Zachta lo. sadehu. vehu sheomed betzad sadehu, uchegon sheyyachol larutz acharehen umaggian kodem sheyyetzu missadehu:

Achar haacharon ani va. im hasseor shel teruma nafal baacharona, haissa kullah naaset medumma, veim shel chullin nafal baacharona, hakkol muttar, shehaacharon hu sheose hachimmutz. veha deshare rabbi eliezer keshennafal oto shel chullin acharon, hayenu davka keshekkadam vesillek et haissur, veaf al pi shehoil ketzat shessiyya laacharon dehetter ligmor hachimmutz, af al pi chen nitbattel taamo veeno chozer veneor. aval lo kadam vesillek haissur venitchammetz al yede shenehem, asur, desavar rabbi eliezer ze vaze gorem asur:
Leolam eno oser ad sheyyehe bo kede lechammetz. deze vaze gorem muttar. vahalacha kachachamim:
Zoma listera. keli sherosho echad kaf verosho haacher mazleg. bakkaf maalin bo marak min hakkedera uvammazleg maalin bo vasar:

Rabbi yehuda omer en lahem. achorayim vatoch. taama derabbi yehuda, mishshum dechol hane chelim yesh meachorehen chakak bet moshav keen sheosim lichle chesef, ufeamim shekkofeho al piv umishtammesh bachakak shebbaachorav:

Rabbi shimon omer yesh lahem. leinyan ma shebbetoch hakkeli yesh lahen din achorayim vatoch, sheim nitmeu achorav lo nitma ma shebbetoch hakkeli. aval leinyan hakkeli atzmo en chilluk din achorav middin tocho, sheim nitmeu achorav tzarich lehatebil et kullo cheillu nitma tocho. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bichli. ucheli yesh bo siman:
Kemot shehu. rekan:
Tzibbure ferot. simanan, minyan o makom:
Shelosha matbeot ze al gav ze. o yoter. vehammachriz machriz matbeot matzati, veze ba veomer kach vechach hayu vehayu munnachim ze al ze:
Yiddalek. deyesh shevach etzim battavshil, vechen bappat:
Yaale beechad umatayim. uveha mode rabbi meir, deen ze measara devarim dechashev rabbi meir dimkaddeshim, kidmuchach bayrushalmi:
Mehuha. beged yashan uvaluy:
Shettelayah. kemo shettelaah. milleshon telay al gabbe telay. kelomar shessam hayeshana telay al hachadasha:
Holchim achar habberia. danin otah kedin habberia, im temea temea, veim tehora tehora:
Ketanna al haggedola. ben shetehen mehuhot ben shetehen beriot:

Holchim achar haggedola. veim haggedola nekuva chemotzi rimmon shebbishvira chazo nithara, gam hakketanna hamechubberet immah tehora af al pi shehi shelema. veim haggedola shelema vahare hi mekabbelet tuma, af hakketanna hamechubberet immah temea af al pi shehi nekuva vemotzi rimmon:
Holchim achar happenimit. im temea happenimit temea hachitzona, veim happenimit tehora hachitzona nammi tehora:

Rabbi shimon omer kaf moznayim. lefaroshe milleta detanna kamma kaate. uvechaf moznayim shel mattachot temea ayre, deim telaah betachtit hammecham mibbifnim, tame hammecham, veim telaah mibbachutz, tahor hammecham:

Telayah al tziddah. shehidbik hattelay al dafnot hammecham lo vetachtito, ben mibbachutz ben mibbifnim, tahor. umaskana dechullah pirkin vetaama dechullehu tame midras vetame teme met vetahor mikkelum haamurim kan hu, dechol davar harauy lishchiva, vehu sheyyihye asuy lishchiva o lishiva o lehishshaen alav, tame midras, levad im hu cheli cheres deeno mittamme midras, dehachi yalfinan mikkera dichtiv (Vayikra 15) veish asher yigga bemishkavo, makkish mishkavo lo, ma hu yesh lo tohora vemikve af mishkavo sheyyesh lo tohora vemikve, yatza cheli cheres sheen lo tohora vemikve. vehammappatz heasuy lishchiva, af al pi sheen lo tohora vemikve middichtiv (sham 11) kol keli asher yease melacha vahem bammayim yavo, vehay lav keli hu, mikkol makom tame midras, dimrabbinan leh mikkera dichtiv kol hammishkav, kol lerabbot et hammappatz, veen lo tohora ad sheyyechatech veyishshaer mimmennu pachot mishshishsha al shishsha. uchele avanim uchele gelalim uchele adama, tehorim mikkelum. vechen kol davar habba min hayyam, tahor. ucheli etz habba vemidda, shemmachazik arbaim sea velach shehem korayim beyavesh, nammi tahor mikkelum, lefi sheeno mittaltel male. vechen davar sheen alav torat keli, o sheyyesh lo torat keli veeno mimmeshammeshe adam ella meshammeshe meshammeshav, tahor, kegon tarbus shel zetim umappatz shel gittot vesadin shel tzurot, deamrinan bematnitin shehen tehorin mikkelum, dela chashive chelim shel meshammeshe adam:
Sheddarko limmanot. sheen adam mochro ella beminyan mippene chashivuto:
Perech uvadan. shemot mekomot hen. vaani shamati egoze ferech, egozim shekkelippatan rakka venifrachin:
Chulfe teradin. alin mitztzalot hatteradin:
Kulse cheruv. kilche cheruv shebbeeretz yisrael, shehem gedolim vetovim:
Shel baal habbayit. shehen gedolim, aval shel nachtom ketannim hen:
Harauy learla. kegon egozim verimmonim vechaviyyot setumot:
Veharauy lechile hakkerem. kegon chulfe teradin vekulse cheruv udelaat yevanit. veen halacha kerabbi meir velo cherabbi akiva:
Avudim. al yede achbarim o rikkavon:

Lo yigga bahen. lemachran, lefi sherotze adam bekav shello mittisha kabbin shel chavero, kav shello chaviv alav al yede sheamel bo, mittisha kabbin shel acherim sheyyikkach bidmehen im yimkerem. velo amru rabbanan hare ze lo yigga bahen, ella shello avdu ella ad kede chesronan hammeforash bemishnatenu, lechittim uleorez tisha chatzae kabbin lakkor vechulei‏. aval im avdu yoter mikkede chesronan, modim chachamim lerabban shimon ben gamliel demochran bevet din. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hayu yadav tehorot. vaalehem mashke tofeach:
Eno choshesh shemma nitmeu. mashkin sheal yadav baachore hakkos veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim:

Habbeged mittamme. litme met ulechol shear tumot chutz mimmidras, mishshum shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot. mishshum dachazi laaniyyim, veitrabbe middichtiv vehabbeged. aval lemidras bainan midi dachazi lishiva, uvefachot mishshelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lo chazi lemoshav:
Hassak. haarug missear venotza shel izzim, shiuro ben litme met ben lemidras en pachut mearbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim:
Shavin. littamme tumat midras uteme met, sak veor umappatz:

Sheyarav arbaa. leinyan ze neemar shiuro vearbaa, keshebbala venikra venishtayyer mimmennu shiur arbaa tefachim. aval bitchillat arigato eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyeerog kullo. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Tevalin shenayim ushelosha shemot. shelosha issurin chalukin ze mizze kare shelosha shemot, kegon pilpelin shel arla veshel ashera veshel teruma:
Asur umitztarfin. kelomar mitztarfin yachad leesor hattavshil shennitbashshel bahem:
O shene minim mishshem echad. kegon zangevil ufilpelin ushenehem arla o shenehem teruma. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Mardea. hu makkel aroch agol veav shelish tefach, uverosho haechad barzel rachav mechuddad lachtoch bo sharashim, ushemo charchur, uverosho hashsheni varzel kemo martzea, ushemo darvan, shebbo melammed happara litlameha:

Mishshiva lacharchur mearbaa laddarvan. im naflu mashkin temeim al hacharchur, en tame min hammardea ella shiva tefachim. veim al haddarvan naflu, en tame ella arbaa. verambam peresh, sheim naflu mashkin temein bammardea chutz leshiva tefachim min hacharchur o chutz learbaa tefachim min haddarvan, have chichli shennitmeu achorav velo nitma tocho, veotan shiva tefachim hassemuchim lacharchur vehaarbaa hassemuchim laddarvan lo nitmeu:

Ella lashsheyarim. keshennatnu chachamim shiur lacharchur shiva veladdarvan arbaa, lo natnu ella leinyan ze sheim nishbar hammardea venishar samuch lacharchur shiva tefachim o samuch laddarvan arbaa, tame, mippene sherauy laasot meen melachto. pachot mikkan, have cheshivre cheli vetahor. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Beged shetztzevao viklippe arla. kegon kelippe egozim verimmonim, degam hakkelippim asurim bahanaa, kiddarshinan [berachot lo:] et piryo, et hattafel lefiryo:
Yiddalek. sheasur bahanaa, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) vaaraltem arlato, shello yehene velo yitzba velo yadlik bo et hanner:
Kullam yiddaleku. rabbi meir letaameh, deamar lekamman et sheddarko limmanot mekaddesh, uveged shetztzevao sheddarko limmanot hu:
Vachachamim omrim yaale beechad umatayim. letaamayhu, deamre lekamman befirkin en mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad. vahalacha kachachamim:

Gerisin. shel pol shel teruma, shennitbashshelu im adashim shel chullin venatnu vahem taam, taama lo vatil afillu beyoter mimmea. uvelo taam afillu befachot mimmea share, deha devainan mea hayenu davka chittim bechittim dahave min bemino, deasmechuha akkera et mikdesho mimmennu, ma sheatta merim mimmennu im nafal letocho mekaddesho, vezehu min bemino:
Vetikkenah tame midras. adayin omed betumato, kevan deozen sheniyya kayma:

Tahor min hammidras. af al pi denittakkena rishona kodem shennishbera sheniyya, mikkol makom tahor, defanim chadashot bau lechan, shelleachar sheyyarda lah tumat midras nitchaddeshu lah panim hallalu, veen zo harishona meachar shekkevar nitkalkel bah kede bittulah:

Aval tame magga midras. mishshum deozen rishona keshennishbera vetikkenah shehevi ozen acheret tachat hashshevura vechibberah lassandal, nitmet magga midras, shehare naga bassandal hattame midras, vechi nishbera ozen sheniyya defarach minna tumat midras ishtayyar beh tumat magga, dechol hassandal mechubbar laozen rishona shennittakkena:
Ad shennifseka. ozen sheniyya:
Tehora. dechevan denishberu shete aznayim tu lo chazi lemidi:
Akevo. or shel sandal hamechasse et gova haregel shekkeneged shoko meachorav:
Chotmo. sheole keneged etzbeot haregel millefanav:
Tahor. mittuma dilmafrea, aval mekabbel tuma mikkan ulehabba:
Solyam. or shettachat parsat haregel bilvad, sheen lo akev. uvelaaz 97:
Haemum. defus shel minal asuy meor male sear:
Rabbi eliezer metaher. desavar lo nigmera melachto shel minal ad sheyyishmetenna meal gabbe haemum:
Vachachamim metammein. dechashve leh nigmera melachto. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kol chamatot tzerurot. nodot shennikkevu nekev hammotzian mide tumatan vekashar hannekev:
Tehorin. kemo shehayu, mippene sheatid lehattir hakkesher:
Chutz mikkesher shel arviyyim. sheeno noach lehattir:
Tzeror shaa. kesher heasuy lefi shaa veomed lehattir:
Tzeror olam. kesher heasuy lihyot kayyam leolam:
Kol chamatot tzerurot tehorot. ben tzeror olam ben tzeror shaa, vaafillu shel arviyyim. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Shenayim shehifkidu etzel echad ze mane veze matayim. kegon deafkidu tarvayhu ki hadade ze bifne ze:

Noten laze mane velaze mane vechulei. deamar lehu attun lo kafditu ahadade, velo chashadtem ze et ze shemma chavero yitba hammatayim. ana nammi lo remay annafshay lemedak hammatayim shel mi hen. venaasu keillu hinnichu kol hashshelosh meot bitzror echad, delo have leh lemedak ma yesh laze vetocho uma yesh lachavero:
Ma hifsid harammay. uleolam lo yode al haemet:
Amar lachavero teneha li vechulei. aval amar zeche li bah, kana harochev, veen hammagbiah yachol lomar ani zachiti bah:
Lo amar kelum. shekkenaah ze shemmeshachah miyyad chavero, vechol zeman shehayta veyad hammagbiah hefker hayta:

Ulema amru. kemo uvamme amru, kelomar beeze inyan amru shehamechammetz chullin bisor shel teruma, vehametabbel kederat chullin bitvalin shel teruma, vehamedammea shemmearev [umevashshel] chullin uteruma yachad, sheanu holchim hakkol lehachamir, umeshane min bemino. uvamme amru peamim lehakel vfamim lehachamir, bemin shennitarev im sheeno mino. umefaresh, lehachamir ketzad, seor shel terumat chittin shennafal letoch issat chittin shel chullin, dehaynu min bemino, oser benoten taam afillu yoter mimmea, vead mea oser afillu belo netinat taam:
Chavile tiltan. en chavila pechuta meesrim vachamishsha zirim:

Nitarvu vaacherim. garsinan, velo garsinan vaacherim baacherim. vei garsinan la tzarich lomar shennitarvu kol otan acherim baacherim, delo have ella chad sefeka, veashmeinan af al gav deikka tere rubbe, asire:

Kullam yiddaleku. veha delo amrinan yimmachru kullan chutz middeme issur shebbahen, kidamar rabbi shimon ben gamliel beferek [batra] daavoda zara gabbe yen nesech, mishshum dehacha chayshinan bechulehu shemma yachazor haoved kochavim veyimkerennu leyisrael, ma sheen ken beyen nesech delekka lemechash lehachi:
